status: full-time in-office, exempt/salarycompensation: base salary of $100,000 - $110,000 doeare you the right fit? would it excite you to have a pivotal role in communicating to our community what is necessary to overcome our housing shortage and make home more attainable to everyone? if yes, please keep reading. about useveryone deserves a place to call home. not just an address or somewhere to take shelter, but a little slice of the universe that’s all your own. a place where you can plant roots and grow. where you have a voice. where you make memories. where you always belong. a house is a structure with four walls and a roof—but a home is wherever you can be you. that place might look a little different to everyone, but the feeling of safety and comfort it provides is universal. and to us, that’s a feeling no one should live without.since 1909, the master builders association of king and snohomish counties has been making home happen. we live in one of the best places in the world, and as representatives of our region’s housing industry, it’s our duty to keep it that way—by making housing available and attainable to everyone. that’s why we support those who provide the puget sound region with places people can call home.we’ve been the voice for builders for more than 100 years, helping to shape our community for the greater good. we devote years to creating legislation that promotes a free market where housing supply can keep up with regional demands. we collaborate with our communities to develop land in ways that serve everyone, balancing environmental preservation with housing provision. and we’re continuously building a home of our own, where our members can connect, learn from each other, and succeed. together, we’re determined to provide our region with attainable housing—today, tomorrow, and for the next 100 years.there’s a reason people say home is where the heart is—because home is where everything begins. it’s integral to human success, to creating connected communities, and to building a better tomorrow. that’s why, as the master builders association of king and snohomish counties, we don’t just make housing happen—we make home happen.what it takes to succeedhere are the skills and traits you’ll need to be successful in our organization.a team player -- you define personal success by the success of the association and your teammates in addition to the excellence of your own work.courageous – you are always willing to try something new, whether that is a new responsibility or a new way of approaching an existing one.self-motivated but also collaborative – you take full ownership of your work statement but also enjoy working with a team.highly adaptive and resilient – when necessary, you are happy to iterate, react to changes in requirements, and learn for next time.organized and detail-oriented – you have a knack for record-keeping and multi-tasking and have strong proofreading and copyediting skills.an excellent communicator – you write and speak effectively at varying levels of technical detail depending on what is most effective with any given audience.skilled & experienced but also humble – you are confident in what you bring to the team while recognizing that your opinion isn’t the only one that matters.a good coach – if you are managing people, you are comfortable both praising excellence and identifying areas for improvement.position overviewthe advocacy communications manager has an overarching primary objective: to ensure members, policymakers, and broader community understand mbaks’ advocacy priorities and how to make home more attainable for all.to accomplish that objective, the advocacy communications manager has four primary responsibilities:1. develop and execute strategic, member-focused communications that advance the priorities of the homebuilding industry and demonstrate the value of mbaks advocacy.2. contribute to a culture of excellence within the team to advance the priorities and objectives of the association.3. provide coaching, feedback, challenging tasks, cross-training opportunities, mentoring, and soft-skills consultation to any direct reports. and as you collaborate with staff on projects, help them understand the “why” in addition to the “what” of your recommendations.4. develop and / or maintain processes, tools and behaviors that support the needs of the association’s stakeholders. focus on effective project management and timeliness and quality of deliverables while being approachable, flexible and professional.the advocacy communications manager currently oversees one other staff member and works closely with internal stakeholders to create and distribute a wide variety of impactful communication pieces in support of the association’s programs, products and experiences, primarily those relating to its advocacy efforts.the position communicates with a wide variety of audiences, including homebuilders and remodelers, industry professionals and suppliers, elected officials, and the general public, across websites, targeted emails, a weekly e-newsletter, social media, advertising, presentations, and digital and physical collateral for events.the advocacy communications manager needs to understand the unique voice and branding elements for each of those audiences and be adept at both overseeing and executing the full production process for all forms of communication. success in this role requires strong writing and storytelling, public policy fluency, visual communication skills, and the to do. powerful ai will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. there are groups building ai who don't share these goals. whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether ai expands human freedom or shrinks it.we're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of gws of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. we acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. speed and scale are our key from first principles. challenge every assumption. zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.love of the game. the frontier of ai is the most interesting problem of our time. we put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.build something that actually matters. if you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.the public affairs teamexamples of key problems the team is working onshape the policy and regulations that make or break the industry. state and local rules on power, land, and permitting can open a market or close it. you'll track legislation and regulatory shifts, brief leadership on political risk, and work to shape outcomes in our favor before they turn into blockers.turn neighbors and officials into advocates. grants, and write communications materials that translate infrastructure complexity into clear narratives for community, government, and executive audiences.manage external partners, including relationship with a strategic customer, serving as the primary point of contact between aws and the customer's leadership. you'll design, build, and deliver programs that create meaningful impact for the strategy and execution of community engagement to drive impact in untapped markets, with a focus on long-term, innovative, high-impact programs that leverage amazon's unique assets and culture. partner-facing marketing that carry strategy to closed revenue, deciding with incomplete information and improving through iteration rather than waiting for certainty.essential duties and capture experiences, and sales collateral, and hold them to conversion performance.own paid media and digital strategy as a lead generation channel for the commercial business, partnering with media on targeting, budget allocation, cost per qualified lead, and pipeline contribution.own launch planning across the commercial portfolio including timelines, channel roles, asset requirements, and partners sell the commercial portfolio with confidence.create launch toolkits, training materials, and visual standards for categories buyers do not yet know.hold the portfolio's representation consistent across distributor, dealer, and partner channels.work with sales to define how inbound leads route and qualify, and close the loop between media spend and closed revenue.define success metrics across awareness, consideration, lead quality, conversion, and early adoption.measure campaign and creative effectiveness against pipeline impact, working with analytics to find root causes rather than symptoms.pivot spend, messaging, creative, or channel emphasis when results call for it, and communicate plainly what changed and why.take select upside bets from concept to execution with clear objectives, resourcing, dependencies, risks, and measurement.education & experienceeducation and basic qualificationsbachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field.5–7 years in perform.working command of paid media and digital marketing strategy built for lead generation, including cost per lead, funnel conversion, and pipeline contribution.proven track record partnering closely with a sales organization and earning credibility with it.demonstrated ability to read campaign performance and adjust course without waiting to be told.experience launching new products or emerging categories that required customer education.ability to decide with incomplete information and keep work moving.authorized to work in the united states without sponsorship.preferred defenders have. together, these shifts represent the biggest change in cybersecurity in a generation.amazon web services (aws) is investing to lead through that shift. we have long set the standard abilities across the globe, shaping experiences that move between the digital and physical world every day.uber is seeking a creative director to lead our product expression team , responsible for defining how uber comes to life through illustration, motion, design language, visual storytelling, and moments of delight across our products .this is a senior creative leadership role for someone who can establish a compelling creative vision and also get close to the work. you'll lead and inspire a multidisciplinary team while staying close to the work-developing and prototyping new creative concepts and systems, working directly alongside designers to explore and refine ideas, and providing a high bar for craft. you'll lead through both direction and making, helping push the work from good to exceptional.you'll work across design systems, product design, brand, marketing, engineering, and product to create an expressive language that is distinctly uber while building the systems that allow it to scale across a global product ecosystem.this role requires exceptional taste, creative judgment, strong visual and motion craft, systems thinking, and the ability to influence within a complex matrix organization. you should be equally comfortable setting a multi-year creative direction, presenting to senior leadership, leading a critique, and opening the tools to explore an idea yourself.what you will do define uber's product expression. establish and evolve a clear creative vision for how illustration, motion, visual storytelling, and moments of delight show up across uber's products.  set an exceptional bar for craft. develop a strong point of view on what great looks like and help teams consistently reach that bar without sacrificing speed or scalability.  be a hands-on creative leader. this is not a role that directs exclusively from the sidelines. explore concepts, prototype ideas, create visual and motion direction, and work alongside designers when the work benefits from your direct involvement.  lead and grow the expression team. inspire, coach, and develop designers across illustration, motion, and visual design while building a culture of experimentation, critique, and exceptional craft.  create systems, not just moments. turn strong creative ideas into reusable principles, patterns, tools, and systems that can scale across products, teams, markets, and use cases.  partner deeply with product design and design systems. work closely with product and systems teams to make expression an intentional part of the experience rather than a decorative layer added at the end.  navigate and influence a matrix organization. build strong relationships across product, brand, marketing, engineering, and design. create alignment across teams with different priorities while maintaining a coherent creative vision.  connect brand and product. help translate the uber brand into meaningful product experiences while recognizing that product expression has its own needs, constraints, and opportunities.  lead through influence. build excitement around a creative direction, communicate the rationale behind it, and bring senior leaders and cross-functional teams along without relying on organizational authority.  champion experimentation. encourage the team to explore broadly, prototype quickly, and pursue unexpected ideas before converging on solutions that can scale.  direct and participate in creative reviews. lead critiques, working sessions, and creative explorations that make the work stronger while helping teams understand the principles behind the feedback.  move fluidly between vision and detail. be comfortable shifting from long-term creative strategy to reviewing the timing of an animation, the composition of an illustration, or the details that make an interaction feel uniquely uber. basic qualifications 10+ years of experience in creative direction, product design, visual design, motion design, illustration, or related disciplines.  significant experience leading creative teams and setting creative direction for large-scale digital products, brands, or experiences.  a portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft and creative leadership across multiple forms of expression, with particular strength in areas such as motion, illustration, visual design, or interactive experiences.  demonstrated ability to remain hands-on while leading and elevating the work of others.  exceptional visual, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate creative decisions expertise in one or more creative disciplines-particularly motion, illustration, visual design, or interactive storytelling-with strong judgment across the others.  experience building creative systems that balance consistency with expression , allowing teams to create distinctive experiences without fragmenting the broader product.  proven ability to operate successfully within a highly matrixed organization and influence senior partners across product, engineering, brand, marketing, and design.  experience collaborating closely with design systems teams and translating creative innovative content creation workflows. you'll constantly explore new formats, creative approaches, and production techniques to increase the volume of viable concepts we can test.we want someone who is innately curious about the internet, gaming audiences, emerging technology, and why content works. you understand why people love games, and can translate connection, fun, and emotion into actionable concepts. you’re someone who won’t wait for a brief to pursue an idea, defaults to experimentation over assumptions, and sees ai as an opportunity to fundamentally change how creative gets made. you'll combine creative intuition with a scientific approach to testing, using performance data to understand what resonates, develop better ideas, and continuously improve our advertising creative.what you'll doexecute and deliver high-quality, ai native & hand edited creativebring concepts to life using ai-generated content, in-game footage, gameplay replay tools, and traditional editing and motion graphics software as appropriate.experiment with emerging ai models, tools, and workflows to unlock creative possibilities that traditional production methods cannot easily achieve, including new ways to generate, transform, enhance, and assemble content.ensure creative meets starform's visual standards and is correctly formatted and ready for deployment across target ad networks.build repeatable processes that increase the speed, variety, and volume of creative production without compromising quality.continuously explore new tools and techniques, sharing discoveries and turning successful experiments into scalable workflows.ideate, develop, experiment, measure, and iterateindependently generate compelling advertising concepts based on an understanding of gaming audiences, internet culture, platform trends, and what makes metalstorm fun to play.develop a strong point of view on what we should make, why it might work, and how we can test it.work closely with performance marketing to develop creative hypotheses, prioritize concepts, and build structured testing plans.use performance data, including ctr, cpi, conversion, and roas, to understand what is working, what isn’t, and meaningful insights from noise, all to inform future creative decisions.generate meaningful creative variations across hooks, storytelling, gameplay, formats, and other elements with the intent of positively influencing performance.optimize for both the volume of credible creative opportunities tested and the performance of the resulting assets.improve the creative systemstay ahead of emerging trends in gaming advertising, internet culture, platform behavior, and ai-enabled content creation.proactively identify opportunities to improve creative strategy, production speed, testing velocity, and asset quality.document successful workflows, creative learnings, and repeatable patterns so the broader team can build on them.partner with other internal and external content producers, providing clear briefs, useful feedback, and creative direction when needed.communicate progress, surface blockers early, and take ownership of delivering results in a fast-moving environment.what we're looking forai fluency and curiosity. you already actively experiment with ai-powered creative tools and are excited to discover new ways of working. you don't need to know every tool; you need to be eager to explore, learn, and build effective workflows.executional capability. you can independently turn ideas into clear and usable hooks, storyboards, sequences, and finished creative assets. experience with video editing, motion graphics, gameplay capture, and generative media tools is valuable, but raw editing speed alone isn't what will make you successful here.exceptional creative instincts. you can identify compelling content opportunities, develop original ideas, and explain why they might resonate with a specific audience.native online sensibility. you understand internet culture, gaming communities, platform-specific conventions, emerging trends, and the difference between content that feels authentic and content that feels like an ad.performance orientation. you understand that creative must serve a business objective, and you're interested in how content influences acquisition metrics and player growth.a gamer at heart. you love games! you understand what makes games compelling and can translate that excitement into creative that makes people want to play metalstorm.an experimental mindset. you naturally generate hypotheses, test ideas, learn from results, and use evidence to improve your next attempt. you’re curious about where changes have impact, and nothing is too precious to investigate.ownership and initiative. you identify opportunities, develop your own ideas, and move them forward without waiting for someone else to tell you what to make.adaptability and pace. you are comfortable with ambiguity, can juggle multiple experiments, and respond productively when an idea fails or priorities change.collaborative communication. you can articulate your thinking, accept feedback, share learnings, and work closely with marketing and creative teammates to improve the outcome.what success looks likeai-enabled workflows that meaningfully increase creative speed, variety, and output.a steady pipeline of high-potential concepts grounded in audience insights, platform behavior, and game knowledge.consistent delivery of polished, platform-ready creative across target ad networks.more credible creative experiments reaching testing, with less time lost to production bottlenecks.a disciplined cycle of testing and learning that improves advertising performance and builds the team's understanding of what resonates with potential metalstorm players.why join starform?at starform, you'll have the opportunity to shape how a growing game reaches new players. you'll have room to explore new creative approaches, experiment with emerging ai capabilities, and influence the systems and strategies behind our advertising—not simply execute briefs handed to you.we're a small team that values initiative, curiosity, high standards, and people who are motivated to make a meaningful impact. if you're excited by the intersection of gaming, internet culture, creative experimentation, and ai-enabled production, we'd love to hear from you.please include a link to your portfolio in your submitted resume.

smartphones, tablets, web browsers, select smart televisions from lg and samsung, and more--with no need to purchase new gaming consoles or equipment. luna brings more than 50 games to prime members at no additional cost, including gamenight, an evolving collection of more than 25 approachable, local multiplayer games designed to bring friends and family together in the living room. to play gamenight titles, simply scan a qr code on your tv and your smartphone becomes your controller. with simple and responsive touchscreen inputs and support for multiple local players, gamenight offers and easy and approachable way to play whether you’re an experienced gamer of a casual fan.amazon luna games is hiring a creator marketing manager to lead the strategy, planning, execution and management for creator marketing initiatives for amazon gaming as well as developing always-on creator programs, making sure we shift the mental model from one-off, transactional paid executions to long-lasting, relationship-based creative co-creation.the goal is to foster creator partnerships that enhance brand awareness, visibility and engagement while maintaining alignment with overall business objectives both in the us and globally. this position will play a crucial role in developing data-driven insights to drive creator growth, brand awareness and excitement for amazon gaming.reporting to the head of social and creators lead, the senior creator marketing manager will be a strategic and executional thought-partner to define and drive the creators strategy across our portfolio of games, services, and brands, contributing to a world-class creator presence on both owned (luna’s social handles) and earned (third-party channels) to fuel player acquisition, deepen community engagement, and elevate brand love.you will set the strategic direction for creators across all platforms and markets, establish global measurement frameworks, and lead a distributed vendor team of agency partners. the ideal candidate combines deep creator expertise with a passion for gaming culture, a data-driven mindset, and the ability to operate at both the strategic and executional level in a fast-moving, global environment.key job responsibilitieskey job responsibilitiescontent strategy & management develop and implement strategic frameworks for creator content collaboration across brand channels as well as third-party, creator-led handles. build and maintain a global creator content calendar that aligns social activations with game launches, live-service events, cultural moments, and tentpole campaigns. support and implement paid boosting creator content strategy aligned with the paid media team. evaluate and select content that aligns with brand and games strategy and messaging. ensure all creator content reflects luna’s brand voice.measurement and kpis establish a global social media measurement framework with clearly defined kpis for the creators program that tie social performance to business outcomes, including reach, engagement, sentiment, conversion, and player lifetime value. with the head of social & creators shape the creator goals, evolve the goals about junojuno leverages collective bargaining power to secure better student loan rates for students. with 290,000+ members and over $2b in negotiated loan volume, we've proven that group buying works. we are the most popular way to pay for the world's top graduate programs, and we're looking for someone to own the communications that reach our members at the moments that decide whether they borrow with us.the problemfederal lending reforms have created a significant market shift. in july 2026, new caps on federal graduate loans, including the elimination of grad plus for new students, came into effect, leaving millions of students with significant funding gaps. students need transparent, competitive private options, exactly what juno provides.your missionwe're seeking a marketing communications manager to own how juno talks to its members across all our products and business lines. most of that conversation happens over email and sms: juno sends at high volume to a member base of 290,000+, and the gap between a good send and a great one is measured in funded loans.you'll be the person who turns what we know about our members into the right message, to the right audience, at the right moment in their borrowing cycle, and who can prove what it did. this role is based in our miami office, and you'll train in person with our team during your first few months.what you’ll doown member communications end to end: write, build, qa, and ship email and sms campaigns and automated flows in customer.io across grad, undergrad, and refi.own the juno voice: write messages that are clear, accurate, and on-brand, and keep that voice consistent across every send.run the communications calendar: translate the goals of grad leaders and senior team members into a calendar of shipped sends, and keep it moving every week.learn the juno product and data model deeply:understand how a member moves from signup to rate offer to application to funded loanknow what we hold on every member, where it lives, and what it can and can't tell youuse that structure to build segmentation and personalization that hold up at scaleget the audience right: define who receives what by vertical, school, application stage, loan status, and timing. a mis-scoped audience is the most expensive mistake in this role.personalize at scale: use member data and liquid to tailor content, and help improve our personalization workflows over time.own measurement: report on what each campaign did. opens and clicks, but mostly applications started, applications completed, and loans funded. bring the read to the team before anyone asks for it.run the test roadmap: propose and run experiments on subject lines, messaging, timing, and sequencing, and keep a record so we stop re-learning the same lessons.keep the program clean and compliant: route messaging through compliance review, maintain suppression and deliverability hygiene, and keep the account organized enough that someone else could pick up your work.use ai as a multiplier: draft, edit, qa, and analyze with ai tools: copy variants, segment logic, liquid, and post-send analysis. we expect the work to move faster because of them, and we expect you to catch it when the output is wrong.what we offercompensation: base salary range of $80,000 to $100,000, depending on experience, plus an annual performance bonus.benefits: comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage, plus 401(k) matching.what we’re looking forbackground: typically 1 to 4 years in marketing communications, email marketing, crm, pr, or content.hands-on experience with an email platform (customer.io, klaviyo, braze, hubspot, mailchimp) is a strong plus; we'll teach you our setup.open to a communications or pr professional who wants to own a high-volume channel, or an email marketer who wants to sharpen their writing and data skillsexcellent writing: you can write a short, clear email or text that gets someone to take one action, and you can adapt your tone for students, parents, and graduates.you value direct communication: you see email and sms as among the most powerful ways to reach people, and you want to get better at them.comfortable with data: you can read a campaign report, reason about an audience, and tell a real result from noise. you don't need sql on day one, but you should want to learn it.ai fluency: you already use ai in your daily work and can walk us through exactly how. we care less about which tools you use than whether you've actually changed the way you work, and whether you know where they fall down.precision: the work is high-volume and unforgiving of small errors, because a wrong merge field or a mis-scoped audience reaches thousands of people at once. you check your work, and you build processes so the checking isn't the only thing standing between us and a mistake.reliability: you do what you said you would, when you said you would. the team will trust you to run this program without hand-holding.execution over ideation: you'll ship a lot. you'd rather run the calendar well than spend the week debating it.curiosity about the product: you want to understand how student lending actually works (federal versus private, what drives a rate, cosigners, deferral, and refinancing), because you can't communicate clearly about a product you don't understand.comfort with seasonality: our year has a peak. you plan for it months ahead and go all-in when it lands.location: based in miami or willing to relocate, and authorized to work in the us.the x-factoryou're precise: you catch the broken link before it goes to 40,000 peopleyou're a sharp writer: you can say it in half the words and it lands betteryou close the loop: a campaign isn't done until you've reported what it didyou think in systems: you'd rather build the process once than do the thing by hand ten timeswhy join juno?the opportunityreal impact: help hundreds of thousands of students get access to the lowest rates on the market.market timing: federal aid changes create massive tailwind for growth.proven model: $2b+ negotiated and 290k+ members. product-market fit achieved.

detail.desc: this role is a hybrid role with both in-person and virtual requirements. travel required to locations throughout the dallas-fort worth metroplex, with occasional travel to waco, temple and austin. travel is reimbursed.about us: join a dynamic, fast-paced team where your voice matters! we’re looking for a talented and motivated professional who is eager to make a big impact. if you thrive in a fast-moving environment, love solving problems, and have a passion for crafting compelling stories, we want you on our team!the role: as a senior media and public relations consultant, you’ll be the bridge between our organization and the news media. your role will involve pitching stories, building relationships with journalists, and helping to elevate our brand through earned and paid opportunities. we’re looking for someone who is ready to roll up their sleeves and dive into a variety of media projects that require strong writing, creativity, and adaptability.why you'll love working with usa collaborative team: work with talented, passionate people who are always looking to support one another.exciting opportunities: the chance to work on high-profile projects that make a real difference.a positive work environment: we believe in maintaining a positive, upbeat work culture where hard work is appreciated and celebrated.ready to join? if you’re excited about shaping the future of healthcare, solving challenges, and working in an energetic, creative environment, apply today! we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to the table.what you’ll dodevelop and pitch media stories that align with our brand’s mission and vision.cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key media contacts.write clear, concise, and engaging press materials, including press releases and media statements. respond to media inquiries and manage on-demand requests.problem-solve quickly and effectively when issues arise.monitor media coverage and create reports to track and measure success.collaborate with internal teams to ensure consistency in messaging and strategy.what we’re looking fora strong communicator with excellent writing skills and attention to detail.someone who is comfortable working in a fast-paced, on-demand environment.a creative thinker who can come up with innovative ways to tell our story.a problem solver with the ability to stay calm and efficient under pressure.a team player who is willing to work hard and bring their best to every project.a background in communications, public relations, or a related field.benefitsour benefits are designed to help you live well no matter where you are on your journey. for full details on coverage and eligibility, visit the baylor scott & white benefits hub to explore our offerings, which may include: immediate eligibility for health and welfare benefits 401(k) savings plan with dollar-for-dollar match up to 5% tuition reimbursement pto accrual beginning day 1note: benefits may vary based on position type and/or levelqualifications education - bachelor's or 4 years of work experience above the minimum qualification experience - 5 years of relevant experience

communications, campaigns and events — including sensitive issues and major leadership announcements. you’ll own communication plans endtoend, create compelling content and use data to assess impact and continuously improve our approach.you will regularly translate complex topics into clear, concise messages and visuals that help employees understand what matters. you’ll write frequently using company and strengthen the employee experience.as a employee communications senior advisor, your work will help power our planet, reduce carbon emissions and create cleaner air for everyone. are you communications that inform and educate, and when needed, manage risk and mitigate crises.leads editorial development to establish a continuous and optimized presence across platforms (brainstorming, sheets, site copy and key messages/talking points.serves as a public information officer (pio) during incident management team activations, playing a vital role in supporting our customers and communities during emergencies.a material job duty of all positions within the company is ensuring the protection of all its physical, financial and cybersecurity assets, and properly accessing and managing private customer data, proprietary information, confidential medical records, and other types of highly sensitive information and data with the highest standards of conduct and integrity.minimum qualificationsten or more years of experience in corporate communications within a corporate and/or agency environment.preferred qualificationsbachelor’s degree or higher in public relations, journalism, communications, marketing or a related field. experience developing communication plans and content, including executive emails and talking points. experience writing following ap style and smart brevity principles. experience using email content platforms for employee communications, such as salesforce marketing cloud, microsoft amplify, etc. experience developing content and updating intranet sites using platforms such as sharepoint. experience planning and producing large employee events. experience developing communications to connect with field-based employees. experience using adobe creative cloud and canva. demonstrated understanding of content and communication trends and technology.strategic problem solver and highly creative in finding new ways to achieve team goals and elevate the employee experience. working knowledge of microsoft suite, including sharepoint, viva engage. experience communicating across different company levels, such as customers, colleagues and executives. additional informationthis position’s work mode is hybrid. the employee will report to an sce facility for a set number of days with the option to work remotely on the remaining days.  unless otherwise noted, employees are required to work and reside in the state of california.  further details of this work mode will be discussed at the interview stage. the work mode can be changed based on business needs.visit our candidate resource page to get meaningful information related to benefits, perks, resources, testing information, hiring process, and more!qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the los angeles county fair chance ordinance for employers and the california fair chance act. relocation does not apply to this position.position will require up to 20% traveling and being out in the field throughout the sce service territory.this position has been identified as a nerc/cip impacted position - prior to being hired, the successful candidate must pass a personnel risk assessment (pra) or background investigation. once hired, the candidate must complete specified training prior to gaining un-escorted access to assigned work location and performing necessary job duties.about southern california edisonthe people at sce don't just keep the lights on. our mission customers with the safety and reliability they demand. at sce, you’ll have a chance to grow personally and professionally, making a real impact in southern california and around the world.southern california edison is a proud equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veteran status.we are committed to ensuring that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. please contact us to request accommodations at (833) 343-0727.

detail.desc: overviewnoaa research is one of the most consequential science agencies in the federal government — advancing the forecasts that save lives, the data that informs climate policy, and the understanding of earth systems that shapes decisions for generations. but great science only creates impact when it is communicated well. as an oar science communications specialist, you will be embedded directly within a noaa oar laboratory or program, working alongside scientists and senior leaders to translate groundbreaking research into communications that inform, engage, and inspire. you are a skilled writer, a strategic thinker, and a natural connector — someone who can develop talking points for a congressional briefing, coordinate a nationwide all-hands meeting, and advise the oar communications director on sensitive engagement opportunities, all in the same week. this is a role for a communications professional who understands that the stakes of getting science communication right are high — and who brings both the craft and the judgment to do it well.fwi is expanding rapidly and has been recognized as a 2024 and 2025 top workplace by the washington post, offering excellent growth opportunities in a collaborative environment.work schedule and location: in-person presence required at one of the following locations: air resources laboratory (college park, md); pacific marine environment laboratory (seattle, wa); david skaggs research center (boulder, co); global fluid dynamics laboratory (plainsboro, nj); atlantic oceanographic and meteorological laboratory (miami, fl); national severe storms laboratory (norman, ok); great lakes environment research laboratory (ann arbor, mi); or noaa ssmc3 (silver spring, md)  remote positions are expected to work in the office each tuesday (oar cfo-cao office day) when based in silver spring, md  normal work hours are monday through friday, 8 hours per day / 40 hours per week, excluding federal holidays  local and non-local travel may be required, including international travel; all unplanned travel must be approved in writing by the cor at least 10 calendar days in advance fwi is expanding rapidly and has been recognized as a 2024, 2025 and 2026 top workplace, offering excellent growth opportunities in a collaborative environment .responsibilities serve as an analyst and coordinator for communication actions, working closely with oar office leadership, the oar communications team, and subject matter experts across headquarters, labs, and programs  provide exceptional written and oral communications for oar products and materials, ensuring oar mission, work, and activities are presented in clear, concise, and understandable language for a variety of audiences  explain and organize complex scientific information into communication products used by oar leadership and the workforce, demonstrating strong writing and editing skills with experience translating technical information for non-scientific audiences  provide planning, coordination, and communication support to oar senior management for periodic meetings and events, including all-hands meetings and site visits  develop talking points and other materials used by leadership when communicating to internal and external audiences  provide training and resources to nationwide oar communications staff on a variety of communication topics  establish and maintain communications between oar communications staff to effectively communicate noaa-relevant information across the oar workforce  coordinate within oar to showcase oar mission, work, and activities across a variety of communications platforms and events  provide advice and recommendations to the oar communications director and oar laboratory and program leadership on sensitive issues, opportunities for engagement, and strategies for improved communications  document workflows and maintain organized files containing data associated with communications work required qualifications  ba/bs in a technical or business discipline — communications, journalism, science communications, environmental science, public affairs, or a closely related field preferred; advanced degrees or certifications may qualify for shorter periods of required experience  8+ years of professional and/or academic experience desired demonstrated experience providing communications support for a federal science agency, research organization, or similar technical environment  proven ability to translate complex scientific or technical content into compelling written products for diverse audiences, including non-expert and senior government audiences  experience developing executive communications including talking points, briefing materials, and leadership presentations for senior government officials  familiarity with noaa, oar, or federal agency communications processes, review cycles, and public affairs requirements  experience planning and coordinating large-scale events such as all-hands meetings, site visits, or public outreach events  strong interpersonal skills; demonstrated ability to build relationships with scientists, senior managers, and communications colleagues across a geographically distributed organization  sme ii candidates: demonstrated experience advising senior leadership on communications strategy and sensitive engagement issues  ability to obtain and maintain a low-risk federal security clearance fwi is an equal opportunity employer, including disability/vets.  why join our team benefitsat fwi, we place the highest importance on creating an exceptional employee experience. you'll have opportunities to achieve your career aspirations through internal promotions, professional development, and other recognition and rewards programs. join our team and take advantage of the many benefits we offer, including: health insurance  dental insurance  vision insurance  long-term and short-term disability insurance  life insurance  401(k) plan  holiday pay  paid time off  pay range $102,866.40 -$108,280.42 depending on experience, education, and clearance level.

including timelines, workflows, approvals, dependencies, and competing priorities.coordinate stakeholders and resources to keep communications initiatives moving forward.proactively identify risks, issues, or potential communications considerations and recommend appropriate solutions.manage multiple priorities while maintaining quality, accuracy, and timely execution.measurement & continuous improvementuse channel and content performance insights to evaluate communications effectiveness.identify trends and recommend improvements that strengthen audience engagement and communications outcomes.support reporting and dashboards that provide meaningful insights into communications performance.identify opportunities to improve communications workflows, tools, processes, and technology.bring new ideas and approaches to communications challenges while balancing creativity with business objectives and audience needs.brand & reputationensure communications consistently journalism, english, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.progressive communications experience demonstrating increasingly independent responsibility.exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills with the ability to simplify complex information.strong project management and organizational capabilities with experience managing work from idea through execution.demonstrated ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively with stakeholders and subject-matter experts.strong creative thinking and problem-solving skills.sound judgment and ability to independently manage multiple priorities.ability to adapt communications for different audiences, leaders, channels, and business needs.experience with communications platforms, technology, and/or measurement tools relevant to assigned responsibilities.skills & competenciesexceptional writing, editing, and storytellingemployee and enterprise communicationscommunications planningleadership communicationsproject management and executionstakeholder partnership and relationship buildingaudience-focused communicationcreative about mind:mind robotics is building physical ai for real-world industrial deployment, starting with the factory floor. we believe the hardest problems in ai are solved when researchers and engineers are hands-on with the physical world every day - and we're looking for people who are passionate about robotics, value ownership, and are excited to tackle difficult problems. join us if you want to move beyond digital intelligence and put intelligence into motion.about the team and the role:we're looking for a senior communications leader to serve as our first dedicated comms hire and primary partner to our ceo. you will own both his public profile as it relates to mind robotics – earned media, podcast placements, press interviews, and executive voice – and the company's internal communications as we scale. you are a builder who can operate without a team, move fast, and do the work. this role will shape the narrative and public opinion for mind robotics’ next phase of growth.responsibilities:ceo & executive communicationsserve as the ceo's day-to-day communications partner: briefing docs, media prep, talking points, and message development for all public appearances.drive a proactive earned media strategy—pitch and secure placements on high-impact podcasts, business and tech press, and conference stages.own the ceo's editorial output: op-eds, public statements, and investor-facing communications.build and maintain relationships with journalists, podcast producers, and editors on the ceo's behalf.external & corporate communicationsdevelop and own the company's messaging architecture, narrative positioning, and crisis communications framework.lead all media relations: serve as primary press contact, manage inbound inquiries, and produce press materials for key milestones.support fundraising and product launch communications in partnership with leadership, finance, and legal.internal communicationsdesign and run the company's internal communications infrastructure: all-hands formats, leadership updates, and the cadences that keep a growing team aligned.write company-wide announcements, organizational change communications, and culture moments in a consistent, on-brand voice.partner with hr and people ops on employee experience communications as the team scales.requirements:externalceo media strategy: develop a 6-month earned media roadmap with target outlets, podcast targets, and placement calendar within first 30 days.press kit & messaging house: build a foundational messaging architecture and press kit (company backgrounder, ceo bio, boilerplate, faqs) within first 45 days.first placements: secure at least 2–3 meaningful ceo media placements (podcast appearances or press features) within the first 90 days.launch playbook: partner with rivian's communications team to co-develop artifacts, playbooks, and sops for initial operator deployments — establishing a repeatable framework for all future launch communications.internalall-hands framework: audit existing all-hands format and deliver a redesigned structure—agenda, narrative arc, ceo prep guide—within first 30 days.internal comms cadence: stand up a recurring internal newsletter or leadership update channel (slack, email, or equivalent) by day 60.new hire communications: develop onboarding communications materials that orient new employees to company mission, culture, and leadership voice.cultural moment coverage: own communications around at least one major internal milestone (hiring milestone, product update, company offsite) end-to-end within the first 6 months.qualifications:8–12+ years in communications, with significant in-house experience at a technology company; director-level or equivalent.proven track record managing executive communications for a founder-ceo or senior leader with an active public profile.strong media relationships across tech and business press; existing podcast producer and digital media contacts a strong plus.exceptional writer across all formats—press releases, executive narrative, internal memos, and editorial content.startup builder mentality: comfortable owning a function end-to-end, creating structure from ambiguity, and operating without a team.experience in deep tech, robotics, automotive, or adjacent industries preferred.

detail.desc: job title: group brand strategy directorreports to: presidentposition summarythe brand strategy team at pereira o’dell is tasked with creating and setting into motion the overall behavior of a brand. strategists must understand every element that impacts a brand’s behavior: culture, consumer, company, category - the entire landscape that affects the communications a brand puts out into the market to accomplish its goals.the group brand strategy director leads the brand strategy development for the brand, working closely alongside our other group brand strategy directors and reporting to the president. they are actively engaged in both existing business and new business, ultimately responsible for brand strategy framework and positioning development, target audience understanding, qual/quant research, and partnering with the research partner on ongoing brand health trackers. responsible for creative brief development and strategic recommendations.this role will be a hybrid role based in new york.duties & responsibilitiescultural anthropologist - reviewing and ensuring that the larger brand (strategic and creative) platforms the agency is selling in/working on are future-facing - we’re working with and learning from culture, and advancing it, not following it.trusted client advisor - build deep, daily working relationships with clients and become a trusted extension of their team. understand their business well enough to anticipate challenges, push their thinking, and provide a clear strategic point of view, not just when a brief lands, but throughout the life of the partnership.creative resource - guide the team down paths that best represent brand needs.business analysis - work to simplify the chaos. a brand challenge is multi-faceted, and yet the best creative solutions are singular in nature - your job is to marry these two realities.consumer behavior - in partnership with communications planning, find patterns in consumer behavior in an effort to reinforce or redirect how a brand is behaving in-market. this means finding new ways to connect, to position, or to operate based on audience information.new business instigator - partner with the new business team to create provocative and thoroughly analytical new business perspectives and thought pieces.mentorship - actively grow the abilities and skill of the department members through formal training programs, mentorship and hands-on learning. this also includes resourcing for the department in partnership with the director of resourcing.thought leadership - guide the agency and our clients in the development of communications, and the understanding of their own research. author perspectives on communications that have ramifications beyond our clients and our agency.overseer of tools - develop a recommendation and implement strategic planning tools to enhance the process through specific planning tools as well as syndicated or proprietary databases that enhance the level of thinking and insight injected into the entire process.required knowledge, skills, and abilities10+ years of experience in brand strategy at creatively driven agenciestrack record of motivating ground breaking and award winning ideasexperience managing and mentoring other strategistsexperience driving brand ideas inside non-broadcast, media neutral environmentsability to wear multiple hats in a dynamic, evolving agencysocial/digital channel understanding essentialdepth in analyticssalary & benefits:the base salary range for this role at the time of posting is $180,000 to $230,000. this position is eligible to receive a performance bonus. the eligibility of an employee to receive a performance bonus is based on numerous factors, including business revenue. the salary an employee or prospective employee is paid within this range will depend on factors such as but not limited to: internal compensation of current employees in similar roles, market considerations, budgetary considerations, level of responsibility, background, experience, and qualifications.full-time employees enjoy a competitive benefits package for you and your dependents to ensure a healthy lifestyle. our benefit offering includes: medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life & ad&d, 401(k) with company match, short-term and long-term disability, hsa, fsa, and maternity/parental leave.additional information:pereira o'dell is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the us federal e-verify program. at this time, we are not accepting resumes or candidates from third-party vendors.

and leadership discussions.anticipate risks, resolve competing stakeholder input and escalate decisions that could affect brand integrity, timing, cost or the guest experience.measures of successimprovement in brand awareness, consideration, differentiation and key brand perceptions in priority markets.consistent application of the approved brand identity across u.s. campaigns, descriptionabout the role.we are looking for a creative brand strategist with hands-on food & beverage experience who thinks big, can steer our internal vision, and can help shape the visions of our clients. the strategist is a multi-talented professional who is practiced in thinking critically about restaurant brands and f&b businesses, crafting inspiring strategic narratives, and developing clear solutions to ambiguous problems. this role is specifically suited to someone who has experience working in restaurants, foodservice, food & beverage brands, hospitality, or a closely related f&b environment and is excited by the opportunity to build the brands and experiences of the future. you should be genuinely curious about how people eat, drink, shop, dine, and experience brands, and be able to translate that curiosity into meaningful business and brand strategy. above all, the strategist demonstrates a passion for the food and beverage industry and an ability to work collaboratively, nimbly, and effectively. sound like you? read on.responsibilitiesjoin us.we are committed to creating a more diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace. our goals and commitments are shaped and strengthened by our team. there is more work to be done. join us, and help us build a future where all voices are heard and everyone can feel they belong.responsibilities.as a strategist, you will...co-create compelling and grounded strategies with a diverse team of collaborators to create world-class f&b experiences for some of the largest and smallest brands in the world.support senior strategists in guiding projects from problem definition through strategic recommendation.support in translating consumer, cultural, competitive, and category insights into clear strategic opportunities.collaborate with internal teams to develop strategic narratives, frameworks, and presentations employing captivating storytelling and a keen visual aesthetic.bring a strong understanding of the restaurant and f&b landscape to client challenges and strategic conversations.help identify emerging food, beverage, restaurant, hospitality, and consumer trends and understand their implications for brands and businesses.qualificationsyour experience and skillswe are looking for someone with existing experience in food and beverage. restaurant, foodservice, hospitality, food & beverage cpg brands, or related experience is highly valued and is a priority for this role.2+ years of professional experience in brand strategy, consulting, marketing strategy, innovation, product development, or a related strategic discipline.hands-on experience working in food & beverage, ideally with a restaurant, foodservice company, f&b brand, hospitality business, or agency/consultancy serving these industries.a genuine passion for restaurant and f&b brands and an interest in how consumers experience them.a strong understanding of consumer trends and their business implications, and the ability to distinguish a meaningful trend from a fad, particularly in the food world.a passion for brand storytelling and the ability to turn complex thinking into compelling, easy-to-understand narratives.strong presentation skills and a keen visual sensibility. you know how to build a great deck and understand how content, narrative, and imagery work together to make an idea memorable.confidence working directly with clients and presenting strategic thinking with composure, clarity, and enthusiasm.the ability to write and deliver presentations that are to-the-point, memorable, and impactful.the ability to work closely and collaboratively with cross-functional teams and a willingness to learn as you go.in your cover letter, please address the following.about you and tce: why are you interested in joining our team?about business strategy: describe a challenging strategy project or problem that you were involved with. what made it challenging for you? how did you approach the problem? and what was the ultimate insight and outcome?about f&b innovation: if you came to work at tce, which company, product or service would you want to redesign?about uscore foodservice is a part of acosta group – a collective of the industry’s most trusted retail, marketing and foodservice agencies reimagining the way people connect with brands at every point in their shopping journey.core foodservice is revolutionizing the north american foodservice industry. with over 60 offices, we are a dynamic team dedicated to navigating the evolving landscape of foodservice operations. our mission? to seamlessly connect top-tier brands with consumers wherever they eat away from home – think ballparks, restaurants, schools and more. as the industry's premier foodservice sales agency, we drive demand, forge invaluable relationships, and accelerate growth across every dining destination.at core foodservice, we empower our employees to focus on what they love, fostering detail.desc: content strategist – modern office, great amenities including onsite gym + dog friendly!location: phoenix, az; onsite monday through thursday, wfh fridaysbase salary: $70,000-$75,000 benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401k, 3 weeks pto, paid holidays job type: full-time start date: asaptypical hours: m-f, 8:00 am – 5:00 pm (some flexibility) content strategist (content-focused marketing exp. req.; agency exp. not req.) description our client, a phoenix-based marketing agency, is expanding their team (~30 company-wide) and looking to add a content strategist to their office. this position is open following the promotion of their senior strategist to executive creative director. you will play a lead role in developing and executing content strategies across a variety of channels, helping shape the strategy, write copy, build creative briefs, and understand why certain messaging, formats, and approaches will resonate with a specific audience. whether you have agency experience or are looking for the opportunity to join a progressive agency that works across a variety of industries and client audiences, this is a great opportunity for someone who wants to work alongside a team that looks for ways to stay innovative and challenge the status quo. what matters most is strong writing, strategic thinking, adaptability, and the ability to connect content back to business results.and then there’s the culture. a lot of companies say they’re culture focused, but our client’s employee tenure and reputation really speak for themselves. they’re a team that genuinely enjoys working together, which is why this is primarily an in-office role. what’s especially cool is that they don’t believe in putting people in a box. if you’re interested in learning something new or exploring another area of the business, they’ll actually encourage you to do it. and if that isn’t reason enough, if you have a pup you don’t want to leave behind, their office is dog friendly, too.content strategist (content-focused marketing exp. req.; agency exp. not req.) responsibilities• own content strategy across social, email, web, seo, paid, and digital channels• write and edit copy while shifting voice and tone across brands and audiences• turn business goals and audience needs into actionable content plans• develop briefs that give creative teams clear direction on messaging and execution• shape social strategy around platform behavior, audience interests, and current trends• incorporate seo and aeo best practices into web and blog content• review work for strategic fit, brand voice, accuracy, and overall quality• use performance data and audience insights to identify opportunities for improvement• share strategic recommendations with clients and collaborate across internal teamcontent strategist (content-focused marketing exp. req.; agency exp. not req.) qualifications • bachelor’s degree required (open to major)• 3+ years of experience in content strategy, copywriting, seo, or a closely related discipline• exceptional writing and editing skills with a strong command of voice and tone• strong background in email marketing with experience in either organic social or paid media• knowledge of seo/aeo, audience behavior, and using data to improve content performance

requirements.about nc childnc child is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization that advocates for public policies that improve the lives of all north carolina children. as the state's only multi-issue child advocacy organization, our work addresses the whole child, including health and well- being, early childhood education, and family economic security. we are also a trusted source of state-level research and data for policymakers and child advocates across north carolina.the opportunitync child is seeking an experienced, strategic, and mission-driven director of communications to strengthen our voice, expand our reach, and help advance policies that improve the lives of children and families. reporting to the senior director of development and communications, this individual-contributor role develops communications strategies, leads proactive media outreach, translates research and policy into compelling content, and makes recommendations on audience priorities, message positioning, child research, policy positions, experts, and constituent perspectives. prepare press releases and media advisories, maintain media contacts in meltwater, and promote nc child's child health report detail.desc: about audubonthe national audubon society is a leading nonprofit conservation organization with 120 years of science-based, community-driven impact, dedicated to protecting birds and the places they need, today and tomorrow. birds are powerful indicators of our planet’s health, acting as sentinels that warn us of environmental change and inspire action. audubon works across the western hemisphere, driven by the understanding that what is good for birds is good for the planet. through a collaborative, nonpartisan approach across habitats, borders, and the political spectrum, audubon drives meaningful and lasting conservation outcomes. with over 1,000 staff and more than 2.6 million supporters, audubon is a dynamic and ever-growing force committed to ensuring a better planet for both birds and people for generations to come. learn more at www.audubon.org and on facebook and instagram @audubonsociety.position summarythe communications associate will contribute to audubon’s team in south carolina by supporting general communications and community building efforts, helping raise awareness of our mission, programs and places across the state while educating and activating key audiences in support of our conservation and policy priorities. working closely with the senior communications manager and other staff, the communications associate will oversee day-to-day communications activities, supporting earned media efforts as well as the creation and distribution of content across web, social media, email, and other owned and paid channels.this position is classified as hybrid, in accordance with audubon’s “where we work” policy. hybrid employees are expected to work in an audubon office every monday and tuesday and an additional two days each month of the employee’s choosing. candidates should be located within commuting distance (40 miles or less) of audubon's offices and centers in columbia, sc, charleston, sc, audubon silver bluff sanctuary in jackson, sc or audubon center and sanctuary at beidler forest in harleyville, sc.compensation$27.00 - $29.00 / houradditional job descriptionessential functions support senior communications manager in the development of annual communications work plans for audubon’s team in south carolina. serve as primary implementer of day-to-day communications, working with leadership team to broaden audubon’s visibility and reach.work with program staff to proactively gather stories of our conservation and policy work and lead the production of consistent, high-quality storytelling that amplifies these stories via newsletters, blogs, social media, and other channels and promotional materials.produce and/or manage video and photo coverage of programs when appropriate.assist in securing local earned media for initiatives for audubon's work/initiatives in sc. manage media lists and develop relationships with reporters.support policy and community building staff with outreach and advocacy campaigns, leveraging tools like everyaction and mobilize to engage and grow membership.support the coordination, execution and documentation of special and annual events, including outreach and media coverage.track metrics and analytics across our channels, including earned media, social media and website, and develop regular reports for staff highlighting trends.preparing materials for our community and campus chapter use to amplify our advocacy and conservation outcomes.support a culture of philanthropy, including public funding efforts.maintains and fosters culture of safety.other job-related duties as assigned.qualifications and experiencebachelor’s degree required in journalism, communications, marketing, political science, environmental studies or other relevant areas of focus.1-2 years of professional experience with public relations, brand management, writing, editing, campaign organizing, project management and/or advocacy preferred. an equivalent combination of education and experience may also be considered.strong communication and interpersonal skills a must; ability to work with multiple stakeholder groups across a decentralized organization is also necessary.excellent english language writing skills, spelling, and grammar with a knack for online communications and messaging required.proficiency with microsoft office applications and obvious ability to easily learn how to use tools to manage online communications tools.demonstrated personal and professional commitment to and experience in advancing inclusion and belonging.strong proficiency in a wide range of digital platforms and programs, including microsoft office, adobe indesign and photoshop, wordpress, facebook, twitter, instagram, youtube, everyaction, mobilize or similar email management system.photography, sound and video recording and editing capabilities are a plus; experience in the nonprofit sector on issues related to conservation; knowledge of south carolina and its people/geography/history/environment.must be willing to travel, as well as commit to some evening and weekend work as needed.must have reliable transportation and/or a valid driver’s license.commitment to audubon’s organizational values of care, collaboration, change, integrity, impact, and innovation.experience fostering inclusive and collaborative work environments is valued.national audubon society competencies: this role will also be accountable to apply and develop the following competencies.building relationships: establish and nurture meaningful connections and trust with others while fostering an environment of inclusivity and respect.problem solving: find effective solutions to challenges and support decision-making by drawing on critical thinking, creativity, and systematic approaches.accountability: be reliable and trustworthy in fulfilling commitments while recognizing inequities that may impact the ability of others to fulfill responsibilities effectively.supporting change: adapt to changes and modify behavior in response to new information or unexpected obstacles while considering the diverse needs of others.critical thinking: take an active approach to analyzing, evaluating, and interpreting information or situations objectively and logically to make informed decisions or judgments.eeo statementwe are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic outlined by federal, state, or local laws. we are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring process for all candidates.accessibility statementthe national audubon society endeavors to keep our careers site accessible to any and all users. if you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact accommodations@audubon.org. this contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

about our organization citizens for responsible energy solutions (cres) is a non-profit organization founded in 2013 to engage republican policymakers and the public about responsible, conservative solutions to address our nation’s energy, economic and environmental security while increasing america’s competitive edge. this work includes building out robust political and advocacy operations to support republican clean energy champions in the u.s. house and senate. in addition to working with members of congress and legislative staffs to discuss policy ideas, the cres team members also collaborate with industry representatives and subject matter experts in their mission to bring americans together to solve our most pressing issues. cres policy goals include: reducing global emissions and growing the u.s. economy. enacting policy that builds off historically successful approaches to affordable clean energy. affordably reducing domestic emissions in a manner that can be leveraged globally.  to further its mission, cres established cres forum in 2017 to educate the public and influence the national conversation around clean energy solutions that are actionable, market-friendly and responsible. cres forum provides expert information to key decision makers, so they are empowered to act in addition to support annual forums and events, such as national clean energy week, to demonstrate how clean energy policies strengthen the economy, enhance america’s vital national security interests and help to preserve our environment for future generations.  scope of work: the director of communications advances cres' strategic priorities, mission and vision by executing a comprehensive communications and media strategy and strengthening the organization’s public profile. this role ensures consistent and effective messaging to legislators, policymakers, the media and the public—reinforcing cres' reputation as a leader in climate and clean energy advocacy. the director also plays a pivotal role in crafting compelling content, monitoring the media landscape, refining messaging strategies and building key relationships with external and government stakeholders.  reporting to the vice president of communications and collaborating closely with the government affairs, external relations and policy teams, the director helps shape public discourse, engage diverse audiences and enhance cres’ positioning. a primary responsibility of this role is to support cres’ long-term strategic planning. these duties include—but are not limited to—identifying opportunities to insert cres as an expert voice and/or areas for engagement to expand cres’ reach and exposure.    the director should demonstrate a strong desire to grow into a managerial role by fostering collaboration, supporting colleagues and contributing to the development of high-performing teams.  responsibilities: drafts a wide range of external communications materials including press releases, media advisories, talking points, op-eds and executive remarks, ensuring alignment with cres’s messaging priorities. supports cres staff and spokespeople for external speaking engagements by developing briefing materials and conducting prep sessions. monitors news coverage and social media to assess media sentiment, track relevant narratives and identify proactive and responsive opportunities to insert cres messaging. leads the development and delivery of recurring communications products, such as the cres newsletters, in coordination with internal staff and external consultants. builds and maintains relationships with congressional communications staff and monitors public statements from lawmakers and relevant stakeholders to inform cres communications efforts. leads cres’ capitol hill communicators program, including coordination with affiliated caucuses and foundations such as the conservative climate caucus and the western caucus foundation. organizes and manages c6wc (cool conservative communicators collaborating on climate change with cres) programming and events, ensuring alignment with cres communications goals. serves as a thought partner with the development of broader communications strategies in support of legislative priorities, events and issue campaigns, in partnership with the vice president and the other director of communications. provides strategic direction for the development of multimedia content and digital assets—including blogs, social media, and videos—while collaborating with internal team members and vendors to ensure brand consistency. assists with the drafting and editing of high-level organizational documents such as annual reports, polling decks, briefing memos and messaging frameworks as needed. supports the implementation of the communications workplan by contributing to goal tracking, reporting and performance measurement in coordination with the vice president and director of communications. collaborates with the external relations team to provide communications support for grant proposals, reporting and donor engagement. ensures adherence to cres brand and style guidelines across all external-facing communications. performs other duties as assigned. professional attributes: demonstrates strategic thinking and leadership: effectively leads communications efforts with a clear vision, guiding cross-departmental collaboration to achieve organizational goals. manages competing priorities: excels at juggling multiple tasks, meeting tight deadlines and maintaining focus in a fast-paced environment. politically savvy: possesses strong instincts and the ability to anticipate how others, including media and policymakers, will respond to cres' communications and initiatives. exceptional writing and editing skills: produces high-quality content quickly, with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to adapt messaging for diverse audiences. highly organized and detail-oriented: demonstrates excellent organizational skills, ensuring seamless execution of communications strategies and materials. collaborative and team-focused: works well across teams, driving consensus and supporting colleagues to maximize organizational impact. creative and adaptable problem-solver: develops innovative solutions to enhance messaging and media engagement strategies. aspires to develop managerial skills: demonstrates a strong desire to grow into a leadership role by fostering collaboration, guiding team efforts and mentoring colleagues to achieve high performance and shared success.  education, experience, and skills: required: 6+ years of communications, press, or media relations experience in a policy, political, or advocacy setting bachelor's degree in communications, political science, public relations, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. outstanding writing and communication skills experience writing press releases and op-eds existing relationships with beltway reporters, capitol hill communicators, etc. demonstrated experience engaging republican policymakers, conservative policy organizations, or center-right audiences, including building relationships with relevant offices, coalitions, and media, and advancing policy communications objectives with those audiences.  preferred: existing relationships with energy beat reporters knowledge of energy and/or environmental policy experience working in federal or state government experience working at a not-for-profit or similar organization to cres social media management  compensation and competitive benefits: the salary range for this position is $110,000 –
