job descriptionholland america line has been exploring the world since 1873. our ships offer innovative features and enriching experiences focused on destination exploration and personalized travel, inviting guests to savor the journey.the senior manager, onboard marketing is responsible for leading the strategy, governance, and execution of guest-facing communications and marketing initiatives across the holland america line fleet. this role oversees the development and implementation of printed and digital communications that enhance the guest experience, strengthen brand consistency, and support business objectives. the senior manager leads onboard marketing resources and establishes standards, processes, and priorities that ensure effective execution across multiple vessels. working closely with shipboard operations, guest experience, revenue, sales, and marketing teams, this role aligns messaging and promotional strategies throughout the guest journey. the position identifies opportunities to increase guest engagement, drive onboard revenue, and improve communication effectiveness through multiple onboard and pre-cruise channels. this role analyzes guest feedback, business performance, and market trends to develop innovative marketing solutions that support fleet objectives. the senior manager provides leadership, coaching, and direction to onboard marketing teams while ensuring consistent delivery of brand standards and marketing programs. the ideal candidate possesses strong leadership, stakeholder management, strategic planning, and operational execution skills, along with experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives within hospitality, travel, leisure, or consumer-focused environments.here’s a summary of what holland america line is looking for. is this you?responsibilities:fleet communications & brand experience leadershiplead the strategy, governance, and execution of all guest-facing communications across the holland america line fleet, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and alignment with brand standards. establish communication frameworks that support a seamless guest experience across all voyage touchpoints, including printed materials, digital channels, signage, collateral, menus, and onboard publications. define priorities, processes, and quality standards that enable consistent execution across multiple vessels. partner with shipboard and shoreside stakeholders to evaluate communication effectiveness and identify opportunities for enhancement. ensure messaging supports operational objectives while strengthening guest engagement throughout the cruise journey. monitor emerging trends, guest expectations, and business needs to continuously evolve communication strategies. drive accountability for communication excellence across all onboard guest touchpoints. onboard marketing team leadership & developmentprovide leadership, direction, and oversight for onboard marketing personnel across the fleet, including responsibility for workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, training, coaching, performance management, and succession planning. establish clear expectations and operational standards that promote accountability and high performance. ensure continuous onboard coverage and effective resource allocation to support fleet requirements and business priorities. foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, learning, and continuous improvement among onboard teams. develop team capabilities through ongoing feedback, mentoring, and professional development opportunities. partner with shipboard leadership to address operational challenges and ensure alignment with organizational goals. create an environment where team members are empowered to deliver exceptional results and contribute to business success. guest journey & cross-functional marketing integrationpartner with sales, marketing, guest experience, revenue, and shipboard operations teams to ensure alignment between pre-cruise communications and the onboard guest experience. develop integrated communication strategies that support guest engagement throughout the customer journey, from booking through disembarkation. identify and resolve communication gaps that impact the guest experience or operational execution. serve as a key liaison between shipboard and shoreside teams to ensure consistency of messaging and priorities. collaborate with stakeholders to launch new programs, campaigns, and initiatives that support business objectives. drive cross-functional decision-making and effective execution of marketing priorities across the fleet. ensure communications reflect evolving guest needs and organizational goals. revenue growth & commercial marketing strategylead the development and implementation of onboard marketing initiatives that enhance guest participation and support revenue growth objectives. partner with revenue and commercial teams to identify opportunities to promote onboard products, services, and experiences through targeted communication channels. evaluate the effectiveness of marketing programs using guest feedback, operational data, and business performance metrics. recommend strategies that improve visibility, engagement, and conversion across key revenue-generating areas. prioritize initiatives that maximize business value while maintaining a positive guest experience. support the successful deployment of promotional campaigns across multiple vessels. ensure marketing efforts align with both commercial goals and brand expectations. innovation, performance & continuous improvementleverage guest insights, operational feedback, and business data to identify opportunities that enhance communication effectiveness and improve the overall guest experience. lead the evaluation, development, and implementation of new tools, processes, and marketing approaches that support strategic objectives. establish performance measures and reporting mechanisms to assess program effectiveness and inform decision-making. collaborate with internal stakeholders to pilot, refine, and scale innovative solutions across the fleet. drive continuous improvement efforts that increase operational efficiency, guest satisfaction, and business performance. anticipate changing market conditions and evolving guest expectations to ensure organizational readiness. champion best practices and a culture of innovation throughout the onboard marketing function. knowledge, skills & abilities:scope: the senior manager, onboard marketing is responsible for the strategic direction, governance, and execution of onboard marketing and guest communications across the holland america line fleet. the role operates across both shipboard and shoreside environments, serving as a key link between marketing, sales, guest experience, revenue, and operations teams. this position oversees guest-facing communication channels that influence the guest journey from pre-cruise planning through disembarkation. the role establishes fleet-wide standards, processes, and priorities to ensure consistent execution across multiple vessels. in addition, the position is responsible for the operational effectiveness and deployment of onboard marketing resources throughout the fleet. the role supports enterprise objectives by aligning communication strategies with brand, guest experience, and commercial priorities. success requires balancing operational needs, guest expectations, and business goals across a geographically dispersed environment. the position impacts both daily onboard execution and long-term marketing strategy across the fleet. problem solving: this role requires the ability to evaluate complex and often competing business priorities across shipboard and shoreside functions. the senior manager analyzes guest feedback, business performance metrics, operational requirements, and market trends to identify opportunities and address challenges. the position must anticipate communication gaps, operational constraints, and evolving guest expectations that could impact business outcomes. success requires synthesizing information from multiple stakeholders and developing solutions that balance guest experience, brand consistency, operational feasibility, and revenue objectives. the role regularly addresses issues that require sound judgment in the absence of established precedent. the incumbent must identify root causes of communication and execution challenges and implement sustainable improvements across the fleet. the position also evaluates new technologies, platforms, and marketing approaches to improve effectiveness and efficiency. strong analytical, strategic thinking, and decision-making capabilities are essential to achieving desired results. impact: this role has a significant impact on the guest experience, brand perception, and commercial performance of holland america line. the senior manager establishes and maintains standards that govern guest-facing communications across the fleet, ensuring consistency and quality throughout the customer journey. decisions made within this role influence guest engagement, satisfaction, and awareness of onboard products, services, and experiences. the position contributes to revenue growth through the development and execution of marketing initiatives that support commercial objectives. by aligning shipboard and shoreside priorities, the role improves organizational effectiveness and execution across multiple departments. the position drives continuous improvement efforts that enhance communication effectiveness and operational efficiency. recommendations and strategies developed within this role help shape the future direction of onboard marketing programs. the role's influence extends across the fleet and contributes directly to broader business and brand objectives. leadership: the senior manager, onboard marketing provides leadership, direction, and accountability for onboard marketing resources across the holland america line fleet. the role is responsible for workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, performance management, coaching, and development of onboard marketing team members. the position establishes priorities, performance expectations, and operating standards that enable consistent execution across multiple vessels. the incumbent allocates resources to ensure effective fleet coverage and alignment with business objectives. beyond direct leadership responsibilities, the role influences cross-functional teams and stakeholders to drive successful implementation of marketing initiatives and communication strategies. the position fosters a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. strong leadership skills are required to guide teams operating in diverse and geographically dispersed environments. the role serves as a key advisor and subject matter expert, helping shape decisions that impact marketing performance, guest experience, and operational success. essential/minimum qualifications:bachelor's degree in marketing, business administration, communications, hospitality management, or a related field. 5+ years of progressively responsible experience in marketing, guest communications, hospitality, travel, cruise, tourism, or a related customer-focused industry. demonstrated experience leading teams and managing people in a multi-site, operational, or complex business environment. experience developing and executing integrated marketing, communications, or guest engagement strategies. proficiency with microsoft office suite and business systems used for communication, reporting, and performance analysis. ability to travel domestically and internationally, including ship visits, as requiredessential experience required:experience leading marketing, communications, guest experience, or commercial programs across multiple locations, business units, or operational environments. demonstrated success managing and developing professional teams, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and employee development. experience establishing standards, processes, and operating procedures that drive consistency, efficiency, and quality across a broad organization. proven ability to collaborate and influence stakeholders across multiple functions, including operations, sales, revenue, marketing, guest experience, and senior leadership teams. experience utilizing guest feedback, business performance metrics, market trends, and operational data to develop strategies, solve complex business challenges, and improve results. demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously while balancing guest experience, operational requirements, brand standards, and commercial objectives. experience leading continuous improvement initiatives and driving organizational change through the implementation of new processes, technologies, programs, or business practices. strong strategic planning, project management, communication, and decision-making skills with the ability to deliver results in a fast-paced, customer-centric environment. travel: less than 25% with shipboard travel likelywork conditions: work primarily in a climate-controlled environment with minimal safety/health hazard potential.physical demands: must be able to remain in a stationary position at a desk and/or computer detail.desc: descriptiondevice brand studio, an internal agency within the devices group at amazon, is seeking a talented senior ux designer to help bring new amazon offerings to market, products, services, and features within our devices portfolio. the senior designer will help lead and craft our connected digital experiences across amazon’s physical retail environments, including interactive displays, touchscreens, on-device demos, digital signage, and multi-screen experiences.as a senior individual contributor, you will execute on and help evolve the visual design vision for amazon’s retail product experience, contribute to scalable design systems, and tackle complex design challenges across our in-store product surfaces including touch bars and on device demos. you will consider the complete customer journey across physical and digital touchpoints, translating shopper needs into intuitive user flows, interaction models, states, and transitions. this is not a traditional ui/ux design role — you will operate at the intersection of brand expression, systems thinking, interaction design, motion, and physical retail, partnering closely with motion designers, interaction designers, channel managers, product managers, and retail leaders to deliver high-quality experiences.the ideal candidate has a strong foundation in digital design, typography, motion and brand systems and have the ability to take creative direction and translate it into polished, on-brand work across a range of formats. you will work closely with creative directors, art directors, and copywriters to bring concepts to life, iterating based on feedback and factoring in customer and business requirements. you should be comfortable presenting your work to peers and leads, articulating the rationale behind design and cx decisions, taking direction well, and knowing when to ask questions versus when to execute. you should have working knowledge of brand guidelines and creative briefs at a top consumer-facing brand like amazon.because the work is varied and fast-paced, you should have strong craft fundamentals and the ability to manage your own time across multiple projects. you will partner with creative directors, art directors, copywriters, and production to deliver design work across product detail pages, merchandising assets, retail fixtures, and packaging. you will also help create scalable design and interaction systems that can flex across devices, screen sizes, retailers, product lines, and global markets while maintaining a cohesive customer experience.this role is for a design-forward contributor who executes with precision, translates creative direction into thoughtful design solutions, brings a strong point of view, proactively identifies opportunities to improve the customer experience, and is looking to grow their craft within a fast-moving in-house creative team.key job responsibilities execute high-quality, brand-consistent design work across digital touchpoints, guided by established creative direction help define and evolve visual and brand standards that shape how customers experience amazon devices design for the web within responsive frameworks, design systems, and cms workflows, ensuring visual consistency and scalability apply brand guidelines accurately and consistently across a range of digital formats and surfaces incorporate ai tools into the creative process to explore ideas, develop assets, accelerate workflows, and expand creative possibilities collaborate with creative directors, art directors, and copywriters to bring concepts to life from brief through digital go-to-market delivery iterate quickly on design work based on feedback from creative leads and stakeholders prepare and organize design files and assets for handoff to production and other teams contribute ideas and point of view in creative reviews, while executing to the direction set by leads manage time and priorities across multiple concurrent design requestsabout the teamour team is committed to creating experiences that genuinely improve how customers interact with our products. we operate with a collaborative, inclusive culture where designers have real influence over product direction and are trusted partners in strategic decision-making. we're focused on building scalable design practices and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with emerging technologies. if you're looking for a place where your craft, leadership, and ideas will have visible impact, this is the team for you.basic qualifications 7+ years of design experience have an available online portfolio experience designing and prototyping with tools such as figma, adobe creative cloud, or similarpreferred qualifications experience designing job description:position summary:building trusted markets , powered by our people  at cboe global markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. we provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. as a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.  we’re building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we’ve earned as a global market leader. our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. as champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. we strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.   to support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model.location overview:cboe hq is located in the historic old post office district, it’s a landmark that blends classic architecture with modern amenities. the building features expansive spaces with high ceilings and large windows, offering an abundance of natural light and panoramic views of the city skyline and the chicago river.with its prime location in the heart of downtown, the opo building provides easy access to major transportation hubs, including union station and multiple cta lines, making it convenient for commuters. the building is home to a variety of amenities, including restaurants, a fitness center, and collaborative workspaces, creating a vibrant and dynamic work environment in one of chicago's most iconic areas.the corporate communications team is hiring for an internal communications specialist.we’re looking for a creative, skilled writer to join the corporate communications team, supporting our internal communications manager and contributing to several initiatives and workflows focused on internal communications. we’re a passionate and dedicated team seeking an energetic person excited about the opportunity to showcase cboe’s internal culture and deliver employee-focused content that engages and informs our global associate base.as an internal communications senior specialist, you’ll be responsible for the following:write and edit a wide range of communications materials, including articles for cboe’s intranet site, internal newsletters, associate emails and other corporate message documents using cboe’s corporate voice and style. disseminate communications internally, including sending company-wide emails, newsletters and managing cboe’s internal communication channels. proofread a variety of communication materials, including newsletters, web posts, press releases, presentations, speeches and other materials. maintain a central repository of communication content, easily accessed and shared by the team. ensure all content is current and accurate through regular, ongoing reviews. assist with quarterly updates to messaging. update and maintain internal communications editorial calendar and manage team project request dashboard. analyze metrics across cboe’s internal content platforms and create comprehensive quarterly metrics reports. work collaboratively with our design team to conceptualize and develop graphics for a broad spectrum of internal communications materials. collaborate across the marketing and communications team and with diverse stakeholders throughout the organization to effectively deliver content to internal audiences. complete other tasks as needed. the ideal candidate:has 5 -7+ years’ experience in communications, public relations, marketing or related field. holds a bachelor's degree in journalism, public relations, communications, marketing or finance. is a team player who can work cooperatively in group situations, exhibits openness to others' views and will source ideas from other departments across company. is comfortable seeking out information needed to deliver content on deadline. thrives working in a professional, corporate environment; comfortable being agile and flexible in a fast-paced environment is experienced in microsoft products including word, outlook, sharepoint, powerpoint and excel. you’ll really stand out with:entrepreneurial spirit, desire to do more, seek ways to enhance and improve, going beyond the status quo. creative thinker, ability to adapt voice and content, execute fresh ideas, tackle problems with ingenuity. snappy writer, ability to distill complex information into easily understood and engaging material for a wide variety of audiences. adaptable and nimble, ready to jump on trending topics or accommodate last-minute requests. eye for design and bringing engaging content and graphics to life. understanding of financial industry and interest to learn more. equal employment opportunitywe're proud to be an equal opportunity employer - and celebrate our associates' differences, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status.this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. candidates must be legally authorized to work in the united states without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.salary ranges (applicable for us locations only)at cboe, we are committed to providing a competitive, transparent, and market‑informed total rewards program. the anticipated base salary range for this role is $98,175-$127,050, with actual compensation determined by job‑related factors such as skills, relevant experience, education, internal alignment, and location.this role may also be eligible for annual incentive compensation and, where applicable, participation in cboe's long-term equity programs.additional information about cboe's total rewards program, including benefits and other compensation components, can be found here: total rewards at cboe.any communication from cboe regarding this position will only come from a cboe recruiter who has a @cboe.com email or via linkedin recruiter. cboe does not use any other third party communication tools for recruiting purposes.

content from initial business challenge through final execution. you will partner with strategists, marketers and subject matter experts to identify opportunities, shape narratives and develop content strategies that drive measurable business outcomes. just as importantly, you’ll bring those ideas to life through high-quality writing across formats and channels. this role reports to the senior director of marketing communications. this is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned tu office location for a minimum of two days a week.role overview and core responsibilitiesshape content strategypartner with strategy, marketing and product to understand priorities, challenges and growth opportunities. develop content strategies that align to business objectives, audience needs and market opportunities. identify content gaps, journey opportunities and strategic approaches that strengthen audience engagement. ensure content programs support broader brand, demand generation and thought leadership goals. recommend the right content formats, channels and experiences rather than simply responding to asset requests. build distinctive points of viewresearch market trends, customer challenges and competitive dynamics to uncover meaningful insights. develop differentiated perspectives that strengthen our market position and thought leadership efforts. help shape messaging, narratives and content themes that create consistency across channels and touchpoints. translate complex topics into clear, compelling and audience-centric stories. create high-impact contentpersonally write and develop thought leadership, executive bylines, articles, reports campaign messaging, web content and other strategic assets. create content that balances audience value with business objectives. ensure content is aligned to brand standards, messaging frameworks and audience needs. bring a strong editorial mindset to every project, elevating quality, clarity and impact. drive continuous optimizationanalyze content performance and audience engagement to identify opportunities for improvement. apply learnings to strengthen future content strategies and investments. stay informed on evolving content trends, buyer behaviors and ai-enabled content practices. required knowledge and experiences7+ years of experience in content strategy, thought leadership, editorial, content marketing, agency strategy, journalism or related fields.exceptional writing and storytelling skills with a portfolio demonstrating both strategic thinking and strong execution.proven ability to transform business challenges, market dynamics and audience insights into content strategies and narrative platforms.experience developing differentiated points of view that help brands stand apart in competitive markets.strong understanding of content strategy, customer journeys, audience needs and content ecosystems.experience creating executive-level thought leadership, long-form content, messaging frameworks, campaign narratives and integrated content programs.understanding of b2b marketing, demand generation and brand-building principles.strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and explain strategic recommendations.comfort navigating ambiguity and helping shape content direction in a fast-moving environment.preferred skillswe’re also looking for the preferred skills below. whether you are proficient or could use some brushing up, content development while maintaining originality and quality.benefits that support every part of your lifeat transunion, we design benefits to help you feel well, do well, and plan well—from day one.for your health: enjoy day-one eligibility for medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus supplemental plan options. spousal, domestic partner, and other eligible dependent coverage is available on select plans. choose tax‑advantaged hsa and fsa accounts to make everyday care more affordable.for your protection: we’ve got your back with company‑paid basic life and ad&d, optional voluntary life and ad&d for you and your family, and short‑ and long‑term disability. you can also opt into a legal plan, pet insurance, and travel accident coverage.for your family: from adoption assistance and fertility planning coverage to caregiver support, we’re here for every chapter. access dependent care fsa for possibility of an employer match, a complimentary care@work membership, and up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave with eligibility for a thoughtful, gradual return.for your future: build toward what’s next with our 401(k) with employer match and employee stock purchase plan (espp). tap financial wellness resources, career coaching, and optional long‑term care insurance to plan confidently.for you: grow and recharge with tuition reimbursement, flexible time off for exempt opengov is the leader in ai and erp solutions for local and state governments in the u.s. more than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the opengov public service platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. these solutions come together in the opengov erp, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum roi with every dollar and decision in sync. learn about opengov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at opengov.com.role overviewas a senior growth marketing specialist at opengov, you're a full-stack marketer—owning the complete go-to-market lifecycle for products, features, and campaigns. you'll develop positioning and messaging, craft integrated demand gen programs, build enablement collateral, execute launches, and measure impact. from strategy through execution, you'll combine storytelling and data to drive pipeline and establish opengov as the ai and erp leader for state and local governments.you'll partner across the marketing team, working with design, brand, and ops colleagues while owning outcomes end-to-end. this is a hands-on role where you shape gtm strategy, create compelling content, launch campaigns, and continuously optimize for results. you bring both strategic vision and tactical execution chops.what you'll docampaign strategy & executionbuild and launch integrated multi-channel campaigns (email, paid, webinars, social, events, content syndication) to drive qualified pipeline for targeted personas and accounts. own performance tracking, reporting, and optimization based on results.create compelling marketing content—emails, landing pages, ads, ebooks, customer stories, blogs—leveraging ai tools daily to scale production and test variations at speed.develop gtm messaging and positioning informed by customer insights, gong calls, sales feedback, and competitive intelligence. create talk tracks, enablement decks, and messaging guides that translate complex capabilities into clear value statements.define market segmentation, personas, and icp insights that inform campaign targeting and messaging across all programs.support abm campaigns and nurture strategies using marketo and salesforce to engage prospects across the funnel.stay plugged into government, market, and competitive trends to identify campaign opportunities and inform gtm strategy and decision-making.product launches & enablementlead end-to-end launch plans for new products and features—defining objectives, audience, messaging, tactics, timeline, and success metrics.develop comprehensive enablement materials (pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, faqs) to equip sales, customer success, and support teams on new capabilities.coordinate internal comms, customer announcements, and field readiness to drive product adoption.performance & optimizationown campaign measurement and reporting—tracking pipeline contribution, engagement rates, conversion metrics, and roi.analyze campaign performance, identify learnings, and translate insights into optimization recommendations.stay plugged into competitive, industry, and government trends; use insights to shape timely, relevant campaigns.what we're looking forcore experience5+ years of b2b or b2g marketing experience, ideally in saas or high-growth environments.proven track record developing and executing multi-channel campaigns that drove measurable pipeline results.strong writing and editing skills; provide examples of campaign copy, content, or messaging that moved the needle.experience with or demonstrated ability to own product positioning, gtm strategy, launches, or messaging development.hands-on proficiency with marketo, salesforce, and marketing automation; comfort with analytics and translating data into insights.mindset & attributesai-forward thinker: comfortable using ai tools (claude, gemini, chatgpt, etc.) daily to augment your work—scaling content creation, analysis, and decision-making.analytical and strategic; able to synthesize customer insights, competitive intelligence, and market trends into clear, compelling narratives.roll-up-your-sleeves operator; comfortable owning everything from strategy to execution across campaigns, content, and launches.collaborative and adaptable; energized by cross-functional work, fast iteration, and ambiguity.data-driven; demonstrate ability to measure, learn, and optimize based on results.nice-to-havesexperience in or passion for public sector, government, or b2g marketing.hands-on experience with abm tools, guru, aha, or pendo.background with win/loss analysis, competitive intelligence, or voice-of-customer research.experience launching products or features end-to-end.compensationchicago, il: $80,000 - $110,000on target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.the final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.why opengov?a mission that matters. at opengov, public service is personal. we are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. some people say this is boring. we think it’s the core of our democracy.opportunity to innovatethe next great wave of innovation is unfolding with ai, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring ai to local government. we’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.a team of passionate, driven peoplethis isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. opengov is headquartered in san francisco and has offices in atlanta, boston, chicago, dubuque, dallas, and pune.a place to make your markwe pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. if you have a great idea, we want to hear it. excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.benefits that work for youenjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and familiesflexible vacation policy and paid company holidays401(k) with company matchpaid parental leave, wellness stipends, and hsa contributionsprofessional development and growth opportunitiesa collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

location: chicago, illinoisbusiness unit: rush medical centerdepartment: philanthropywork type: full timework schedule: 8 hr (8:30 am - 5:00 pm)rush offers exceptional rewards and benefits learn more at our rush benefits page (https://www.rush.edu/rush-careers/employee-benefits).pay range: $32.00 - $46.44 per hourrush salaries are determined by many factors including, but not limited to, education, job-related experience and skills, as well as internal equity and industry specific market data. the pay range for each role reflects rush’s anticipated wage or salary reasonably expected to be offered for the position. offers may vary depending on the circumstances of each case. this role has a corresponding incentive plan based on multiple factors. incentive compensation and additional benefits can be found on our rush benefits page (https://www.rush.edu/rush-careers/employee-benefits)summarythe associate director, strategic development communications is responsible for planning, writing and executing original proposals at the $100,000-$1 million level and other deliverables that contribute to high-priority donor cultivation, solicitation and stewardship. while this role does not maintain a donor portfolio, the associate director works closely with frontline fundraisers, leveraging writing and organizational skills to help build relationships and secure gifts. the associate director also will work directly with clinical and academic faculty and staff throughout rush university medical center and rush university to define and articulate philanthropic opportunities and report on the impact of donors’ support. reporting to the director, strategic development communications, the associate director is an integral role on the office of philanthropy’s strategic development communications team, which develops and articulates messaging for rush’s current philanthropic campaign; defines and cultivates the campaign’s menu of philanthropic opportunities; drafts proposals, impact reports and cultivation materials for donors; and provides writing and editorial support as needed. the individual who holds this position exemplifies the rush mission, vision and values and acts in accordance with rush policies and procedures.other information bachelor’s degree required, preferably in journalism, communications, marketing, english or a related field, or with communications experience in a related subject such as public health or medicine. a minimum of five years’ experience writing in healthcare, science and/or higher education, with philanthropy experience preferred. exceptional writing and storytelling skills required, including the ability to articulate rush’s mission and the campaign vision to a variety of constituencies with poise and diplomacy. experience or familiarity with developing human-centered messages that emphasize real-world impact and meaning. professional demeanor. strong analytical and interviewing skills. curiosity about healthcare and the biomedical sciences. proven ability to master and then convey complex concepts, synthesizing information from multiple sources to produce original persuasive prose for general audiences. broad experience working collaboratively on communication-related deliverables; welcomes constructive feedback and strives for continuous improvement. a track record of shepherding multiple projects with overlapping deadlines from inception to delivery. poise in interacting with and eliciting information from clinicians, researchers, administrators and senior leaders. familiarity with associated press style. demonstrates a global perspective, crafting communications that resonate across cultures and contexts. proficiency in microsoft office, particularly word, excel and powerpoint required; willingness to learn new technology preferred.disclaimer: the above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. it is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements.responsibilities serve as primary author and project manager for assigned donor proposals, working in collaboration with frontline fundraisers who manage prospect relationships. craft original prose that inspires, builds trust and imparts a sense of urgency, answering the questions “why rush?” and “why now?” assimilate information in a variety of forms to articulate the case for support and communicate complex concepts in easy-to-grasp messaging. strategically and creatively utilize the philanthropy communications library of content to repurpose and build upon existing materials as appropriate. set and monitor timelines for project deliverables and stakeholder review/approval; mobilize colleagues from across the institution to meet established deadlines. assure that all elements of each proposal — narrative, budget, supporting information — are complete, accurate, tailored to the prospective donor’s philanthropic interests and goals, and reinforce consistent messages. in close partnership with the director, strategic communications, serve as a subject matter expert for select clinical and/or academic programs. keep abreast of institutional facts, figures and news, and of relevant themes and trends in health care. as assigned, create and update stewardship reports, campaign materials, presentations, toolkits and one-pagers, and other philanthropy content. partner with philanthropy communications colleagues to produce content about high-impact funding priorities and the impact of philanthropy that can be shared online, via social media and multimedia platforms, etc. act as a liaison to fundraising teams and to rush’s central office of marketing and communications, drawing from and contributing to the department’s shared library of content. develop, pilot and implement tools to improve all processes listed within this job description.rush is an equal opportunity employer. we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

stakeholder engagement.job descriptionthis position offers a senior communications leader the opportunity to shape, drive and protect motorola solutions’ global corporate reputation. serving as a role reports directly to the sr director of external communications.scope of responsibilitiesstrategic executive partnership: serve as a trusted, strategic advisor and business partner to corporate teams including the office of the chairman & ceo, finance, investor relations, strategy, legal and marketing.executive thought leadership & platform building: develop and execute holistic, end-to-end media interviews and major industry forums.financial communications & earnings: lead communications strategy for quarterly earnings releases, shareholder meetings, annual reports and quiet-period communications in close alignment with investor relations and finance.m&a & strategic transactions: drive comprehensive media and stakeholder communications for mergers, acquisitions, strategic including earnings materials, executive briefing material, speeches, press releases, strategic messaging frameworks and executive social media media content .measurement & insights: guide media within the chicago market and, ideally, call the city home.you will do this by:setting strategic vision and direction (30%)partnering with regional executive director, midwest to design innovative effectively tracking progress-to-goal.supporting the regional executive director, midwest to influence and motivate new and existing external constituents to invest in our work.developing and organizing a growth strategy for the midwest region, focused on sustainability in illinois, and expansion in michigan and wisconsin (milwaukee) as priority markets.maintaining and building goals, to meet all development kpis.donor engagement and brand awareness (25%)developing and executing a strong plan to engage prospects and donors across chicago and emerging midwest markets, while efforts.serving as an ambassador for onegoal, when needed, in major gift prospect/donor meetings, conferences, or other public-speaking engagementscreating the conditions for the development team to partner effectively with other midwest regional functions, as well as with the national external affairs team, to engage all external stakeholders through in-person, virtual, or written members.collaborating with the mlt, the national external affairs team, and org-wide colleagues to identify interdependencies and ensure strong execution of cross-team and cross-regional efforts.the determine fits, and build plans that are responsive to interlocking and evolving challenges and opportunities.you enjoy zooming out to see the big picture to craft a data-informed strategy and enjoy zooming in to execute, bringing that strategy to life — including standing up new fundraising efforts in emerging markets.contingency planning and problem-solving excite you, and working to streamline resulted in impact and building champions in your work because you understand others' perspectives and motivations and adjust your messages, approach, and design based on your audience.you get energy investing in onegoal.your written and verbal communication shines whether meant for a new intern, a milwaukee-based prospect, or a founding board member.you are a coalition builder.you cultivate impact to the next level. you operate with a strong sense of personal responsibility when it comes to solving challenges.you analyze data and marshal resources to ensure our students and school (preferred)willingness to travel to external stakeholders across the midwest region up to 8 times per month (required)

opengov is the leader in ai and erp solutions for local and state governments in the u.s. more than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the opengov public service platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. these solutions come together in the opengov erp, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum roi with every dollar and decision in sync. learn about opengov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at opengov.com.role overviewas a growth marketing manager at opengov, you're a full-stack marketer—owning the complete go-to-market lifecycle for products, features, and campaigns. you'll develop positioning and messaging, craft integrated demand gen programs, build enablement collateral, execute launches, and measure impact. from strategy through execution, you'll combine storytelling and data to drive pipeline and establish opengov as the ai and erp leader for state and local governments.you'll partner across the marketing team, working with design, brand, and ops colleagues while owning outcomes end-to-end. this is a hands-on role where you shape gtm strategy, create compelling content, launch campaigns, and continuously optimize for results. you bring both strategic vision and tactical execution chops.what you'll docampaign strategy & executionbuild and launch integrated multi-channel campaigns (email, paid, webinars, social, events, content syndication) to drive qualified pipeline for targeted personas and accounts. own performance tracking, reporting, and optimization based on results.create compelling marketing content—emails, landing pages, ads, ebooks, customer stories, blogs—leveraging ai tools daily to scale production and test variations at speed.develop gtm messaging and positioning informed by customer insights, gong calls, sales feedback, and competitive intelligence. create talk tracks, enablement decks, and messaging guides that translate complex capabilities into clear value statements.define market segmentation, personas, and icp insights that inform campaign targeting and messaging across all programs.support abm campaigns and nurture strategies using marketo and salesforce to engage prospects across the funnel.stay plugged into government, market, and competitive trends to identify campaign opportunities and inform gtm strategy and decision-making.product launches & enablementlead end-to-end launch plans for new products and features—defining objectives, audience, messaging, tactics, timeline, and success metrics.develop comprehensive enablement materials (pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, faqs) to equip sales, customer success, and support teams on new capabilities.coordinate internal comms, customer announcements, and field readiness to drive product adoption.performance & optimizationown campaign measurement and reporting—tracking pipeline contribution, engagement rates, conversion metrics, and roi.analyze campaign performance, identify learnings, and translate insights into optimization recommendations.stay plugged into competitive, industry, and government trends; use insights to shape timely, relevant campaigns.core experiencewhat we're looking for8+ years of b2b or b2g marketing experience, ideally in saas or high-growth environments.proven track record developing and executing multi-channel campaigns that drove measurable pipeline results.strong writing and editing skills; provide examples of campaign copy, content, or messaging that moved the needle.experience with or demonstrated ability to own product positioning, gtm strategy, launches, or messaging development.hands-on proficiency with marketo, salesforce, and marketing automation; comfort with analytics and translating data into insights.mindset & attributesai-forward thinker: comfortable using ai tools (claude, gemini, chatgpt, etc.) daily to augment your work—scaling content creation, analysis, and decision-making.analytical and strategic; able to synthesize customer insights, competitive intelligence, and market trends into clear, compelling narratives.roll-up-your-sleeves operator; comfortable owning everything from strategy to execution across campaigns, content, and launches.collaborative and adaptable; energized by cross-functional work, fast iteration, and ambiguity.data-driven; demonstrate ability to measure, learn, and optimize based on results.nice-to-havesexperience in or passion for public sector, government, or b2g marketing.hands-on experience with abm tools, guru, aha, or pendo.background with win/loss analysis, competitive intelligence, or voice-of-customer research.experience launching products or features end-to-end.compensationchicago, il: $110,000 - $140,000on target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.the final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.why opengov?a mission that matters. at opengov, public service is personal. we are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. some people say this is boring. we think it’s the core of our democracy.opportunity to innovatethe next great wave of innovation is unfolding with ai, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring ai to local government. we’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.a team of passionate, driven peoplethis isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. opengov is headquartered in san francisco and has offices in atlanta, boston, chicago, dubuque, dallas, and pune.a place to make your markwe pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. if you have a great idea, we want to hear it. excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.benefits that work for youenjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and familiesflexible vacation policy and paid company holidays401(k) with company matchpaid parental leave, wellness stipends, and hsa contributionsprofessional development and growth opportunitiesa collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

and implement strategic internal and external communications to advance the department’s organizational priorities, promote transparency, strengthen public trust, and foster meaningful public understanding of the department's mission and services. serving as a trusted advisor to the chief of police and executive leadership, you’ll shape messaging, lead media relations, guide crisis communications, and foster meaningful community engagement. working in close partnership with the city’s office of communications, you’ll help ensure clear, consistent, and timely communication—especially when it matters most.why this position is importanteffective communication is essential to building trust between law enforcement and the community. as the police department communications manager, you’ll help ensure the public stays informed, understand the department’s priorities, and has confidence in the information it receives. from everyday communications to high-profile incidents and emergencies, your leadership will help shape public understanding, support transparency, and strengthen the relationship between the wilmington police department and the community it serves.typical tasksleadership and staff development provides leadership, mentoring, performance management, and professional development for civilian and sworn public information staff, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team. provides instruction and guidance to department staff and participates in administrative strategy meetings. builds and maintains productive relationships with media outlets, community organizations, government partners, and public information professionals to enhance collaboration and information sharing.communications strategy and planning develops and manages communication policies, standards, and protocols that promote consistent messaging and align with citywide communication practices. designs and executes integrated communication campaigns supporting crime prevention, public safety education, community engagement, recruitment, organizational initiatives, traffic safety, and internal communications. directs the department’s multimedia communication strategy, including video production, digital storytelling, social media, websites, and other communication platforms. evaluates emerging communication technologies and trends to strengthen outreach and organizational effectiveness. advises executive leadership on communication strategy during critical incidents, emergencies, major investigations, and other high-profile events, ensuring timely, accurate, and transparent information while considering operational and legal constraints.operations and public information ensures departmental compliance with state and national accreditation standards and city public information procedures. oversees daily department operations, including preparing and distributing information, responding to media and citizen inquiries, and coordinating information releases with departmental units. provides on-scene public information support during major and minor police events of community concern. monitors media coverage, digital conversations, social media trends, public sentiment, and emerging issues to identify opportunities, mitigate misinformation, and inform communication strategy.executive communications support serves as executive communications advisor to the chief of police and command staff. develops speeches, presentations, correspondence, talking points, reports, opinion pieces, video messages, and other executive-level communications. provides media coaching to department leadership and manages requests for leadership participation in public appearances, productions, and community events.program evaluation and continuous improvement assesses communication program effectiveness through analytics, media monitoring, audience engagement, and performance metrics. uses data and emerging trends to refine communication strategies and enhance public outreach.qualificationseducation/experiencemaster’s degree in communications, public relations, journalism, marketing, digital media, and two (2) years of progressively responsible experience in local government, program management, communications, or a related field, including supervisory or lead experience.or, bachelor’s degree in communications, public relations, journalism, marketing, digital media, or a related field, and four (4) years of progressively responsible experience in local government, complex program management, communications, or a related field, including supervisory or lead experience.or, any other equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.other requirementsus drivers license and an acceptable driving record.knowledge, skills and abilitiesdemonstrated ability to work effectively with the public, coworkers, and interdepartmental teamsstrong project and program management skills.experience with municipal operations.ability to understand complex instructions and work independently.strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.excellent communication, negotiation, facilitation, and customer-service skills.ability to develop and maintain productive relationships with businesses, community groups, contractors, event organizers, city staff, and regional partners.ability to identify problems, develop solutions, and make recommendations to the department director.ability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays when required by departmental activities.supplemental informationphysical demands office work: primarily sedentary, involving prolonged sitting, computer use, osha regulations, including hazard communication, personal protective equipment, and slip, trip, and fall prevention.working conditionswork is primarily performed in an office environment, with integrated, executive and issues communications. also known in the market as corporate communications manager, integrated communications manager, strategic communications manager or senior communications manager .  about the role  pearson is looking for a strategic and hands-on communications professional to help shape, protect and enhance our reputation. this newly created role will support our virtual learning business while contributing to wider priorities including career readiness, workforce readiness and ai innovation.  you will work across external, internal and executive communications, connecting business activity to pearson’s wider corporate story. success in this role requires strong strategic thinking combined with the ability to personally deliver high-quality communications materials, executive briefings and stakeholder content.  this is an opportunity for someone who enjoys creating structure, bringing stakeholders together and turning complex business activity into clear, engaging and impactful communications.  what you'll do  lead proactive and reactive communications across pr, internal communications, social media, customer communications, public affairs and crisis communications.  develop narratives, messaging frameworks and content aligned to pearson’s corporate priorities and business objectives.  support pearson’s virtual learning investors and senior leaders.  strong b2b communications experience. additional b2b2c or consumer-facing communications experience would be advantageous.  experience supporting executive communications, leadership events, media preparation and thought leadership activity.  experience managing issues, reputation or crisis communications in a complex organisation.  a proactive mindset 4480397461.company: North Carolina Coalition for Alternatives to the Death Penalty

detail.desc: the north carolina coalition for alternatives to the death penalty (nccadp) includes 28 partner organizations and thousands of individuals committed to ending north carolina’s death penalty. we envision a north carolina free from state killing where justice is rooted in racial equity, healing, and addressing harm without perpetuating it. we work with and educate lawmakers, communities, and the public about the racist, unjust and ineffectual death penalty. we advocate for equitable alternatives, rooted in restorative justice, that promote healing and increase public health and safety. we center the voices of people most proximate to the death penalty: homicide survivor family members (including executions) and individuals living on or exonerated from death row and their families. we believe their leadership and stories are key to transforming our system.nccadp has experienced exciting growth and success since 2024 when gov. roy cooper commuted 15 death sentences at the conclusion of a two-year campaign led by the organization. north carolina has not executed anyone in more than 20 years, yet some lawmakers are eager to resume, even in the midst of failed executions in other states. we seek a strong, creative leader and team player to build on this momentum at a critical time for our movement. the ideal candidate will have a passion for criminal justice reform, exceptional communications skills, and at least three years of relevant experience.nccadp strongly encourages applications from people who have direct experience with the carceral state in north carolina, including people who are formerly incarcerated themselves or those who have incarcerated loved ones. we also encourage applications from people who have survived violence, as well as those who have lost loved ones to violence, including homicide and execution. nccadp strives to create a team that reflects our commitment to racial justice and equity; and therefore, we especially seek applications from black and brown people, people with disabilities, and people who identify as lgbtq. the director of communications must live in north carolina and will work remotely, with some travel for in-person events and meetings across the state as required.key responsibilitiesdirect and implement nccadp's communications:serve as primary writer and content strategist across nccadp's communication platforms including social media, email, and website.manage and grow nccadp's email list and optimize email communication, including design of digital newsletters and engagement campaigns.create strategic communications such as petitions, targeted messages, and call to action.liaise with partner organization communications staff to facilitate sharing events and information and deepen engagement from their memberships.develop and implement a digital organizing strategy in collaboration with staff and coalition partners.maintain and update nccadp's wordpress website.draft and distribute press releases and media advisories; maintain and expand press lists; track and share relevant media coverage.design digital and print communications materials, including graphics, event flyers, reports, and campaign toolkits.2. develop and maintain nccadp's databases, including:donors and donor acknowledgement.media outlets.volunteers, coalition members, and partners. 3. support nccadp events and programs:collaborate with staff and volunteers on planning and promotion of in-person and virtual events.represent nccadp at community events and coalition gatherings.4. serve as an active and collaborative member of a small, high-functioning  team:take initiative to strengthen organizational systems and offer support across program areas when needed.contribute to long-term strategic planning, infrastructure development, and sustainability planning.may include onboarding and supervising interns and volunteers supporting communications, research, and outreach indicatives as needed.qualifications and experience significant previous experience developing and executing communications strategies and ability to shape narratives that drive social change including strong storytelling, research, writing, and editing skills. preferably with an advocacy or social justice-oriented organization.previous experience managing a crm and using digital organizing strategies, including social media platforms.personal commitment to nccadp’s mission to end the death penalty and to nccadp’s core values of racial justice, centering the voices of people most proximate to the death penalty, and restorative justice. strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.self-motivated and ability to meet deadlines.exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to work collaboratively with staff, volunteers, and interns.proficient with computer and office software, social media, and basic graphic design.ability to photograph or video events.familiarity with the death penalty landscape, the criminal legal system, the decarceration movement, and north carolina political dynamics is a plus.hours and compensation: this is a remote, full-time position (37.5 hrs/wk) with traditional daytime hours and occasional evening or weekend hours. it will also require occasional in-person meetings and events, sometimes in different areas of the state. we highly value a “can-do” attitude, and we also strive to support our staff in their work-life balance through our benefits package and positive, passionate work environment.annual salary is $64,000.15 paid holidays in addition to a total of 22 days combined paid time off and health care leave.health care stipend and retirement benefit (total $11,120 annually) and reimbursement for travel and some home-office expenses.salary and benefits with pro-rated paid leave will commence upon hire. the position also includes a three-month probationary period. to applyplease complete our initial application : https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1faipqlscoxsva4vmid6gae5f1jew7acvdtbhac7dvvitmd3us5qcmqq/viewform?usp=header , which includes a request for a writing sample and resume.this position will be open until filled and applications reviewed on a rolling basis; those interested are encouraged to apply immediately.

automation platform.experience integrating a marketing automation platform with a crm, including lead management, lead scoring, and bi-directional data sync.hands-on experience with email deliverability, including domain authentication (spf, dkim, dmarc) and ip warming.experience running automation for two brands in one instance.a track record of running marketing operations work segmentation inside a marketing automation platform.experience with customer.io, salesforce marketing cloud, or braze.experience with customer data platforms such as amperity.experience with email testing tools, google analytics, and bi tools such as tableau.experience in sports or live events is a plus given the fast-paced, matchday-driven environment.competencies, knowledge, skills and ability to interface with attorneys and all other levels within the firm.  planning and organizational skills.  budget creation, management and innovation in maximizing the use of funds.  interest in organization- hyatt corporate officesummarythe opportunityhyatt hotels corporation is looking for an innovative director of social media & content to join our global marketing team to lead and transform social for one of hospitality’s most loved loyalty programs. this director will lead hyatt's global social media strategy, operations, and evolution for world of hyatt. social is one of the most important ways guests discover brands, share experiences, and decide where to travel. this role will define how world of hyatt shows up in culture, earns attention, builds community, and turns social engagement into brand affinity, consideration, loyalty, and business results. you will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.who we areat hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.as we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: people. we turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.why now?this is an exciting time to be at hyatt. we are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. the hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and hyatt is no exception.how we care for our peoplewhat sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the hyatt family. our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. we’re proud to have earned a place on fortune’s prestigious  100 best companies to work for®  list since 2013. this recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.we’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include: annual allotment of free hotel stays at hyatt hotels globally flexible work schedule work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center a global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption paid time off, medical, dental, vision, 401k with company matchwho you areas our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of empathy, inclusion, integrity, experimentation, respect, and wellbeing. you enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.the rolethis is a build-and-evolve leadership role for a social-native strategist with a strong point of view on what makes content worth watching, sharing, and remembering. the ideal candidate has demonstrated the ability to grow meaningful engagement, build audiences, and create a creator and influencer network from the ground up. they will bring a practical, forward-looking perspective on changing platforms, formats, technologies, and audience behaviors - and turn that perspective into action.the director will lead a team of social professionals and agency partners while working closely with brand and regional teams, media, communications, digital, customer care, marketing, hotel, product, and other partners globally. this role will set the quality bar for world of hyatt's social presence and create the clarity, operating model, and momentum that allow teams to move quickly, test intelligently, learn across channels and build cultural relevance.how you will make an impact:own and continually evolve hyatt's global social media strategy for world of hyatt, aligning business priorities, brand objectives, audience needs, and evolving technologies.set a clear point of view for how world of hyatt can use social to strengthen brand relevance, deepen guest relationships, grow communities, and support commercial objectives.lead strategies that grow meaningful engagement, audience communities, content effectiveness, and loyalty across priority social platforms. build on what is working, challenge what is not, and create a culture of testing, iteration and innovation.build and scale a creator and influencer network from the foundation up, including recruitment, relationship development, program mechanics, briefings, contracts, content frameworks, partner with media on affiliate or incentive structures where appropriate, measurement, and long-term program growth.own the social-native content strategy across formats including short-form video, creator-led storytelling, community content, live experiences, guest and user-generated content, and platform-native series. understand what belongs in each format and share learnings across channels to maximize reach, efficiency, and impact.set the quality bar for world of hyatt's social content and partner with brand, communications, and creative teams to ensure the work reflects hyatt's purpose, brand identities, destinations, hotels, and guest experience while remaining distinctive and culturally relevant.create the operating model, processes, governance, tools, and standards required to activate social effectively across global, regional, and hotel teams. establish a center of excellence that helps colleagues create better work and move with confidence.serve as hyatt's primary social media subject matter expert, providing strategic guidance, education, playbooks, and best practices to colleagues and hotel teams. help the organization stay current as platforms, creator norms, consumer behaviors, and disclosure expectations evolve.oversee real-time engagement, community management, social care, listening, and reputation management in partnership with customer care, communications, and regional teams. understand how to turn people who already love hyatt into active participants and advocates.establish and maintain a comprehensive social measurement framework, including benchmarks and kpis for reach, audience growth, engagement quality, video performance, creator impact, sentiment, traffic, conversion, and business contribution. make clear what is working, why it is working, and where to invest next.lead the evaluation and adoption of emerging platforms, technologies, formats, and tools - including ai-enabled capabilities where they can improve speed or quality - and make informed recommendations about where hyatt should test, invest, or scale.partner with media, digital, brand, and agency teams on paid social activation and integrated campaigns. know when to seed content organically, when to amplify it, and how to adapt it for audiences and channels further up the consideration funnel.manage the social media budget, agency relationships, technology partners, and other external vendors . qualificationsexperience required:10+ years of experience in social media, digital marketing, content, communications, or a related field, with substantial experience leading social strategy and operations for a consumer-facing brand or business.5+ years of people leadership experience, including experience leading managers, hiring and developing talent and building high-performing teams.a demonstrated record of growing meaningful social engagement and audience communities. you can show the work, explain the choices behind it, and connect performance to business or brand outcomes.proven experience building and scaling a creator, influencer, ambassador, affiliate, or user-generated-content program - ideally from close to zero - including recruitment, relationships, program structure, content frameworks, and measurement.deep knowledge of major global social platforms and the craft of social-native video. you understand why a short-form social series and a brand film require different creative disciplines, and you know how to lead both without flattening either.a defensible point of view on what makes content good, culturally relevant, and worth sharing, along with the creative judgment to set a high quality bar across formats.a point of view on content strategy leveraging existing assets, ugc, and creating new content to maximize budget and engagementan outcome-driven approach to measurement. you have built kpi frameworks, dashboards, benchmarks, and testing plans where they did not yet exist, and you know how to distinguish attention from meaningful engagement and business impact.a track record of turning audience insights, cultural trends, and platform changes into innovative, practical strategies. you move at the speed of culture and product, with the judgment to protect the brand while experimenting.the position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.we welcome you:research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? apply. we’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make hyatt even better.the salary range for this position is $142,500 - $190,000the final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate. we value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.
