detail.desc: to get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.job categorymarketing & communicationsjob detailsabout salesforcesalesforce is the #1 ai crm, where humans with agents drive customer success together. here, ambition meets action. tech meets trust. and innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. the world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through ai, driving innovation, and keeping salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? you’re in the right place! agentforce is the future of ai, and you are the future of salesforce.slack needs a content lead who can connect the dots: from what we say, to how it shows up across digital touchpoints (on the web, in campaigns, on social, and more), to whether it’s actually working. this role is that connective tissue.as senior manager, content & digital presence, you’ll research, write, and develop slack’s thought leadership content: the articles, reports, and narratives that shape how the market thinks about the future of work. you’ll also hold the editorial framework across our digital presence, ensuring narrative cohesion from the blog to the website to campaign content. you’ll report to the director of content strategy and work closely with pmm, seo, design, brand, and demand gen to fuel integrated marketing motions and ensure gtm moments land with the right content behind them.the best candidate is an exceptional storyteller who can translate complex strategic narratives into content that resonates across audiences, travels across formats and channels, and makes even the most complex launches feel clear and connected.what you’ll doresearch, write, and develop thought leadership and digital content that reinforces slack’s most critical narrativesmanage the editorial calendar: prioritize topics, map content to gtm moments and tier 1 launches, and keep output consistent across formatshold narrative cohesion across digital touchpoints, including the blog, website, campaign content, and socialown editorial quality and content standards across slack’s digital channels, including slack.com and salesforce.com/slackreview copy before it goes live to keep it accurate, on tone, and on messagepartner with pmm to turn approved product positioning into content that resonates with target audienceswork with seo/aeo partners so content is built to be found and establishes slack as an authoritative voicebring an editorial lens to website decisions such as navigation and content prioritiesbuild and manage ai-enabled workflows for research, drafting, content auditing, and performance trackingtrack what’s working and use performance signals to sharpen content over timewhat you bring6+ years of content strategy, editorial, or thought leadership experience at a b2b saas companya strong writer with a portfolio of content that moves markets, not just fills calendarseditorial judgment: you know what slack should and shouldn’t be saying, and you can defend itexperience mapping content to gtm strategy and integrated marketing motions across web, campaigns, and socialcomfort working across seo, design, and campaign teams without needing a translatorcomfort with ai tools as an accelerant, including knowing when to trust the output and when to override itthe ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines in a fast-moving launch environmentpreferredexperience with executive or ghostwritten contentfamiliarity with analytics and content performance toolsexperience working with freelancers or agencieswhy this rolethis role sits where narrative, digital, and gtm meet. if you’re a writer and editor who wants to shape how slack sounds everywhere it shows up, this is it.unleash your potentialwhen you join salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our ai agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. together, we’ll bring the power of agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for ai, and the world.accommodationsif you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this accommodations request form.please note that salesforce uses artificial intelligence (ai) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. please see our candidate privacy statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of ai tools and opt out options.posting statementsalesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. what does that mean exactly? it means that at salesforce, we believe in equality for all. and we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. this policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their salesforce employment journey. it also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at salesforce are fair and based on merit. the same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.in the united states, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. more details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.at salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions. the typical base salary range for this position is $143,400 - $216,900 annually. the range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

detail.desc: job title - lead specialist, corporate communications  description  shape pearson’s story across virtual learning and enterprise priorities in a strategic, hands-on role spanning integrated, executive and issues communications. also known in the market as corporate communications manager, integrated communications manager, strategic communications manager or senior communications manager .  about the role  pearson is looking for a strategic and hands-on communications professional to help shape, protect and enhance our reputation. this newly created role will support our virtual learning business while contributing to wider priorities including career readiness, workforce readiness and ai innovation.  you will work across external, internal and executive communications, connecting business activity to pearson’s wider corporate story. success in this role requires strong strategic thinking combined with the ability to personally deliver high-quality communications materials, executive briefings and stakeholder content.  this is an opportunity for someone who enjoys creating structure, bringing stakeholders together and turning complex business activity into clear, engaging and impactful communications.  what you'll do  lead proactive and reactive communications across pr, internal communications, social media, customer communications, public affairs and crisis communications.  develop narratives, messaging frameworks and content aligned to pearson’s corporate priorities and business objectives.  support pearson’s virtual learning business while connecting activity to wider themes including career readiness, workforce readiness and ai innovation.  partner proactively with stakeholders across marketing, product, sales, media relations, government relations, hr and corporate communications.  identify upcoming launches, conferences, campaigns, opportunities and potential reputational risks, ensuring the right teams are aligned and informed.  prepare senior leaders for media opportunities, events, presentations and all-hands meetings through briefing memos, talk tracks, presentations and supporting communications materials.  provide communications support for executive leadership communications, including presentations, internal messaging and executive social content.  manage issues and crisis communications planning and response activities.  monitor media, stakeholder sentiment and reputational risks, using insight to inform communications strategies and recommendations.  produce polished, executive-ready materials in microsoft word and powerpoint with a consistently high attention to detail.  what we're looking for  broad experience across corporate, strategic or integrated communications rather than a single-channel communications specialism.  proven ability to balance strategic communications planning with hands-on execution.  strong narrative development skills and experience adapting key messages for multiple audiences while maintaining message consistency.  experience working across multiple stakeholder groups, including customers, employees, policymakers, investors and senior leaders.  strong b2b communications experience. additional b2b2c or consumer-facing communications experience would be advantageous.  experience supporting executive communications, leadership events, media preparation and thought leadership activity.  experience managing issues, reputation or crisis communications in a complex organisation.  a proactive mindset with the ability to identify opportunities, connect stakeholders and drive activity forward without waiting for a detailed brief.  excellent writing, editing and storytelling skills, with exceptional attention to detail.  strong microsoft word and powerpoint capabilities.  practical awareness of ai in communications, seo, aeo, geo and the strategic use of social media.  particularly attractive backgrounds  education, higher education, edtech or other regulated industries.  corporate communications experience within consulting or professional services organisations such as accenture, mckinsey, bcg or similar firms.  public affairs, government relations or reputation management experience.  location & working pattern  united states | remote  the successful candidate will support pearson’s north america business while collaborating across a global organisation. flexible working arrangements will apply in line with pearson policy and business requirements.  salary  compensation at pearson is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. as required by the california, colorado, hawaii, illinois, maryland, minnesota, new jersey, new york state, new york city, vermont, washington state, and washington dc laws, the pay range for this position is as follows: the minimum full-time salary range is between $75,000 - $115,000. this position is eligible to participate in an annual incentive program, and information on benefits offered is here. applications will be accepted through september 13th 2026. this window may be extended depending on business needs.  why join pearson?  this is a rare opportunity to help shape communications across one of the world's leading learning companies. you'll work at the intersection of education, workforce readiness and ai innovation, partnering with senior leaders to tell compelling stories that influence customers, employees, policymakers and stakeholders globally.  if you enjoy turning complex business priorities into clear communications, building relationships across teams and delivering work that genuinely makes an impact, we'd love to hear from you.    who we are:  at pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. we believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. we are the world's lifelong learning company. for us, learning isn't just what we do. it's who we are. to learn more: we are pearson.  pearson is an equal opportunity employer and a member of e-verify. employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. we actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under vevraa and section 503 of the rehabilitation act.  if you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing talentexperienceglobalteam@grp.pearson.com.  job: corporate communications  job family: enterprise  organization: corporate marketing & communications  schedule: full_time  workplace type: remote  req id: 25656  #location

we have an exciting opportunity for a public relations manager at eversheds sutherland (us) llp. we are searching for someone who wants to be a valued contributor and member of a talented and dynamic team of lawyers, paralegals and business professionals.the public relations manager plays a central role in building and amplifying the eversheds sutherland brand across the us marketplace. working alongside a peer pr manager and in close partnership with the us director of communications and brand, this role leads the development and execution of integrated public relations strategies across all us offices, practice groups, and attorneys.this is a role for a strategic communicator — someone who brings their own point of view, connects pr activity to measurable business outcomes, and proactively shapes the firm’s narrative rather than simply responding to requests. the ideal candidate knows how to build strong, trusted relationships with attorneys while also managing expectations with confidence and directing effort toward the priorities that matter most to the firm.equally important is how this person operates as part of a team. this role requires close, ongoing collaboration with the peer pr manager, the business development and client services teams, and firm leadership — and success depends on the ability to balance competing demands, communicate transparently, and put the team’s goals ahead of individual priorities. strong organizational skills and a disciplined approach to managing multiple workstreams are essential.the ideal candidate brings genuine pr instincts, a strategic understanding of how ai is reshaping media and communications, and the presence to earn credibility across the organization. experience managing others — whether staff, freelancers, or agency partners — is preferred, and the ability to do so will be an expectation as the team grows.responsibilities and duties: strategy & prioritizationdevelop and own a proactive us pr strategy — identifying story opportunities, setting priorities, and aligning pr activity to the firm’s business objectives, not just attorney requests.bring a clear point of view on where to invest time and resources, balancing individual attorney asks against broader firm and practice group priorities.maintain rigorous project management across multiple simultaneous workstreams, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks and stakeholders are kept informed.build and maintain systems and workflows that create accountability, visibility, and consistency across the pr function.attorney relations & media executionproactively identify and pursue media opportunities at the regional, national, and global level to elevate eversheds sutherland’s profile across key practice groups and industry sectors.execute day-to-day pr activities including pitching and placing bylined articles and stories, preparing attorneys for media interviews, drafting and distributing press releases, and securing speaking engagements for attorneys.build trusted relationships with attorneys while confidently managing expectations — advising on what’s realistic, setting clear timelines, and redirecting effort toward the firm’s highest-priority opportunities.cultivate and maintain strong relationships with editors, reporters, and journalists across regional and national markets.partner with the international pr team to identify cross-border media opportunities and ensure consistent global messaging.thought leadership & executive visibilitydevelop and implement thought leadership strategies that position key attorneys and firm leaders as go-to voices in their areas of expertise.collaborate with attorneys and business development professionals to shape compelling narratives around practice group strengths, client wins, and industry trends.digital & social mediasupport and help drive social media strategies that amplify attorney profiles, practice area content, and firm news.contribute to content planning across digital channels, ensuring pr efforts are integrated with broader digital communications.ai & evolving media landscapebring a strategic understanding of how ai is reshaping media, journalism, and communications — and apply that perspective to how the firm tells its story.leverage ai-enabled tools to improve efficiency, enhance content quality, and inform media strategy. curiosity and a willingness to experiment are just as valued as existing fluency.awards, measurement & operationshelp manage and implement a comprehensive awards strategy covering individual attorney recognitions and firm-level submissions.help maintain the us public relations media database and coverage tracking.evaluate and report on the effectiveness of pr efforts, translating results into actionable insights for leadership.establish and refine processes and workflows to enhance team productivity and streamline operations.collaboration & leadershippartner closely with the business development and client development teams to understand practice areas and support strategic plans.manage external agencies, freelancers, or consultants as needed; as the team grows, this role is expected to take on direct management responsibilities.support additional projects and initiatives as directed by the us director of communications and brand.knowledge, skills and abilities:education:bachelor’s degree required from an accredited college or university; preferred concentration in public relations, communications, journalism, marketing, or a related field.experience:a minimum of five years of public relations or related experience in a professional services environment. law firm or professional services experience preferred; agency background is equally welcome. some global or international exposure is a plus. experience managing staff, freelancers, or agencies is preferred; candidates without prior direct management experience but with a clear readiness to grow into that responsibility will also be considered.skills:strong media relations instincts with a proven track record of placements. exceptional written and verbal communication skills. ability to distill complex legal topics into compelling narratives. strategic thinker who proactively identifies opportunities and connects pr activity to business outcomes — not just executes requests. highly organized with demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, set expectations, and deliver across simultaneous workstreams. comfortable advising and pushing back on attorneys when appropriate, while maintaining strong working relationships. proven collaborator who works well across functions and puts team goals first. strong executive presence and comfort working directly with firm leadership. experience with social media strategy and digital communications. familiarity with ai tools for communications or content — or a demonstrated curiosity and commitment to developing that fluency. proficient in microsoft office and outlook.ai & emerging tools:strategic awareness of how ai is reshaping media, journalism, and the communications industry is important to this role. comfort using ai-powered tools (for research, drafting, media analysis, etc.) is valued; candidates who are actively experimenting and learning in this space are encouraged to apply.this is a hybrid role and will require on-site presence 3 days per week. the salary ranges for this position vary depending on the geographic location and other factors such as experience, internal equity, market data, and job-related considerations. the range for this position is from $95,000 - $140,000, with offers contingent upon the various factors. the firm’s compensation strategy includes not just a base salary but also comprehensive benefits such as healthcare, paid time off, discretionary merit bonuses, life and disability insurance, retirement plans and tailored learning opportunities.eversheds sutherland (us) llp is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion within our firm and in the larger legal profession. we believe that diverse skills, knowledge and viewpoints make us a stronger firm. eversheds sutherland (us) llp maintains a policy of affording all employees and applicants equal employment opportunities without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender (including gender identity or expression or transgender status), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital or familial status, domestic violence victim status, ancestry, amnesty, citizenship status, ethnicity, military and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. unlawful discrimination, harassment and retaliation will not be tolerated in any of the firm’s offices or any other work-related setting. qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation in order to apply for a position or to enable them to perform the essential functions of a position for which they are otherwise qualified. eeo.

detail.industry: Public Relations and Communications Services, Higher Education, and Engineering Services
detail.desc: position summarysdsu is seeking a college of engineering media relations officer with experience in media relations and journalistic science writing — identifying newsworthy research and translating complex findings into clear, accurate, and engaging stories for general audiences. to help tell the stories emerging from the university’s research enterprise, with a particular focus on the college of engineering, the media relations officer will help tell the stories emerging from the university’s research enterprise. under the direction of the senior director of media relations and deputy chief communications officer, work directly with researchers, faculty, university leaders, reporters, and fellow communicators to translate complex ideas into compelling stories and help those stories reach audiences locally, nationally, and internationally.this is a hands-on communications role with plenty of variety. one day, you may be interviewing a researcher, writing about a new discovery and pitching the story to national media; another, you may be developing a communications plan as part of a college-wide initiative, preparing a faculty member for an interview, responding to a media inquiry, or creating multimedia and social media content. you will also monitor news and online conversations, assess emerging issues and reputational risks, and recommend messaging and communications strategies.what you’ll do:research storytelling & contentfind compelling stories across sdsu’s research enterprise, particularly in engineering, science, and technology.translate complex research into clear, engaging stories for sdsu newscenter, sdsu magazine, websites, social media, external media pitching, and other channels.develop multimedia and short-form content that expands the reach of research stories.media relationsdevelop targeted pitches, news releases, media advisories, and communications plans.build relationships with regional, national, and international reporters and identify opportunities to connect sdsu experts with the news.coordinate interviews and prepare faculty and staff for media engagement.respond to media inquiries and develop recommended messaging and statements.college of engineering communicationsserve as a key communications partner to college of engineering faculty and leadership.identify stories, develop communications strategies, and coordinate media relations, editorial, and social media efforts.develop the college of engineering newslettercollaborate across stratcomm and with campus communications partners to keep messaging aligned.issues & emerging communicationsmonitor news and social media for emerging issues, misinformation, and reputational concerns.draft holding statements, faqs, reactive messaging, and communications recommendations.balance proactive storytelling with the real-time communications needs of a large public research university.what we’re looking for:we’re looking for an experienced communicator who can move comfortably between journalistic science writing, media relations and strategic communications. you should be able to interview researchers and translate complex scientific and technical information into clear, accurate and compelling stories for general audiences. this is not a grant writing or technical writing role. you should be able to make complicated subjects accessible, recognize a strong story, build relationships with reporters, manage competing priorities, and exercise good judgment when issues move quickly.above all, this role is for someone who is curious enough to dig into a complicated subject, confident enough to ask the follow-up question, and adaptable enough to switch gears when the story changes.as part of the california state university (csu) system, san diego state university helps power one of the largest and most impactful public university systems in the nation. see what it’s like to work at the csu—watch our video and imagine your future here: working at the csu.position informationthis is a full-time (1.0 time-base), benefits eligible, permanent/probationary position. this position is designated as exempt under flsa and is not eligible for overtime compensation. standard sdsu work hours are monday – friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., but may vary based on operational needs. the position is approved for partial telecommuting with onsite work at the san diego campus on monday and wednesday. please note that the incumbent will be called to campus on telecommuting days to support campus activities as needed.department summarysan diego state university (sdsu) is a leading public research university within the california state university system, serving more than 46,000 students. sdsu is recognized for its academic excellence, research, innovation, global engagement, and commitment to student success.the president serves as the university’s chief executive officer, providing leadership for sdsu’s academic mission, operations, and strategic priorities. the office of the president supports the president in carrying out these executive responsibilities and advancing the university’s goals.strategic communications and public affairs (stratcomm) serves as the official voice of sdsu, sharing the president’s vision, values, and priorities and telling the university’s story to campus and external audiences. stratcomm leads communications across marketing, media relations, social media, web and digital communications, executive and internal communications, crisis and issues management, visual communications, and government and community relations. the department also manages and protects the sdsu brand and works with partners across the university to highlight sdsu’s programs, achievements, and impact.for more information regarding the strategic communications and public affairs (stratcomm) department, click here.education and experienceequivalent to a bachelor’s degree in a related field and four years of relevant experience. additional experience which demonstrates acquired and successfully applied knowledge and abilities shown above may be substituted for the required education on a year-for-year basis. an advanced degree in a related field may be substituted for the required experience on a year-for-year basis.key qualificationsdemonstrated experience in strategic communications, media relations, and science or research communications, preferably within a large organization.exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex scientific, engineering, and technical information into clear, compelling content for broad audiences.proven success developing media strategies, building relationships with reporters, and securing earned media coverage at the regional, national, or international level.experience advising executives, faculty, researchers, or subject-matter experts on media engagement, strategic messaging, issues management, and reputational considerations.ability to develop and execute integrated communications across earned media, digital, social, editorial, and multimedia channels.demonstrated ability to independently manage complex, cross-functional communications projects, balance competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders.experience using media analytics, audience insights, and performance data to evaluate communications efforts and inform strategy.strong knowledge of communications and editorial best practices, including ap style.preferred qualifications:experience supporting science, research, engineering, or technology communications within higher education, a research institution, public agency, or similarly complex organization.knowledge of higher education communications and the research environment, particularly within a public research university.professional proficiency in spanish is desirable.licenses/certifications requiredvalid california driver’s license or the ability to obtain one within 30 days of hire.compensation and benefitssan diego state university offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and professional growth.compensation:step placement will be determined based on relevant qualifications and professional experience, in alignment with the department’s budget and equity guidelines.initial step placement is not expected to exceed step 1 ($5,877/month).salary step placement for internal applicants will follow the csueu collective bargaining agreement.csu classification salary range: $5,877-$8,561 per month (step 1-step 20).future increases, including step advancements, are subject to contract negotiations.full benefits package includes:generous time off: 15 paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave.retirement: calpers pension plan with retiree healthcare, and reciprocal agreements with other california public retirement systems, including the uc.health coverage: medical, dental, and vision options at low or no cost.education support: csu tuition fee waiver descriptionabout us: born in artistry, built for real life, and fueled by a global community, morphe delivers high-performance, high-design beauty without the prestige price tag. leveraging exceptional product development, regulatory, and supply chain capabilities, we make innovative products that invite creativity and celebrate the freedom to look how you want, when you want. join us in shaping what’s next in beauty.principle accountabilitiesbrand strategy & product innovation support the development and execution of product pipeline strategies in partnership with brand leadership, sales channel leads, and product development, leveraging marketplace trends, consumer insights, competitive intelligence, and creator feedback. identify and evaluate subcategory and product opportunities to support growth objectives, including assessing global sales potential, assortment needs, shade ranges, product features, and consumer benefits. support franchise and subcategory strategies to strengthen hero products, optimize global assortments, and drive long-term category growth. partner with cross-functional teams to develop and maintain global product assortments, ensuring alignment with brand positioning, consumer needs, and commercial objectives.product marketing & launch execution lead the development of comprehensive product launch briefs in collaboration with product development, copy, and creative teams, defining product positioning, key differentiators, features and benefits, pricing across global markets, and launch asset requirements. communicate product launch strategies, priorities, and deliverables across cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and executional excellence. brief internal creative teams and external agencies on marketing and campaign needs, overseeing the development and timely delivery of global assets across digital, retail, and wholesale channels. partner with visual merchandising and creative teams to translate product positioning, launch strategies, and key messaging into compelling in-store experiences. serve as a key cross-functional partner throughout the product launch process, proactively identifying risks, resolving challenges, and ensuring alignment across product development, creative, visual merchandising, sales, and marketing teams.business performance & market analysis monitor product, franchise, and category performance, identifying wins, risks, and growth opportunities. partner with cross-functional teams during monthly business reviews to evaluate performance against targets and recommend actionable next steps. develop and analyze sales reporting for key business initiatives, including product launches, marketing campaigns, and promotional events, to assess performance and inform future strategies. conduct global competitive pricing analyses to inform product positioning, pricing recommendations, and market competitiveness. support ad hoc business initiatives and analyses, including financial planning, marketing strategy, event planning, and consumer and competitive research.team management & development manage and mentor a senior specialist, providing clear direction, prioritization, project oversight, and ongoing coaching to support individual development and team objectives. delegate responsibilities effectively, provide constructive feedback, and foster accountability, collaboration, and professional growth.#morpherequirementsrequired skills & experience bachelor's degree required; mba a plus. 2–3 years of experience in brand management or product marketing required, preferably within the beauty or consumer products industry. strong understanding of beauty industry trends, consumer behavior, competitive landscape, and retail dynamics. strong commercial acumen, with the ability to analyze sales performance, interpret data, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations. demonstrated ability to develop compelling product positioning, consumer-facing messaging, and marketing strategies. excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain a high standard of execution. excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to different audiences and organizational levels. ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. strong relationship-building and influencing skills, with the ability to drive alignment and results across cross-functional teams. experience managing or mentoring junior team members preferred.physical requirementsmust be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, in accordance with applicable laws and workplace safety requirements.additional informationforma brands takes a market-based approach to pay, and amounts will vary depending on your geographic location. the salary range reflected here is for positions based in the greater los angeles area. the successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. these ranges may be modified in the future without notice.salary description$107,000 - $125,000

job details:summarythe marketing manager supports brand strategy execution for the identified brand portfolio, translating the senior manager's strategic direction into day-to-day marketing plans, campaigns, and cross-functional deliverables. the core mandate is executional excellence: bringing the brand strategy to life across touchpoints, managing the details that make campaigns and launches successful, and building the analytical and operational foundation that lets the senior manager focus on strategy. this is a strong development role for someone building toward broader brand ownership.this position will sit full time onsite at our world headquarters in springdale, arkansas.key responsibilitiesbrand positioning & strategy: in partnership with the sr. manager, own and evolve the brand strategy for the brand portfolio, including brand purpose, positioning, target consumer definition, and competitive differentiation, in partnership with the business unit gm and team. ensure brand guidelines are understood and consistently applied across teams and agency partners.consumer & insights: synthesize as well as recommend quantitative and qualitative consumer data (segmentation, usage & attitude studies, purchase behavior, social listening) to identify unmet needs and emerging trends; translate findings into clear, actionable insights that inform brand positioning, innovation priorities, and go-to-market strategy; partner with consumer insights teams to design and prioritize research that closes critical knowledge gaps.campaign & program execution: manage the day-to-day execution of marketing campaigns and brand initiatives — timelines, deliverables, approvals, and stakeholder coordination — ensuring on-time, on-brief, on-budget delivery.brand performance tracking: track brand health metrics, market share, and campaign performance against kpis; prepare regular performance reports and highlight areas needing attention.cross-functional leadership: serve as the strategic connective tissue across creative, media, shopper marketing, social, and digital experience to ensure a consistent, on-brand experience across all consumer touchpoints; partner with media agency partners to shape media strategy — channel mix, audience targeting, and investment allocation — ensuring plans align with brand positioning and growth priorities; manage agency relationships (creative, media, and specialist partners) to drive high-quality output, accountability to brief, and efficient use of budget.portfolio & architecture: guide decisions on product portfolio, naming, and brand architecture within the category space to maintain a coherent brand system.innovation partnership: provide strategic brand input into new product development, ensuring launches are grounded in consumer need and brand equity.marketing plan development: build annual brand plans, including objectives, strategies, budget allocation, and success metrics, in partnership with the sr. director and the business unit gms and their teams.budget management: support disciplined, ongoing stewardship of the marketing budget in partnership with the sr manager and gms (p&l owners) — including annual planning, in-year reallocation, and roi tracking across media, innovation, and shopper investments; proactively identify efficiency opportunities and reallocate spend toward highest-return initiatives; ensure spend pacing, forecasting accuracy, and variance reporting meet finance and leadership expectations.creative oversight and coordination: help develop and refine creative briefs; coordinate creative reviews and consolidate feedback from stakeholders to keep creative development on track.requirementseducation: bachelor's degree required; mba a plusexperience: 5+ years of progressive brand marketing experience, with demonstrated ownership of brand strategyexperience in cpg, food, or a comparably regulated/retail-driven category preferredstrong analytical skills — comfortable translating data and consumer insight into strategic recommendationstrack record of leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing without direct brand identity system, including visual language, typography, color, illustration, and brand patternsdefine and maintain brand standards that balance consistency with creative flexibility across teams and channelstranslate company strategy and brand vision into clear, compelling visual direction in partnership with leadershipdesign and deliver new brand expressions that advance the identity while proficiency in photoshop, indesign, and illustrator, including high-end compositing, retouching, image finishing, and vector illustration.working knowledge of after effects and premiere pro is a plus; proficiency with figma, powerpoint, or presentations and design documentation.strong conceptual mindset with experience translating ideas into compelling visual narratives, storyboards, and customer-facing experiences.confident presenter who can clearly articulate creative rationale to internal teams and clients while managing project feedback and revisions.manage multiple projects about useupraxia is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing locally delivered, extended-release products that have the potential to address therapeutic areas with high unmet medical need. diffusphere™, a proprietary, polymer-based micro-sphere technology, is designed to facilitate targeted drug delivery of both existing and novel drugs. the technology is designed to support an extended duration of effect and delivery of drugs in a hyper-localized fashion, targeting only the tissues that physicians want to treat. we believe the potential for fewer adverse events may be achieved through the precision targeting and the stable and flat delivery of the active ingredient when using the diffusphere™ technology, versus the peaks and troughs seen with more traditional drug delivery methods. the precision of eupraxia's diffusphere™ technology platform has the potential to augment and transform existing fda-approved drugs to improve their safety, tolerability, efficacy and duration of effect. the potential uses in therapeutic areas may go beyond pain and inflammatory gastrointestinal disease, where eupraxia currently is developing advanced treatments, also to be applicable in oncology, infectious disease and other critical disease areas.eupraxia's ep-104gi is currently running both a phase 1b/2a and phase 2b trial, the resolve trials, experience.as a key member of the product development and merchandising team, you will champion product creativity that not only excites and engages our consumers but also delivers strong sales radically improving how people manage car ownership, one of their most expensive and time-consuming assets. backed by artificial intelligence and machine learning, jerry simplifies and automates car million customers — and we're just getting started.we're looking for a senior creative strategist with sharp performance instincts and elevated visual taste. someone who’s obsessed with advertising, creative production — ideally at a performance media agency and/or an in-house growth creative team at a dtc or app-based company.proven track record producing or directing high-performing creative years of experience in brand management, product marketing, publishing, or equivalent roles, agency or in-house.experience delivering integrated go-to-market campaigns from strategy through execution in fast-moving environments.strong cross-functional leadership skills, with a track record of aligning multiple teams and stakeholders around shared goals.exceptional organizational and project global publishing models and working with regional or international partners.experience or passion for the games industry, entertainment, or youth-culture-driven brands.for this role, you will find success through collaboration, operational excellence, and a deep commitment to delivering great player experiences. if you are energized by launching something new, aligning teams around bold customize, collect, and show off. as we grow into a lifestyle brand, design is the thread that connects function and self-expression across every product, every drop, and every partnership. we care 3d skills. experience working with licensed or partner ip (collabs, brand partnerships). familiarity with designing for retail and dtc/e-commerce. how we workwe're a small, fast-moving team that detail.desc: citi wealth is seeking an exceptional senior investments content strategist to join the content & client engagement team — a senior, strategic role at the intersection of investment expertise, multi-format content production, and client communication.this is not a support role. you are a recognised authority in investments content strategy — someone who brings deep knowledge of the wealth management investment landscape, a sophisticated understanding of how complex financial strategies are positioned and communicated across formats, and the credibility to operate at the most senior levels of a large, global organisation. you follow the latest developments in your field closely and adapt them with speed and intelligence to the demands of the business.your remit spans the full breadth of citi wealth's investment product portfolio — from equities and fixed income to multi-asset strategies and alternative investments. you are not a specialist in one asset class or one content format. you are the person who understands how a sophisticated investment idea needs to be expressed differently depending on whether it is a whitepaper for an institutional advisor, a short-form video for a digital channel, a panel discussion at a marquee client conference, or a monthly fact sheet for a relationship manager's client meeting. you move between those formats with fluency and with consistently high standards.you will partner with senior members of citi wealth's global and regional marketing and investment leadership to develop integrated content strategies that bring the firm's investment capabilities to life — across written, video, audio, event, and digital formats. you will be the connective tissue between investment teams, product, legal, compliance, and the broader content function — ensuring that citi wealth's investment value proposition is communicated with clarity, precision, and genuine differentiation.you operate with the same dual metabolism that defines the best investment content professionals: responsive and fast when markets move and opportunities arise; meticulous and considered when developing the flagship collateral, capability narratives, and quarterly programs that form the backbone of citi wealth's client communications calendar. you understand that in a regulated financial environment, every word — and every frame — carries weight.responsibilities:content strategy & integrated campaign developmentpartner with senior members of citi wealth's global marketing and regional marketing leads to seek out and develop integrated content strategies and campaigns in alignment with agreed business and marketing plans — across the full spectrum of citi wealth's investment product portfolio.bring a strategic, audience-first perspective to every brief — ensuring that investment content is grounded in a clear understanding of client needs, competitive positioning, and the prevailing investment landscape.stay closely attuned to the latest trends in investment content strategy, wealth management communication, and financial services storytelling — actively adapting best practices for application within citi wealth's global content program.contribute to strategic planning processes — bringing strong analytic acumen and a results-driven orientation to how priorities are set, resources are allocated, and performance is evaluated.capabilities messaging & investment value propositiondrive the development of clear, compelling capabilities messaging that articulates citi wealth's investment offerings and overall investment management value proposition — with the precision and authority that sophisticated clients and their advisors demand.ensure that investment messaging is consistently differentiated, intellectually rigorous, and aligned with the firm's broader brand and communications standards — across all formats and all markets.develop and maintain a deep understanding of citi wealth's investment strategies across asset classes — equities, fixed income, multi-asset, and alternatives — and translate that understanding into content that is accurate, engaging, and compliant across written, visual, audio, and experiential formats.multi-format content productionlead the development of client-facing and educational content across the full format spectrum — written collateral including whitepapers, brochures, capability overviews, fact sheets, and sales decks; video content including investment outlooks, expert interviews, explainer series, and social edits; audio content including podcasts and recorded commentaries; and event and experiential content including panel programmes, conference presentations, and client experience activations.work closely with citi wealth's investment teams, product, legal, compliance, and the broader content and production team — including editors, cinematographers, and designers — to ensure all output is technically accurate, appropriately approved, and produced to the highest standard across every format.bring the same editorial rigor and audience intelligence to a two-page at a glance as to a flagship long-form video series or a keynote conference program — understanding that quality and clarity are non-negotiable at every scale.understand the specific demands of each format — what a podcast requires that a whitepaper does not; what a live event demands that a social edit cannot deliver — and bring genuine content intelligence to how citi wealth's investment stories are matched to the right medium.product launch & program supportmanage global compliance coordination as it relates to citi wealth investment product launches — including training materials, after-sales support content, and ongoing digital channel maintenance.ensure that all product launch content activity is planned, coordinated, and executed with the diligence that a regulated, global financial services environment demands — on time, fully approved, and audit-ready.maintain comprehensive legal and compliance approval records for all content materials — upholding the highest standards of process integrity and regulatory accountability.reporting & ongoing program managementmanage the standard reporting process across citi wealth's investment strategies — including portfolio manager commentaries, monthly and detail.desc: overviewat microsoft, we're building a modern, ai-forward marketing organization that learns faster, activates smarter, and drives measurable impact. we blend human creativity with ai-powered systems to build a bold, coherent brand at scale, prioritizing outcomes over outputs and uniting disciplines around the customer. microsoft's commercial brand is one of our most valuable assets, and this role helps ensure it shows up as a competitive advantage that customers experience at every touchpoint.the director of commercial brand management & systems owns microsoft's commercial brand as a living, scalable system — building and operating the ai-enabled tooling, content systems, and governance that apply the brand consistently, instantly, and at scale across every customer touchpoint. it pairs enduring brand fundamentals with the modern, hands-on skills a fast-moving ai market now demands.this is a hands-on leadership role. you will shape positioning, architecture, and identity, and carry those decisions all the way through to execution, building strong in-house capability and sweating the details of how the brand shows up. the best brand decisions come from the people closest to the business and the product, amplified by ai, and you will lead a team of senior practitioners who work that way.ai is core to how this role operates. you will use ai-enabled tools and workflows to create and govern the brand at scale, freeing human judgment for the highest-value creative and strategic decisions. the work is anchored in customer obsession, using data and insight to understand and shape how the brand is experienced, and judged by practical, measurable outcomes.key outcomes: a commercial brand that stands out as a competitive advantage in market; a brand system that applies consistently and at scale across every touchpoint; faster speed to market; and a high-performing, modern brand team. success is measured by brand attribution and preference, customer comprehension and navigation of the portfolio, speed to market, and the quality and efficiency of the brand system.at microsoft, our mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. with a growth-mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress across people, teams, and customers. join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what is next for everyone.responsibilitiesown the commercial brand as a living system own microsoft's commercial brand end to end — strategy, architecture, identity, and how it shows up in market — owning both the strategy and its implementation. set brand strategy grounded in practice, applying brand fundamentals to a fast-moving ai market and evolving commercial-customer expectations, and translating them into decisions the organization can act on immediately. own the frameworks, standards, and governance that keep the brand coherent as the portfolio and products evolve. partner with creative, content, and customer marketing teams so the brand is expressed consistently across every channel and campaign. build and operate ai-first brand and content systems bring a marketing-engineering mindset: design, build, and operate ai-enabled brand and content systems that apply the brand at scale. own the tooling and automation roadmap for brand governance, content generation, and quality control, applying ai to accelerate production, review, and portfolio analysis. use ai-enabled workflows to govern the brand at scale, reserving human judgment for the highest-value creative and strategic decisions. stand up the data and measurement instrumentation that shows how the brand is experienced and where the system needs to improve. build in-house capability and lead execution own execution end to end, building strong in-house capability and tooling to deliver the work with speed and craft. develop strong internal capability across core brand disciplines — from naming and architecture to content — so the team delivers high-quality work quickly. set a high operating standard for speed and craft, with a team that sweats the details and moves quickly. establish clear quality bars and ways of working, and hold the team to them. put the customer at the center use data and ai-driven insight to understand how commercial customers actually experience the brand across touchpoints, and shape the system accordingly. ensure the brand reflects a fast-evolving product and the real needs of customers. tie brand decisions to measurable customer outcomes — comprehension, navigation of the portfolio, preference, and trust. lead and develop the team lead and develop a team of senior brand practitioners, setting a high bar for craft and growth. champion a hands-on, ai-forward way of working across the team. model an ownership and builder's mindset, raising the bar on craft and hands-on delivery. influence and secure decisions with senior executives across the marketing and commercial organization, representing brand with clear rationale, evidence, and trade-offs. qualificationsrequired qualifications 8+ years work experience at a branding agency or with product marketing, brand building, and/or strategy developmentor equivalent experience. preferred qualifications12+ years of experience leading brand strategy and management for a large, complex technology portfolio, including 10+ years building and leading successful in-market execution. experience building and operating brand, content, or marketing systems at scale, including governance, standards, processes, and tooling that enable consistent brand application globally. hands-on experience applying ai, automation, and emerging technologies to brand, content, and marketing workflows, with the ability to design and scale ai-enabled marketing systems. experience leading brand strategy for enterprise and commercial technology businesses, including areas such as cloud, ai, data, security, or other complex b2b offerings. experience using customer, market, and brand performance insights, including brand equity and tracking research, to guide strategy, prioritize investments, and measure impact. proven ability to build and scale internal brand and content capabilities, reducing reliance on external execution through effective tools, operating models, and organizational development. demonstrated success partnering across creative, product marketing, product, legal, regional marketing, and agency ecosystems to drive brand consistency, localization, and business outcomes at global scale. brand m5 - the typical base pay oversight for naming initiatives across products, solutions, programs, campaigns, events, and other significant branded assets. build acumatica’s brand awareness, consideration, preference, and differentiation among priority audiences and markets. translate company strategy, customer insights, market research, competitive intelligence, and cultural trends into differentiated brand strategies. define and evolve acumatica’s brand positioning, value proposition, personality, and core brand narrative in partnership with product marketing and communications. act as the senior brand develop and own acumatica’s annual and multi-year advertising strategy, including objectives, audiences, channel strategy, investment priorities, experimentation roadmap, and success metrics. define requirements, platform changes, and advertising technologies. brand, creative & messaging:lead the development of distinctive advertising campaigns and brand experiences in partnership with internal industries, segments, personas, channels, and stages of the customer journey. champion customer-centric storytelling grounded in real customer needs, outcomes, and experiences. establish processes communities acumatica serves. provide brand leadership and guidance for high-visibility company initiatives, executive communications, major events, sponsorships, campaigns, and market-facing experiences. measurement & business impact:establish a comprehensive advertising and brand measurement framework connecting investment to brand and business outcomes. define and monitor kpis across advertising effectiveness, investment efficiency, and brand performance. apply appropriate measurement approaches including brand lift studies, experimentation, incrementality testing, attribution, brand performance data into clear insights and recommendations for senior leadership. build a culture of experimentation in which advertising and creative decisions are informed by evidence, learning, title:                               communications manager type:                                full-timelocation:                      1200 jorie boulevard, suite 301, oakbrook, il 60523reports to:                  chief operating officerare you passionate about the health and well-being of illinois’ children? do you desire to amplify stories of organizations and communities dedicated to creating healthier children, healthier futures? come join our dynamic philanthropic team committed to positively impacting the lives of all children.who we areilchf is a dynamic, responsive, learning organization, committed to playing an active role in systems change that will enable every child in illinois to grow up healthy. as illinois’ only private foundation focused solely on the health needs of children across the state, ilchf is uniquely positioned to support communities and organizations committed to improving the health of their children, with a specific focus on children’s oral and mental health. our mission is to cultivate, support, and promote initiatives that improve the health and wellness of children in illinois. as a grantmaking organization, we do that through listening deeply to communities and organizations, building collaborative relationships, maintaining flexibility in our grantmaking approaches, and evaluating and sharing information to enable children to thrive. for additional information about our organization and the organizations we serve, please visit us at www.ilchf.org.position summarythe communications manager will bring a sincere passion for the health and well-being of illinois’ children and families, and a commitment to ensure every child in illinois grows up healthy. under the supervision of the chief operating officer, the communications manager will manage all of ilchf’s communications strategies designed to drive effective and engaging messages through a multimedia lens. the communications manager will amplify community voice, presence, and commitment to healthy children and families. this position will develop best practices for content development and dissemination, lead internal and external communications, ensure brand and messaging alignment, and oversee ilchf’s website and social media presence.in addition, the communications manager will work closely with the entire ilchf team and interact with both potential and current grantee recipients and other stakeholders including funders, research partners, the ilchf board of directors, etc. building and enhancing relationships that heighten the visibility of the impact made through partnerships and advances the mission of illinois children’s healthcare foundation.duties and responsibilitiesstrategy development and brand managementimplement and annually develop a communications plan that identifies strategic priorities, amplifies core messages, and conveys compelling content and stories through a multimedia lens.enhance ilchf’s brand to center grantee partners’ voices across various platforms and engage diverse community audiences.maintain and evolve procedures, guidelines, and other marketing-related processes to ensure brand and messaging alignment internally and externally.assess and evaluate ilchf’s marketing and communication strategies periodically to ensure delivery of results. monitor market trends and interpret results to inform grantmaking and communication strategies.develop awareness and knowledge of inclusive language best practices and principles and implement them consistently across all communications.website & digital communication strategies  ensure ilchf’s website aligns with the organizational priorities, brand, tone, and messaging and is updated accordingly regarding revisions, additions to request for proposals (rfp) descriptions, document links, images, and content reflecting rfp opportunities. design and manage ilchf’s social media plan and presence increasing visibility of the vital work of ilchf’s grantee partners.create communication materials across various channels, including email, web, print, presentations, and social media.gather data from various sources such as website analytics, social media insights and customer relationship management (crm) systems to help inform communications optimizations. public relationscultivate and manage relationships with multimedia contacts, serve as point person for media inquiries, and act on opportunities for earned media. internal & external communicationsassist and collaborate with graphic designer to prepare ilchf’s annual report summarizing key report findings and strategic implications for internal and external audiences. provide copy editing for both internal and external ilchf’s documents, including white papers, articles, research reports and other documents. design event promotional and supporting materials, such as brochures, flyers, agendas, presentations, email campaigns, website content, and social media campaigns to effectively reach target audiences.collaborate and develop all external communications including, not limited to, one-pagers, bi-monthly newsletters, briefs, presentations, closed grants report, grant initiatives reports, press releases, speeches, etc.special project – event coordinationprovide support for a minimum of 3 convenings hosted by or participated in by the foundation, including attending events to capture multimedia content for communication/media outlets.coordinate with the event lead or team to understand key objectives, metrics, content, and timelines. ensure timely and successful execution of communication tactics.capture ilchf’s mission in action through video and photography (still images). other duties as assigned.key skills and abilities commitment to the foundation’s values of trust, accountability, collaboration, community, belonging without othering, equity, diversity, and inclusion.organization, attention to detail, ability to work independently with minimum supervision.ability to maintain strong, positive relationships with various stakeholders. excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal skills required.results oriented with superior organization and project management skills.proactive, compassionate, friendly, self-directed, and reliable.enthusiastic storyteller, an ability to synthesize complex ideas and repackage them for a variety of audiences. qualificationsbachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in communications, marketing, advertising, public relations, or a related field.demonstrated professional experience across communications, including content development, graphic design, public relations, social media strategy and management, website administration, and digital communications.experience using analytics and performance data to inform and strengthen communications strategies.strong computer and technology skills, including proficiency with microsoft office 365, crm and email marketing platforms (e.g., constant contact, mailchimp), and website content management systems (e.g., wordpress).proficiency with adobe creative suite (indesign, illustrator, photoshop, premiere pro), canva, or comparable graphic design and multimedia software.ilchf team fundamentals be a visible champion of children’s health. cultivate, support, and promote initiatives that improve the health and wellness of children in illinois. live the mission.be an excellent team member. be there for each other and be willing to step into another role or help a coworker when it’s required for success. don’t let your ego or personal agenda get in the way of doing what’s best for the team. help each other to succeed.be an active learner. seek out and take advantage of every opportunity to gain more knowledge to increase your skills and expertise. this includes subject matter both in and out of work. keep an open mind for new ideas. be resourceful about learning and sharing best practices.embrace diverse perspectives. we make better decisions and find better solutions when we consider multiple perspectives, which can be influenced by age, background, ethnicity, race, religion, sexuality, or other experiences. be open to learning from others and challenge yourself to understand the lived experience that informs their views. consider issues through an equity and social justice lens.keep things fun. while our passion for excellence is real, remember that the world has bigger problems than the daily challenges we face in our work. stuff happens. keep perspective. don’t take things personally or take yourself too seriously. laugh every day.why ilchf?ilchf offers a competitive salary/benefits package and the opportunity to work with a small, collaborative, and dedicated team. competitive fulltime salary – starting at $85,000 and commensurate with experience.health insurance coverage through blue cross blue shield platinum plan. the employer covers 75% of the monthly premium cost for both the employee and their dependents.dental, vision, and life insurance coverage: 100% of the premium covered by the employer for both the employee and their dependents. life insurance ($50,000); short and long-term disability insurance.hybrid office setting with a requirement of 2 days per week (tuesday & thursday) in office. 15 pto days to start, plus all federal and state holidays and two floating holidays.12 wellness days per year accrued at 4 hours per pay period.professional development budget of $3,000 annually.tuition reimbursement of $5,250 per year (proof of enrollment required).401(k) plan, up to 6% match on employee contribution in the retirement plan plus a 2% profit sharing contribution (eligible after 6 months of employment).please note all ilchf staff are required to be residents of the state of illinois and all work, including remote work, is required to be done within the state of illinois.contact informationplease submit a cover letter and resume via email to marcommjob@ilchf.org for consideration. ilchf is an equal opportunity employer.

campaigns that deliver a distinctive and memorable retail presence.design systems and brand guidelines that enable creative ideas to scale consistently across brands, retailers, and consumer detail.desc: company description:rafiki coalition for health and wellness is a san francisco-based nonprofit dedicated to eliminating health inequities and improving the lives of black, african american, and marginalized communities in the bay area. for over 35 years, we have provided a safe, welcoming space where health, healing, and hope come together. we offer a holistic range of services, including free and low-cost health screenings, hiv prevention and care, mental health counseling, housing and economic support, fitness classes, and nutrition programs. guided by a belief that wellness is more than the absence of illness, we embrace a whole-person approach that honors the cultural, social, and emotional needs of our community.at rafiki, we are more than a service provider. we are a trusted partner, advocate, and resource. our work is rooted in compassion, cultural humility, and a commitment to social justice. every day, our team stands with our community to dismantle barriers, amplify voices, and create pathways to health and opportunity.if you're looking to join a mission-driven organization where your work directly empowers individuals and strengthens communities, rafiki coalition is the place to make a meaningful impactjob description:under the direction of the director of development and communications, the communications manager leads rafiki coalition's internal and external communications. the position develops clear, consistent messaging; manages digital and print communications; supports media and community outreach; and increases awareness of rafiki's mission, programs, services, and impact. the communications manager also supports development activities through fundraising communications, donor materials, sponsorship promotion, and funder-facing content. the position may supervise staff, contractors, interns, or volunteers assigned to communications projects. responsibilities communications strategy and brand management develop and implement annual communications and marketing plans aligned with organizational priorities and approved by the executive director. maintain consistent messaging, voice, visual identity, and use of the rafiki coalition brand across departments, programs, campaigns, and public materials. create communications calendars, establish priorities and deadlines, and coordinate information from staff and program leaders. monitor communications results and provide practical reports and recommendations to the executive director. content and publications write, edit, and coordinate print and electronic materials, including newsletters, brochures, fact sheets, presentations, flyers, organizational updates, and the annual report. translate program information, community needs, and organizational results into accurate, accessible, and culturally responsive content for varied audiences. manage the review and approval process for public-facing materials and maintain organized communications files, templates, photographs, and content resources. coordinate designers, printers, photographers, videographers, and other vendors as needed. digital communications manage website content and coordinate website maintenance to keep information accurate, current, accessible, and easy to use. plan, create, schedule, and monitor social media and email communications in support of programs, events, community education, and organizational priorities. maintain digital content standards and use basic analytics to assess reach, engagement, and opportunities for improvement. coordinate timely communications during urgent, sensitive, or rapidly changing situations, in consultation with the executive director and appropriate leaders. media community and partner relations develop media outreach materials, including press releases, media advisories, background information, talking points, opinion pieces, and responses to media inquiries. build and maintain working relationships with media, community partners, coalitions, issue experts, and organizations serving rafiki's communities. support public events, campaigns, and community engagement activities through messaging, promotion, materials, and communications logistics. prepare the executive director and other designated representatives for interviews, presentations, public statements, and community appearances. development support partner with the executive director, development staff, and consultants to create fundraising appeals, donor communications, sponsorship materials, campaign content, and event promotion. contribute communications content for grant proposals, funder reports, acknowledgments, impact stories, and other development materials. help communicate the results of funded programs accurately and consistently while meeting applicable funder recognition requirements. support donor and sponsor cultivation through coordinated messaging and appropriate communications follow-up. planning administration and supervision develop and monitor the communications budget; manage vendors, contracts, schedules, and project deliverables within approved authority. coordinate multiple projects, clarify roles and approvals, and keep the executive director informed of progress, risks, deadlines, and decisions needed. supervise and train assigned staff, contractors, interns, or volunteers and provide clear expectations and feedback. follow organizational policies and protect confidential, sensitive, and personally identifiable information in all communications. perform other duties as assigned.requirements:bachelor's degree in communications, marketing, journalism, public relations, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. at least five years of progressively responsible experience in communications, marketing, public relations, or related work, preferably in a nonprofit or community-based organization. strong writing, editing, verbal communication, interpersonal, and project management skills, with careful attention to accuracy and detail. experience managing websites, email communications, social media, publications, media relations, and communications vendors or consultants. ability to communicate effectively with diverse communities and represent rafiki's mission and work in a culturally responsive manner. working knowledge of microsoft office and common content management, email marketing, social media, design, and analytics tools. additional information:this is a full time positionhybrid flsa status - exempt application instructions:when applying for the position include with your resume a cover letter explaining:why you are a strong candidate for this positionwhy you are interested in working for rafiki compensation details: 88000-95000 yearly salary
