overviewconnecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.with 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. as a fortune 100, nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, stonex group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.business segment overview corporate:  engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. from strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies. position purpose we are seeking a seasoned professional to join as senior specialist, pr & communications. this individual will collaborate with commercial & payments business leaders, executives, subject matter experts, spokespeople and marketing teams to deliver clear, consistent and compelling messaging and stories with the media and across key communications channels.the role will create, drive and implement communications strategies supporting stonex's commercial & payments businesses, develop strong relationships across a diverse and specialized business, manage relationships with tier 1 media, financial, trade and commodity media, and drive performance against strategic goals — including brand awareness, executive and subject-matter-expert visibility through media coverage, thought leadership, events and presentations, employee advocacy and additional marketing initiatives.the position will play an important role in translating stonex's commercial & payments capabilities — spanning commodities, foreign exchange, risk management and cross-border payments — into differentiated external narratives. working closely with commercial & payments marketing leads, business development and business stakeholders, the role will connect communications activity to commercial priorities, market positioning, client themes and growth initiatives across the commercial & payments platform.global alignment is a core expectation of the role. the commercial & payments pr & communications manager will work closely with the uk and apac pr & communications managers and the global brand team to ensure commercial & payments messaging, media strategy, executive positioning and thought leadership are coordinated across regions and consistently reinforce stonex's global commercial & payments narrative.responsibilitiesprimary duties will include manage and execute strategic communications for stonex's commercial & payments businesses, aligned with communications, marketing and business objectives.  develop strong working relationships with commercial & payments business leaders, sales and risk management teams, commodity and fx specialists, payments product teams and other subject-matter experts to identify timely and differentiated communications opportunities.  develop and manage relationships between tier 1 media, financial, trade and commodity media and stonex representatives.  proactively pitch stonex businesses, executives, brokers/traders, analysts and market experts for commentary, thought leadership and other relevant opportunities for exposure.  identify opportunities to elevate stonex's commodity, foreign exchange, risk management and payments expertise around relevant market developments, trends, products and client themes.  draft press materials, talking points, executive op-eds, thought-leadership content and marketing communications.  train and support stonex representatives for various media formats, including interviews, panels, broadcast appearances and other external engagements.  partner with marketing and business stakeholders to connect media relations and thought leadership with broader commercial & payments initiatives, including events, digital content, campaigns and client-facing programs.  support communications surrounding significant business developments, including new capabilities, product launches, strategic hires, geographic expansion, partnerships and other commercial & payments growth initiatives.  provide crisis and issues management support to commercial & payments and global leadership.  oversee media monitoring to track relevant market and business coverage and guide strategy based on positive and negative media trends.  develop strong relationships across the commercial & payments ecosystem, with commercial & payments business development as the primary strategic partner and central marketing as the second core partner, followed by product, legal, compliance, hr, online reputation management, executive teams and other relevant stakeholders.  work in tandem with commercial & payments business development to maintain connectivity across commercial & payments stakeholders, ensuring communications strategies and external positioning reflect the broader commercial strategy, business priorities and cross-platform opportunities being advanced across the commercial & payments organization.  partner closely with commercial & payments business development and business stakeholders to understand commercial priorities, market positioning, client themes and growth initiatives, translating those priorities into relevant communications strategies and opportunities.  coordinate closely with the uk and apac pr & communications managers to align commercial & payments messaging, share market intelligence and media opportunities, coordinate cross-regional executive and sme visibility, and ensure locally relevant communications remain consistent with stonex's global commercial & payments positioning.  coordinate with other regional communications colleagues to identify opportunities to extend commercial & payments stories and subject-matter expertise across markets while maintaining alignment with global communications priorities.  develop frameworks for commercial & payments communications strategies, including performance metrics, in alignment with communications leadership expectations and global frameworks.  provide timely impact reports on commercial & payments communications strategies and activity.  own measurable outcomes for commercial & payments communications performance, including media coverage volume and quality, share of voice vs. competitors, and executive/sme visibility, reporting results against defined kpis and taking corrective action when targets are missed.  be accountable for the accuracy, compliance and risk profile of all external-facing communications and media engagements for the segment, ensuring materials are vetted with legal/compliance and that reputational or regulatory risks are flagged and managed proactively.  own end-to-end press release execution for the segment, including timing and scheduling, platform posting, distribution, performance metrics and amplification across owned and earned channels.  other related communications duties as needed. qualificationsto land this role you will need:  8–10+ years of experience in corporate communications, public relations or media relations, preferably with a mix of in-house and agency roles.  exceptional written and verbal communications skills.  experience and comfort working with and influencing senior leaders and highly specialized subject-matter experts.  keen attention to detail.  strong relationships with top-tier financial, business, trade and commodity media in the united states, particularly across agriculture, energy and payments  ability to distill complex financial products, market developments and commercial & payments business concepts into clear narratives across varied audiences and formats.  experience with metrics-based and sentiment-based communications reporting.  experience integrating media outreach with broader marketing initiatives, such as thought leadership, events, campaigns and digital content.  ability to develop and coordinate communications across multiple commercial & payments businesses and subject-matter areas, connecting distinct business priorities and areas of expertise into a coherent stonex commercial & payments narrative.  demonstrated ability to coordinate communications across regions, partnering with uk and apac counterparts to balance local market relevance with consistent global disparate u.s. media landscape — from highly visible journalists running their own substack, to trade publications, podcasters and youtubers, and traditional outlets. icct is also looking to autodesk operations solutions, the organization unifying autodesk's operations platform alongside tandem, flexsim and fusion operations. autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. autodesk had design and make. operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.role contextthis role sits on the brand design team inside marketing, the brand and motion designers behind our campaigns, web, launches and events. every piece of that work moves through asana, and this person owns how it comes in, how it moves and how it ships. you'll be the reason designers spend their days designing.the roleyou will own the operating rhythm of the brand design team, from the moment a request lands to the moment the work ships.own intake in asana. review new requests with marketing stakeholders, make sure each arrives with a complete creative brief, and prioritize what the team takes on, cutting the back-and-forth that pulls designers away from design.build and maintain the processes that move work smoothly from request to delivery, consistently adapting and optimizing.partner with marketing program management on large marketing initiatives each year that touch every marketer, setting start dates and deliverable milestones with clear reasoning behind them.track team capacity against demand and raise trade-offs early, so deadlines are decisions rather than surprises.keep project files and deliverables organized so anything the team has made can be found in seconds.build the reporting that shows what the team delivers and the impact of that work, in both qualitative and quantitative terms.you'll report to our director of marketing creative, and work alongside a team of designers and motion designers.about youyou've run project delivery for an in-house creative, design or marketing team.you've owned intake and set the standard for a good brief, and you've gotten requesters to follow it.you're fluent in a work management tool. asana is ours.you plan across many teams, set milestones, and turn scattered feedback into clear next steps.you notice what's broken before anyone tells you and arrive with a proposed fix.you influence through rationale, data and diplomacy, and you're clearly on your stakeholders' team. people want to work with you because you serve the company as a whole rather than defending any one group.nice to haveexperience reporting on the outcomes of creative work with datafamiliarity with brand or motion design workflowsbackground in b2b software or industrial marketingwe offerwork that shows up in the physical world. the brand you help ship supports software that keeps factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses running.a product the industry already loves. you're adding to something that already wins, and the work is about what comes next.autodesk scale, same mission. the resources of a profitable public company, pointed at the problem we were already solving: building the operating layer between how the physical world is designed and how it performs.an early seat. how this team operates is being shaped right now, and you'll be able to name the parts you own.values & how we workwe reward output and trust people with autonomy. you'll have real room to redesign how this team works, and we expect you to use it: raise issues early, bring a proposed fix, and measure whether it worked. we hire for what you've done, not what your title was. show us the project you're proudest of.our mission is to keep the physical world running. factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. that is what we build.compensation and benefits. base pay is one part of the package. depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. benefits differ by country. for roles in the united states, autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. for roles in canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.belonging. we take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. more at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. more on where this is going: autodesk ceo andrew anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and aos svp stephen hooper on welcoming maintainx to autodesk.compensation range: $81k - $140k

detail.desc: descriptionai, automation, and robotics are transforming how the world works, and amazon, as one of the largest employers on the planet, has a unique opportunity to lead the way in preparing people for what comes next. this role puts you at the center of that effort, at an unprecedented technological moment, shaping programs and communications that will touch tens of millions of lives.as sr pr manager, future of work communications, you will define, build, own, and maintain the future ready campaign: a cross-channel effort anchored by amazon's $2.5 billion commitment to help 50 million people grow their skills for in-demand jobs by 2030 and built on the company's successful track record of upskilling. you won't just tell the story; you'll help shape the programs behind it. that means building, scaling, and maintaining campaigns end-to-end, from the ground up: identifying the opportunity, sourcing data to inform your approach, developing programs that address it, and working with teams across the company to bring them to life through earned, owned, and social media, third-party voices, and strategic partnerships.you're a big thinker and a storyteller at your core. you thrive in ambiguity, can start from a future vision (maybe years down the road) and work backwards to understand how we get there, and you think both globally and locally. you generate ideas relentlessly, and when one doesn't land, you learn from it and come back with something better. you look around corners, anticipating what could become an issue, where a story could go, and which stakeholders need to be brought in early so the team can stay ahead of the moment. you aren't afraid to push back, challenge assumptions, hold partners accountable, even at senior levels, or debate strategies with leaders at every level, because you know that's how good work becomes great. you navigate complex stakeholder dynamics across business, legal, policy, and communications teams, aligning on positioning, timing, and sequencing for announcements that carry significant external visibility.you use your storytelling skill to get ahead of challenges, not just react to them. you'll stay close to how conversations around ai, innovation, and the future of work are evolving, helping the business understand emerging trends and shape thoughtful, proactive communications. you’ll help position amazon’s investments and innovation in a way that resonates with employees, customers, and external audiences. when issues arise, you’ll bring sound judgment and a thoughtful communications approach to help the team navigate them effectively.this is a strong independent contributor role that will have access to additional support from members of the broader team as needed but isn't responsible for direct management. it reports into the global operations and workplace reputation communications team within global corporate communications.key job responsibilitiesdevelop and execute complex communications programs that require input from internal and external leaders, defining strategy where none currently exists and ensuring alignment with organizational objectives.build and maintain cooperative relationships with media outlet representatives, engaging regularly to secure impactful coverage and manage reputational narratives.partner with cross-functional stakeholders to prioritize communications initiatives, making smart trade-offs on timing, effort, and deliverables while establishing clear and measurable success criteria.identify and assess reputational and sentiment risks, establishing protocols and engaging the right partners to take timely, appropriate action.author and review high-quality written materials—including narratives, communications plans, and business documents—providing guidance on writing excellence and ensuring alignment with team and organizational goals.a day in the lifeyou might start your morning reviewing media coverage and sentiment data to brief a leader ahead of an important announcement. by midday, you could be working with a cross-functional team to brainstorm new global program offerings for the workforce of tomorrow, pressure-testing assumptions and aligning stakeholders on messaging. in the afternoon, you may connect with media contacts to pitch a story or hear what trends they're most interested in, then close out by reviewing metrics and updating your team's communications roadmap to keep programs on track.about the teamwe're a team of strategic communicators who are responsible for amplifying and protecting amazon's reputation as a good employer and an innovator that's shaping the workplace of tomorrow for our teams and the world around us. we work across organizational boundaries to develop durable communications strategies that inform, engage, and build trust with the audiences that matter most. we use data to shape our decisions, and we anticipate and mitigate reputational headwinds through cross-channel efforts. we value thoughtful collaboration, creative problem-solving, and a commitment to getting the details right.we're building for the long term—investing in mechanisms, relationships, and talent that will scale as amazon grows. if you want to do meaningful work alongside colleagues who care deeply about their craft and support each other's growth, this is the team for you.basic qualifications 10+ years of recent professional communications or public relations experience bachelor's degree experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams proven track record of building and scaling integrated, multi-channel campaigns with measurable results across earned, owned, and paid media strong storytelling instincts and creative ideation skills, with a track record of generating ambitious, high-impact campaign concepts and translating complex policy topics into compelling narratives experience diving deep on unfamiliar topics and using data to develop messaging frameworks and net-new narratives that influence various audiencespreferred qualifications experience communicating complex concepts clearly and persuasively to different audiences experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, or experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects experience earning buy-in, influencing decisions, offering different perspectives, and communicating results to senior leadership experience using data to define ambiguous reputational opportunities and develop durable solutions, going beyond communications to shape the programs themselves experience identifying emerging trends and informing business leadership of evolving reputational headwinds and opportunitiesamazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.our inclusive culture empowers amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. if you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. if the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your recruiting partner.the base salary range for this position is listed below. your amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (rsus). final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, basic life & ad&d insurance and option for supplemental life plans, eap, mental health support, medical advice line, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.usa, ny, new york - 191,000.00 - 257,800.00 usd annuallyusa, tn, nashville - 156,200.00 - 211,000.00 usd about hiyaat hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. when customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.this role sits in a core business area for hiya and is focused on helping smb and enterprise customers succeed.about the rolethis year we rewrote our story from the ground up — who we are, why we matter, and where we're going. now we need someone to take that story global and make hiya the voice the world trusts on the future of the phone call.this is the role where it all comes together. you'll own how the world sees hiya: the press, the analysts, the stages, our social channels, and the creative that ties it into one unmistakable brand. and it's a story with real range. the same hiya has to land with a network executive in madrid deciding how to protect millions of subscribers from ai scams, a sales leader in toronto whose team's calls keep going unanswered, and a mom in ohio who just got a deepfake call pretending to be her son asking for money.you'll lead our existing creative + events teams and pr agencies, you'll build, and you'll get your hands dirty. organic social doesn't exist here yet. you'll write the strategy, find our voice, and ship the first posts yourself. this is a director role for someone who still loves doing the work.what you'll doown the brand. take the new narrative from slides to everywhere hiya shows up, and set the visual and verbal identity so every touchpoint looks and sounds like one hiya. give teams what they need to stay on brand without asking permission.flex the story without breaking it. work with product marketing to tell it right for each audience, then make it land in each country, with its own pains and language.set global pr strategy. decide where we invest market by market, including how pr helps us break into new ones. lead our agencies and keep the narrative owned in-house.turn our data into headlines. make our annual state of the call report the one reporters, analysts, and operators wait for, and keep a steady drumbeat of data stories by market.build analyst relations. get hiya in front of the analysts who shape how operators and businesses buy, and make sure they know our story cold.build organic social as a function, not just a channel. grow our executives' voices, set guardrails with legal so the team can move fast, create ideas that travel across paid, owned, earned, and ai search, and turn what we hear into intel for product, sales, and pr.make hiya a visible industry leader. build the thought leadership and speaking program, prep spokespeople, and go after the keynotes and awards that put us at the center of voice security and ai fraud. have a plan ready for when something goes sideways.make events count. with our global events manager, set the event strategy: which events matter for which audiences, how we show up, and how we measure presence and relationships, not just leads. flagship moments like mobile world congress should feel unmistakably hiya.build and lead the team. coach and grow the team, run our agencies, and build a creative function that scales globally. hire for where we're going.measure what matters: share of voice, coverage quality, analyst perception, and how brand, pr, and social move people from awareness to consideration. use it to decide where to invest.what we are looking foryou've led brand and comms before. you have 10+ years in brand, communications, or pr at b2b tech companies, including leading teams and agencies across multiple countries.a leader who still does the work. you set the strategy, then write the pitch, draft the post, and give the designer specific feedback yourself. you're as comfortable managing as you are doing.a team builder. you've grown creative or comms teams from small to scaled.a storyteller with taste. you can make telecom, ai, and fraud interesting enough that a reporter leans in, and you know great creative when you see it. b2b buzzwords make you wince.consistent without being rigid. you've kept a brand coherent across audiences, products, and countries, and you know when to flex and when to hold the line.strong across pr, analyst relations, and social. these are your core skills, not side projects. you have real media and analyst relationships, ideally in tech, telecom, or security, and you've turned social from a posting calendar into a real function.global by default. you've run comms across the us and europe, and you know a story that works in new york can fall flat in madrid.calm in a storm. you've handled issues and crisis comms and know how to protect trust when it counts.hands-on and experimental with ai. our pms are already vibe-coding fixes to production. you'll use ai daily to move faster and keep the quality bar high.comfortable on stage and in the room with executives, operators, and press.how we workhiya is not a passive environment. we expect people to take ownership, form opinions, and engage directly with hard problems.we work with a high degree of transparency and autonomy. context is shared openly, and decisions are discussed, challenged, and then made. once a call is made, we commit and move forward.you'll be expected to work through ambiguity, weigh tradeoffs, and take responsibility for results, while keeping a high bar for quality and customer trust.every team member at hiya is expected to live our core values:serve, our customers and partners by holding a high bar for trust and qualityown, share in success and open up to failureslead, listen, show up with a point of view but commit entirely once a decision has been madeimprove, even if it means changing course or contradicting ourselvesdo, rather than observehow we invest in youcompensation & ownershipequity compensation: ownership aligned with your impact and the company's growthwe offer an l&d budget to support your growth and real internal mobility so career pathing isn't just a talking point — because we're building this with people who own the outcome.come work with us!we're building a team with diverse perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. we evaluate candidates through a business lens and believe that diversity and unique viewpoints make our company stronger, more dynamic, and a great place to build a career.we've been recognized by built in, geekwire, comparably, g2, forbes, and deloitte technology fast 500 for our culture, innovation, leadership, compensation, and more. at hiya, we're a people-centric company focused on helping each employee grow both personally and professionally. we create a culture of support and empowerment that challenges the status quo, resulting in an energized team that's passionate about their work. you'll love working here if you're looking for an innovative challenge that's disrupting an industry. come join us!hiya is an equal opportunity employer. we celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

detail.desc: descriptionexempt recruitment announcement director of communication and external relations$80,000 to $110,000 annuallycloses november 04,2026this is an exempt recruitment announcement from the professional educator standards board. this position, located in olympia, wa, may be eligible for a partial teleworking schedule. telework combines in-building and off-site days.who we arewe believe that the success of washington’s students depends on the success of washington’s educators. at the professional educator standards board (pesb), we strengthen and support the success of our educator workforce through every stage of their career.we are one agency with two governing boards: the professional educator standards board and the paraeducator board. our policies and programs span washington’s system of educator pathways, preparation, certification, and professional development opportunities. we oversee educator standards and licensure, and hold preparation programs accountable for the ways in which they recruit, support, and prepare diverse and classroom-ready educators.our board members and staff are committed to centering diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our work and to building respectful, reciprocal relationships with tribal nations across washington state. as part of our commitment, we embrace the opportunity to address disparities and barriers perpetuated by historical and institutionalized racism within the overall education system, and we recognize the unique government-to-government relationship the state holds with tribal nations under the centennial accord.our agency values serve as a compass to guide our work. we value:educator voicediversity, equity, and inclusioneducator excellence for student successcommunity engagementlearning and innovationto operate as an antiracist agency, we seek candidates aligned with these values, including candidates who bring experience or a genuine willingness to learn how to work in good faith with education partners, diverse constituencies, and tribal nations. passion for the mission of pesb, including its commitment to equity and to honoring washington’s diverse communities and tribal nations.position overviewthis position provides strategic guidance to the executive director and other agency members to help engage the public, strengthen external partnerships, and promote the value and visibility of our work. the director for communication and external relations must establish strong, collaborative relationships with internal teams to execute effective, equity-centered communications plans supporting agency needs and goals.this role ensures communication with educators, paraeducators, preparation programs, school districts, educational service districts (esds), educational organizations, policymakers, the public, and tribal nations in washington state is not only clear and accurate but also culturally responsive, reflecting the histories, sovereignty, and self-determination of the communities we serve. the director partners closely with the agency’s tribal liaison to ensure tribal perspectives, protocols, and priorities are embedded in the agency’s communications, outreach, and public engagement work.the director will employ equity-centered and culturally responsive communications to elevate the agency’s core functions for educators (career exploration and discovery, preparation, credentialing, workforce development, and shortage). the role will also work to ensure the agency’s messaging reflects the needs of historically underserved communities and tribal nations. this role will lead and support the development and implementation of campaigns for multiple audiences to support the agency’s priorities, including legislative advocacy.key responsibilitiesagencywide communicationswrite, edit, and design agency communications materials, including one-pagers, reports, faqs, and presentations, to effectively communicate information to diverse audiences (e.g., educators, legislators, stakeholders, associations, tribal nations, and community members). ensure materials are accurate, accessible, culturally responsive, aligned with key messages, and promote the agency as a positive and transparent policymaker and partner.create and maintain internal policies, processes, and training to guide and support staff on the use of communications tools, including guidance on culturally responsive communications practices.promote agencywide initiatives and programs by developing key messages and talking points, leading audience analysis activities, implementing communications plans, and assessing opportunities for greater engagement and outreach. provide media and outreach guidance for agency meetings and conferences, develop materials, and recommend promotional strategies to increase visibility, registration, and participation from diverse audiences and tribal communities.alongside the legislative policy team, translate complex policy, rulemaking, and certification/credentialing information into accessible language for diverse audiences.align current and new agency materials with ada requirements and accessibility best practices.support agency tribal liaison in maintaining relationships between the board and tribal education departments, tribal colleges, and tribal leadership on matters related to educator standards and requirements, the john mccoy (lulilaš) since time immemorial curriculum, tribal-based teacher and paraeducator pathways, and workforce development.public relations and legislative supportdevelop and implement campaigns for multiple audiences to support legislative advocacy for agency initiatives.work closely with the executive director and staff to support the agency’s legislative priorities by advising on communications strategy, framing, positioning, and research, ensuring an equity and tribal relations lens is applied throughout. cultivate and maintain knowledge of and relationships with educational organizations, policymakers, tribal nations, and other partners and constituencies as needed.ensure consistent messaging in legislative materials such as fact sheets, talking points, and presentations.track media coverage, write press releases, coordinate interviews, identify story opportunities, and maintain consistent and positive press relationships. serve as the first point of contact and agency spokesperson for media inquiries.provide direct and proactive advice, consultation, and assistance to the executive director and staff, as needed, regarding public information matters, including providing direct assistance in researching, providing information, and developing messages. support the tribal liaison with establishing, cultivating, and maintaining government-to-government relationships with washington’s tribal nations, consistent with the state’s centennial accord and related tribal consultation policies.digital communicationsmanage graphic design for agency materials, including one-pagers, reports, faqs, ada compliance, and presentations to effectively communicate information to diverse audiences (e.g., educators, legislators, stakeholders, associations, and community members). manage the design and execution of social media, collaborating with agency teams to identify social media content, using best practices, engagement tactics, user-experience design strategies, accessibility compliance, and strengthening content through plain talk principles that reach diverse audiences.manage agency social media tools and profiles, including the content calendar, facebook, x (formerly known as twitter), linkedin, medium, and youtube. lead the design, management, and maintenance of the agency’s internal and external websites, ensuring all formatting, content, and designs align with our agency style guide, meet accessibility requirements, and prioritize the user experience.manage contracts related to website design, management, and maintenance.executive director and board meeting supportprovide outreach support to the executive director by researching and identifying opportunities for stakeholder engagements, networking events, and strengthening partnerships through a variety of communication platforms.draft talking points, correspondence, presentations, or other materials at the direction of the executive director.support board meetings, public hearings, and rulemaking processes with clear communication of opportunities for public and tribal input, including:develop, support, consult, or review executive director and other staff team presentations and materials.attend all pesb board meetings to manage media opportunities and support the executive director, staff, and board members.provide technical support for in-person and virtual meetings.other duties as assigned by the executive director.required qualificationsbachelor’s degree or higher in communications, journalism, or a related field.five or more years of relevant experience in communications or public relations. demonstrated ability to communicate across cultural, linguistic, and community differences, as well as engage in courageous conversations around race, equity, and tribal sovereignty.experience working respectfully and productively with education organizations, policymakers, tribal nations, constituencies, and other partners.understanding of tribal sovereignty and government-to-government consultation detail.desc: descriptionkiro crew is an open source, persistent, self-evolving coding agent built on kiro cli. it started as an internal amazon project where hundreds of engineers adopted it, filed bugs, contributed features, and shaped the product through direct feedback with the engineering team. that internal culture of contribution and trust is the foundation this role inherits.now kiro crew lives on github, and we're opening this thriving internal community to the world. there's already an engaged developer base, established contribution norms, and a product team accustomed to building with community input. what's missing is someone to translate that internal energy into external growth among developers who don't yet know the project.we're looking for an open source community manager to own that transition. you'll be the two-way bridge: representing the product to external developers while channeling their signal back to the team.key job responsibilitiesrun the community day to day. triage issues, moderate channels, answer and route questions, keep response times low.build the newcomer-to-contributor pipeline. design welcome flows, starter docs, good first issues, and and challenges that turn visitors into regulars.create content and represent the project. publish blogs, tutorials, and samples. show up at meetups, hackathons, and conferences with hands-on workshops.amplify releases. partner with engineering and devrel to turn changelogs into launch stories across community channels and social.drive audience growth. identify channels that reach the amplification. you'll also coordinate with developer advocacy on events, content, and partner work.why aws?amazon web services (aws) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. we pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.inclusive team culturehere at aws, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. ongoing events and learning experiences, including our conversations on race and ethnicity (core) and amazecon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.mentorship & career growthwe’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become earth’s best employer. that’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.work/life balancewe value work-life harmony. achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. when we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.basic the future of a $10t industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. today, companies of all sizes - from emerging brands to fortune 500s - use flexport technology to environment? come join us.the rolewe're looking for a social media and content marketing manager to own the channels where flexport shows up every day. you'll run our social presence, keep the blog full of content people actually want to read, and produce a newsletter that logistics leaders look forward to opening. you'll write most of it yourself, polish the visuals in canva, cut short videos produce our newsletter end to end, from picking the stories to writing the copy to hitting send. design social graphics and light marketing assets in canva, staying true to flexport's brand. edit detail.desc: descriptionai, automation, and robotics are transforming how the world works, and amazon, as one of the largest employers on the planet, has a unique opportunity to lead the way in preparing people for what comes next. this role puts you at the center of that effort, at an unprecedented technological moment, shaping programs and communications that will touch tens of millions of lives.as sr pr manager, future of work communications, you will define, build, own, and maintain the future ready campaign: a cross-channel effort anchored by amazon's $2.5 billion commitment to help 50 million people grow their skills for in-demand jobs by 2030 and built on the company's successful track record of upskilling. you won't just tell the story; you'll help shape the programs behind it. that means building, scaling, and maintaining campaigns end-to-end, from the ground up: identifying the opportunity, sourcing data to inform your approach, developing programs that address it, and working with teams across the company to bring them to life through earned, owned, and social media, third-party voices, and strategic partnerships.you're a big thinker and a storyteller at your core. you thrive in ambiguity, can start from a future vision (maybe years down the road) and work backwards to understand how we get there, and you think both globally and locally. you generate ideas relentlessly, and when one doesn't land, you learn from it and come back with something better. you look around corners, anticipating what could become an issue, where a story could go, and which stakeholders need to be brought in early so the team can stay ahead of the moment. you aren't afraid to push back, challenge assumptions, hold partners accountable, even at senior levels, or debate strategies with leaders at every level, because you know that's how good work becomes great. you navigate complex stakeholder dynamics across business, legal, policy, and communications teams, aligning on positioning, timing, and sequencing for announcements that carry significant external visibility.you use your storytelling skill to get ahead of challenges, not just react to them. you'll stay close to how conversations around ai, innovation, and the future of work are evolving, helping the business understand emerging trends and shape thoughtful, proactive communications. you’ll help position amazon’s investments and innovation in a way that resonates with employees, customers, and external audiences. when issues arise, you’ll bring sound judgment and a thoughtful communications approach to help the team navigate them effectively.this is a strong independent contributor role that will have access to additional support from members of the broader team as needed but isn't responsible for direct management. it reports into the global operations and workplace reputation communications team within global corporate communications.key job responsibilitiesdevelop and execute complex communications programs that require input from internal and external leaders, defining strategy where none currently exists and ensuring alignment with organizational objectives.build and maintain cooperative relationships with media outlet representatives, engaging regularly to secure impactful coverage and manage reputational narratives.partner with cross-functional stakeholders to prioritize communications initiatives, making smart trade-offs on timing, effort, and deliverables while establishing clear and measurable success criteria.identify and assess reputational and sentiment risks, establishing protocols and engaging the right partners to take timely, appropriate action.author and review high-quality written materials—including narratives, communications plans, and business documents—providing guidance on writing excellence and ensuring alignment with team and organizational goals.a day in the lifeyou might start your morning reviewing media coverage and sentiment data to brief a leader ahead of an important announcement. by midday, you could be working with a cross-functional team to brainstorm new global program offerings for the workforce of tomorrow, pressure-testing assumptions and aligning stakeholders on messaging. in the afternoon, you may connect with media contacts to pitch a story or hear what trends they're most interested in, then close out by reviewing metrics and updating your team's communications roadmap to keep programs on track.about the teamwe're a team of strategic communicators who are responsible for amplifying and protecting amazon's reputation as a good employer and an innovator that's shaping the workplace of tomorrow for our teams and the world around us. we work across organizational boundaries to develop durable communications strategies that inform, engage, and build trust with the audiences that matter most. we use data to shape our decisions, and we anticipate and mitigate reputational headwinds through cross-channel efforts. we value thoughtful collaboration, creative problem-solving, and a commitment to getting the details right.we're building for the long term—investing in mechanisms, relationships, and talent that will scale as amazon grows. if you want to do meaningful work alongside colleagues who care deeply about their craft and support each other's growth, this is the team for you.basic qualifications 10+ years of recent professional communications or public relations experience bachelor's degree experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams proven track record of building and scaling integrated, multi-channel campaigns with measurable results across earned, owned, and paid media strong storytelling instincts and creative ideation skills, with a track record of generating ambitious, high-impact campaign concepts and translating complex policy topics into compelling narratives experience diving deep on unfamiliar topics and using data to develop messaging frameworks and net-new narratives that influence various audiencespreferred qualifications experience communicating complex concepts clearly and persuasively to different audiences experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, or experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects experience earning buy-in, influencing decisions, offering different perspectives, and communicating results to senior leadership experience using data to define ambiguous reputational opportunities and develop durable solutions, going beyond communications to shape the programs themselves experience identifying emerging trends and informing business leadership of evolving reputational headwinds and opportunitiesamazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.our inclusive culture empowers amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. if you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. if the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your recruiting partner.the base salary range for this position is listed below. your amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (rsus). final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, basic life & ad&d insurance and option for supplemental life plans, eap, mental health support, medical advice line, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.usa, ny, new york - 191,000.00 - 257,800.00 usd annuallyusa, tn, nashville - 156,200.00 - 211,000.00 usd detail.desc: mckesson is an impact-driven, fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. we are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.what you do at mckesson matters. we foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. if you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.about the rolemckesson medical-surgical is seeking a senior ecommerce brand manager, private label to join our consumer markets team. you will lead the commercial strategy and performance of a portfolio of private label health care products across amazon, online marketplaces, and other consumer-facing ecommerce channels.this highly visible individual contributor role owns the end-to-end business performance of the portfolio, including growth, assortment, and listing strategies, product launch planning, profitability, and strong cross functional coordination of marketplace execution.the ideal candidate brings deep amazon and marketplace expertise, strong business acumen, and a proven track record of scaling brands across ecommerce channels through data-driven decision making.working cross-functionally with marketing, pricing, supply chain, product development, operations, and marketplace teams, you will identify and lead the go to market plans to drive profitable growth.this is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of mckesson's private label consumer business during a period of brand evolution.what you'll dodrive private brand growth & own performance serve as the commercial owner for a portfolio of private label products across amazon, marketplaces, and other ecommerce channels. develop and execute growth strategies that balance revenue, profitability, market share, consumer demand, and long-term brand health. lead financial forecasting, business reviews, performance reporting, and identification of risks and opportunities. deploy amazon expertise to lead as project owner supporting a large product rebranding effort delivering a coordinated ecommerce approach to drive and grow the new brand as a 3p seller evaluate assortment, pricing, promotional effectiveness, and channel performance to maximize growth and profitability assess commercial tradeoffs and recommend investments, pricing changes, promotional activity, assortment optimization, and portfolio priorities.lead go-to-market execution cross functionally lead cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment of go to market initiatives within a matrixed organization. identify expansion opportunities rooted in analytics, competitive intelligence, and consumer trends. provide direction to teams by identifying products and categories with the greatest growth potential. support product lifecycle management and commercialization activities across ecommerce channels. ensure products are competitively positioned with clear consumer value propositions and effective pricing architecture in partnership with the pricing team. develop launch strategies including positioning, pricing, content requirements, inventory readiness, and success metrics. partner with marketing teams to drive advertising, customer acquisition, promotional, and brand-building initiatives. collaborate with marketplace and listing teams to improve search visibility, conversion, digital shelf performance, and key programs. coordinate with supply chain and operations partners to ensure inventory availability, launch readiness, and business continuity.deliver insights & influence decisions leverage marketplace analytics, search insights, syndicated data, and internal reporting to create actionable commercial plans and make strategic decisions develop executive-ready business reviews, presentations, and strategic recommendations. monitor competitive activity, marketplace trends, and consumer behavior to identify growth opportunities.basic qualifications bachelor's degree in business, marketing, ecommerce, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 7+ years of experience in ecommerce, marketplace management, category management, brand management, merchandising, commercial strategy, or related disciplines. 3+ years of amazon 3p seller experience directly managing brands and product categories strong experience owning business performance metrics, forecasting, p&l management, and profitability analysis. proven ability to analyze complex data and translate insights into growth strategies and actions experience operating effectively in fast-paced, matrixed organizations. experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders demonstrated success developing and executing portfolio growth strategies that drive revenue, profitability, and market share gains. advanced proficiency in microsoft excel and powerpoint. strong communication, presentation, and strategy articulation skills.preferred qualifications mba or advanced business degree. experience within consumer packaged goods (cpg), retail, consumer products, or omnichannel commerce environments. experience managing brands across amazon, walmart marketplace, target plus, ebay, or similar ecommerce platforms. hands-on experience with amazon seller central, stackline, helium 10, circana (iri), detail.desc: role overviewas a content strategist at webmd ignite, you will guide the strategic vision for our patient education assets in support of multiple products and solutions. you will ensure that our content is highly engaging, discoverable, and optimized for the consumer and patient journeys across applications and platforms and seamlessly integrated into the clinical workflow. your goal is to help simplify complex strategic ideas and transform them into actionable, accessible education that empowers consumers to manage their health, while collaborating on ai-enabled content orchestration and governance, ensuring our content is optimized for the latest generative and agentic technologies.editorial strategyeditorial mission: to provide consumers with the most trusted, accessible, and actionable health education that drives better health decisions and patient engagement, and empowers providers and patients with timely, evidence-based education that improves clinical workflow.target audience: consumers, patients, and family caregivers seeking health information across various digital touchpoints, as well as clinicians, health system administrators, and care managers.point of view: we advocate for the user. we believe health education should be clear, jargon-free, and designed for health literacy—meeting the user where they are in their care journey. our content is "fhir-friendly," interoperable, and "ai-ready," designed as modular assets for dynamic assembly by conversational and agentic systems. we believe health education should not be a static document but dynamic assets that surface at the right moment of care in the right format.process designcontent lifecycle: you will collaborate on the lifecycle of high-volume assets, from research and intake to production. you will also collaborate on ai-assisted workflows, including metadata management and summarization in the content management system to continually increase the ratio of work automated with ai.success metrics: measure strategy effectiveness through feedback on content findability, gaps, gluts, and change requests. success will also be measured by gains in efficiency and scale driven by ai-enabled orchestration.key responsibilitiessubstance & editorial directionstrategic roadmapping: define the content themes and project priorities that align with consumer health trends, clinical health trends, and client needs for consumer engagement and patient education.ai & clinical auditing: utilize agentic ai for automated governance, auditing activities, and programmatic asset mapping for both internal and external use cases. leverage ai for automated clinical auditing and "drift" detection to ensure content aligns with evolving medical guidelines, automatically flagging outdated items for review.market alignment: engage with clients and prospects to understand their jobs to be done, translating them into editorial solutions to support “self-serve” use cases and emr integrations.product collaboration: partner with ux and product managers to ensure content is "born digital"—designed to work seamlessly within modern application layouts, mobile interfaces, and clinical workflows.interoperability & discoverabilityfhir support: partner with content integration and knowledge engineering to align content and metadata models, ensuring our library is "fhir-ready" for emr data exchange.ai content recommendations: work with technical teams on ai-driven clinical decision support that merges encounter data with ambient ai transcripts to improve real-time content recommendations for clinicians.content design: work with the knowledge engineering and search teams to identify "intent gaps" in our consumer and patient libraries and develop content that answers the questions people are actually asking online, as well as what our clients and their patients need.workflow & operationsai enablement & product integration: lead training and enablement for team members and freelancers to incorporate ai agents and automations into every aspect of content strategy and development. partner with product and tech on uat and training for ai-driven products.intake & prioritization: manage the "front door" for new content and asset requests, using data to prioritize high-impact consumer health and patient education projects over other projects.process improvement: continuously partner on refining the content and asset production workflows to reduce "time-to-market" and "time-to-delivery" through ai-assisted automation of clinical and content tasks.qualificationsprofessional experienceeducation: bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, public health, health education, or a related field (master’s level preferred).experience: 5+ years in content strategy or patient education, specifically focused on b2c (business-to-consumer) health or wellness products, or with a proven track record in the healthcare or healthit sectors.digital health ecosystems: familiar with patient education content strategy principles, with the ability to align assets effectively for consumers, providers, payers, and health it users.technical skillsai proficiency: understands ai methodologies, including prompt engineering, rag-optimized response systems, and working with agentic ai autonomous operational partners.cms, workflow, and crm tools: proficiency in using a variety of content management, project management, and client management tools.analytics: ability to interpret client, clinical, and consumer behavior data using a variety of analytic tools and outputs.core competenciesuser-centricity & ai orchestration: a passion for improving user journeys with content, combined with the ability to help redesign traditional workflows around ai-enabled governance to drive measurable gains in efficiency, cost savings, and scale.agility & strategic thinking: the ability to pivot strategy based on digital performance data and changing market demands.communication: exceptional skills in translating complex clinical concepts for a general audience , while maintaining a "team-first" approach to working with disparate business functions, including clinical, editorial, and technical smes.webmd is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and does not funding and is valued at $5.5b, backed by leading investors including goldman sachs, menlo ventures, ivp, unusual ventures, citi ventures, and more. as ai accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. harness brings ai and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.powered by harness ai and the software delivery knowledge graph, the harness platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.over the past year, harness powered over 185m deployments, 82m builds, 18t flag evaluations, 8m security scans, 9.1b optimized tests, 3t protected api calls, and helped manage $2.8b in cloud spend — enabling customers countries, harness is shaping the future of ai software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.position summarywe're looking for someone who understands the software delivery problem at a technical level and can translate it into clear, compelling content for the audiences who care most about solving it — developers, engineering and security leaders, and the broader tech community following where enterprise software is headed.this role sits at the intersection of technology, communication, and market narrative. you'll develop a deep understanding of what harness is building and translate that — alongside what's happening across the industry — into content that earns attention from a technical audience.reporting to the vp of corporate marketing, this role will partner directly with the executive team at harness and work cross-functionally with engineering, product management, and marketing to ensure harness's point of view is grounded in what we're buildingabout the roleyou'll develop content that represents harness's point of view — substantive technical and industry commentary that reflects how practitioners actually think about software delivery, ai governance, security, developer productivity, and engineering roi.that means staying current on what's being published, debated, and shipped across the industry. reading the pragmatic engineer, tracking what engineering leaders are saying, knowing when a dora report or a vc thesis or a major industry announcement is something worth responding to. then translating harness's actual position into words quickly — before the conversation moves on.day to day, you'll monitor the news and developer conversation, identify what's worth engaging with, develop angles and post ideas, write the content calendar and the quality of what goes out.this is not a traditional content role. the bar is high — no fluff, no generic takes, no posts that read like they came from a pr template. the audience is technical and they'll know the differenceabout youyou have a technical foundation — engineering degree, cs background, or equivalent time spent working closely with engineering teams — and you've developed a strong instinct for communicating complex ideas clearly. you read widely across tech, not just in your lane. you have opinions about what's happening in software development and you maintainx to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.in august 2026 maintainx became part of autodesk, joining autodesk operations solutions, the organization unifying autodesk's operations platform alongside tandem, flexsim and fusion operations. autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. autodesk had design and make. operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.role contextthis role sits on the brand design team inside marketing, the brand and motion designers behind our campaigns, web, launches and events. every piece of that work moves through asana, and this person owns how it comes in, how it moves and how it ships. you'll be the reason designers spend their days designing.the roleyou will own the operating rhythm of the brand design team, from the moment a request lands to the moment the work ships.own intake in asana. review new requests with marketing stakeholders, make sure each arrives with a complete creative brief, and prioritize what the team takes on, cutting the back-and-forth that pulls designers away from design.build and maintain the processes that move work smoothly from request to delivery, consistently adapting and optimizing.partner with marketing program management on large marketing initiatives each year that touch every marketer, setting start dates and deliverable milestones with clear reasoning behind them.track team capacity against demand and raise trade-offs early, so deadlines are decisions rather than surprises.keep project files and deliverables organized so anything the team has made can be found in seconds.build the reporting that shows what the team delivers and the impact of that work, in both qualitative and quantitative terms.you'll report to our director of marketing creative, and work alongside a team of designers and motion designers.about youyou've run project delivery for an in-house creative, design or marketing team.you've owned intake and set the standard for a good brief, and you've gotten requesters to follow it.you're fluent in a work management tool. asana is ours.you plan across many teams, set milestones, and turn scattered feedback into clear next steps.you notice what's broken before anyone tells you and arrive with a proposed fix.you influence through rationale, data and diplomacy, and you're clearly on your stakeholders' team. people want to work with you because you serve the company as a whole rather than defending any one group.nice to haveexperience reporting on the outcomes of creative work with datafamiliarity with brand or motion design workflowsbackground in b2b software or industrial marketingwe offerwork that shows up in the physical world. the brand you help ship supports software that keeps factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses running.a product the industry already loves. you're adding to something that already wins, and the work is about what comes next.autodesk scale, same mission. the resources of a profitable public company, pointed at the problem we were already solving: building the operating layer between how the physical world is designed and how it performs.an early seat. how this team operates is being shaped right now, and you'll be able to name the parts you own.values & how we workwe reward output and trust people with autonomy. you'll have real room to redesign how this team works, and we expect you to use it: raise issues early, bring a proposed fix, and measure whether it worked. we hire for what you've done, not what your title was. show us the project you're proudest of.our mission is to keep the physical world running. factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. that is what we build.compensation and benefits. base pay is one part of the package. depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. benefits differ by country. for roles in the united states, autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. for roles in canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.belonging. we take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. more at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. more on where this is going: autodesk ceo andrew anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and aos svp stephen hooper on welcoming maintainx to autodesk.compensation range: $81k - $140k

detail.desc: about audubonthe national audubon society is a leading nonprofit conservation organization with 120 years of science-based, community-driven impact, dedicated to protecting birds and the places they need, today and tomorrow. birds are powerful indicators of our planet’s health, acting as sentinels that warn us of environmental change and inspire action. audubon works across the western hemisphere, driven by the understanding that what is good for birds is good for the planet. through a collaborative, nonpartisan approach across habitats, borders, and the political spectrum, audubon drives meaningful and lasting conservation outcomes. with over 1,000 staff and more than 2.6 million supporters, audubon is a dynamic and ever-growing force committed to ensuring a better planet for both birds and people for generations to come. learn more at audubon.org and on facebook and instagram @audubonsociety.position summaryaudubon's conservation impact depends not only on the work the organization leads, but on how that work is understood, embraced, and acted upon by the audiences who can help advance it—from policymakers and partners to supporters, employees, and (30%) develop messaging that is tailored to the specific political environment and attuned to the rapid pace of legislative activities. write and coach others to enhance their writing of press releases, media advisories, letters to the editor, op-eds, talking points, faqs, fact sheets, speeches, presentations and other media material as needed, ensuring appropriate review for subject matter accuracy and brand standards. plan and manage media events, including press conferences and editorial board meetings. (5%) represent acs can in coalitions for priority campaigns to ensure coordination and brand recognition with joint media activities (5%) elevate the profile of acs can, by working through the media to ensure that opinion leaders are aware of acs can legislative activity and voter education activity. (5%) experience/qualifications:minimum degree required: bachelor's degree preferred degree: bachelor's degree certificate(s) or license(s): n/a years of experience: 2-3 years knowledge, skills, and ability:spanish language proficiency requiredat least 2-3 years of experience in journalism or public relations and/or legislative communications. familiarity with the legislative and/or political process a must; familiarity with reporters and/or media outlets in the covered markets preferred. political campaign or legislative experience preferred. knowledge of health care policy preferred. excellent written, oral, interpersonal and computer skills required. ability to work independently with minimum direction as well as work as a member or leader of a team. demonstrated ability to work on fast-paced, time-sensitive matters with internal and external constituents. ability to complete work in a timely and efficient manner and ensure work is accurate. ability to utilize available technology to perform position responsibilities. self-starter and proactive with creating ideas and messaging adept at working independently in a remote setting. travel requirements:some overnight travel for meetings required. physical requirements:limited lifting for media event setup may be required the starting rate is $73,000 to $83,000 annual. the final candidate's relevant experience/skills will be considered before an offer is extended. actual starting pay will vary based on non-discriminatory factors including, but not limited to, geographic location, experience, skills, specialty, and education.acs can provides staff a generous paid time off policy; medical, dental, retirement benefits, wellness programs, and professional development programs to enhance staff skills. further details on our benefits can be found on our careers site at: jobs.cancer.org/benefits. we are a proud equal opportunity employer.

important news reaches customers and enables field sales and partner teams to engage around the launches that matter most.we are looking for a program manager to help run the programs that make this possible. working closely with senior program managers and stakeholders, you will help keep launches moving on time and at a high quality bar — coordinating across product managers, marketing, engineering, security, legal, and field teams, tracking deliverables, and surfacing risks early. this is a role for someone who is organized, resourceful, and eager to grow in a high-visibility, cross-functional environment where the details matter and the scale is significant. you will learn the launch process end to end, and as you do, you will spot where manual coordination slows launches important launches are elevated to customers. apply generative ai tools including amazon quick to streamline documentation, status reporting, and program analysis.a day in the lifeyou start your morning reviewing the launch pipeline and flagging any launches at risk of slipping, then follow up with the relevant task owners to keep them on track. mid-morning, you join a working session with product and marketing partners to walk through upcoming launches and capture next steps. after lunch, you update the program dashboard and pull together a status summary for the team, highlighting progress and any open items that need attention. between meetings, you look for small ways to remove friction in the intake process often using generative ai tooling to speed up the documentation and reporting that used to take up much of your day.about the teamthe aws lifecycle marketing team shapes how the world’s leading cloud and ai portfolio reaches customers. we orchestrate how aws launches overviewfred hutchinson cancer center is an independent, nonprofit organization providing adult cancer treatment and groundbreaking research focused on cancer and infectious diseases. based in seattle, fred hutch is the only national cancer institute-designated cancer center in washington.with a track record of global leadership in bone marrow transplantation, hiv/aids prevention, immunotherapy and covid-19 vaccines, fred hutch has earned a reputation as one of the world’s leading cancer, infectious disease and biomedical research centers. fred hutch operates eight clinical care sites that provide medical oncology, infusion, radiation, proton therapy and related services, and network affiliations with hospitals in five states. together, our fully integrated research and clinical care teams seek to discover new cures to the world’s deadliest diseases and make life beyond cancer a reality.at fred hutch we value collaboration, compassion, determination, excellence, innovation, integrity and respect. our mission is directly tied to the humanity, dignity and inherent value of each employee, patient, community member and supporter. our commitment to learning across across all territories, service lines, and regional sites, ensuring messaging that tells the whole fred hutch story.  actively participate in local and regional travel to strengthen relationships with physicians and clinics in liaison’s portfolio. this may include taking fred hutch physicians to in-person meetings or visiting clinics for liaison-to-physician meetings. destinations will include regional sites. at least 40% travel is expected.  manage and track requests from external physicians, escalating as necessary until issues and requests are resolved.  regularly report on status of outreach plans as well as field intelligence gathered to internal stakeholders including service line management, and executive leadership at fred hutch.  keep up to date on emerging offerings from service lines, community sites, and the education team; promote new offerings to contacts in the liaison’s portfolio. maintain knowledge of referring pathways within disease specific oncology service lines.  develop and propose marketing materials to promote outreach tactics by collaborating closely with the fred hutch marketing and communications team.  as part of fred hutch’s geographic expansion plan, support regional site launch efforts as fred hutch opens oncology services in new locations.  mentor junior liaisons by providing insights on best practices and helping develop plans
