detail.desc: about hungrypanda 关于熊猫外卖founded in 2017 and headquartered in london, hungrypanda connects overseas communities with authentic chinese and asian food through its delivery platform. we work with merchants and delivery partners to make familiar flavors more accessible and support local businesses.熊猫外卖成立于2017年，总部位于伦敦，致力于通过外卖平台连接海外社区与地道的中餐及亚洲美食。我们与商家和配送伙伴合作，让熟悉的味道触手可及，并支持本地商家的发展。our value 我们的价值理念satisfy your chinese taste. we bring people closer to the food they love and the communities they call home.满足你的中国胃。以美食连接用户与社区，传递熟悉的味道与归属感。our mission 我们的使命connect merchants and consumers through technology and delivery services, creating opportunities across the overseas chinese food ecosystem.通过科技与配送服务连接商家和消费者，为海外中餐生态创造更多发展机会。our people 我们的团队we are food lovers who value initiative, collaboration and practical results. we welcome people who take ownership, communicate openly and turn ideas into action.我们热爱美食，重视主动担当、团队协作和实际成果，欢迎愿意开放沟通、承担责任并推动想法落地的伙伴。about the role 岗位介绍we are looking for an experienced, hands-on public relations manager to strengthen u.s. government and stakeholder relationships and protect hungrypanda’s reputation across media, social platforms and online communities. you will independently lead sensitive issue responses, advise leadership and personally execute communications across english- and chinese-language channels. this role combines government relations, crisis communications, media relations and proactive reputation building, with clear ownership from early risk assessment through resolution.我们正在寻找一位经验成熟、执行力强的公关经理，负责维护美国政府及重要利益相关方关系，并在新闻媒体、社交平台及网络社区中维护熊猫外卖的企业声誉。你将独立主导敏感事件应对，为管理层提供判断建议，并亲自执行中英文对外沟通。岗位涵盖政府关系、危机公关、媒体关系和主动声誉建设，要求从风险发现到事件闭环全程负责。main duties and responsibilities 主要工作职责government relations and public affairs: build and maintain credible relationships with relevant u.s. government offices, regulators, industry associations, chambers of commerce and community organizations. track policy and public affairs issues affecting delivery platforms and prepare briefings, meetings and responses with leadership and legal.政府关系与公共事务：建立并维护与美国相关政府部门、监管机构、行业协会、商会及社区组织的可信关系；跟踪影响外卖平台的政策与公共事务议题，与管理层及法务协同准备沟通材料、组织会面并回应问询。crisis communications and issues management: independently lead responses to negative coverage, allegations, viral complaints, service or safety incidents and other reputational risks. verify facts, assess severity, recommend response timing and channels, prepare action plans and personally drive execution, escalation and follow-up.危机公关与敏感议题管理：独立主导负面报道、争议指控、投诉扩散、服务或安全事件及其他声誉风险的应对；核实事实、判断风险等级、确定回应时机与渠道、制定行动方案，并亲自推动执行、升级汇报和后续跟进。cross-platform social listening and online reputation: own monitoring and response coordination across major english- and chinese-language channels, including instagram, tiktok, facebook, x, youtube, linkedin, reddit, xiaohongshu / red, wechat, weibo and douyin, as relevant to u.s. audiences. include community forums, google and yelp reviews, app store ratings and digital news. map cross-platform spread, identify influential voices and prioritize risks by credibility, reach and business impact.全平台舆情监测与网络声誉：负责主要中英文渠道的监测与回应协调，包括instagram、tiktok、facebook、x、youtube、linkedin、reddit、小红书、微信、微博及抖音，并根据美国市场受众确定优先级；同时覆盖社区论坛、google与yelp评论、应用商店评价和网络新闻。分析跨平台传播路径、识别关键影响者，并依据内容可信度、传播范围及业务影响判断风险。hands-on response and bilingual writing: personally draft statements, press materials, media q&as, executive talking points, social responses and stakeholder updates in english and chinese. adapt messaging to each platform while maintaining factual consistency; address legitimate concerns, correct misinformation with evidence and coordinate reports of policy-violating content. align public comments, direct outreach and official communications with customer service and legal.亲自执行与双语写作：独立撰写中英文声明、新闻材料、媒体问答、管理层发言要点、社媒回应及外部沟通更新。根据不同平台调整表达，确保事实与核心口径一致；回应合理诉求，以证据澄清不实信息，并协调对违规内容的申诉。与客服及法务统一公开评论、直接沟通和官方回应。media relations and proactive reputation building: develop relationships with u.s. mainstream, local, industry and chinese-language media, journalists, creators and community stakeholders. handle sensitive inquiries and prepare spokespeople. identify credible stories about merchants, delivery partners and community impact, and execute communications that strengthen trust before and after a crisis.媒体关系与主动声誉建设：维护美国主流媒体、本地媒体、行业媒体、中文媒体、记者、内容创作者及社区伙伴关系；处理敏感问询并准备发言人材料。挖掘商家、配送伙伴及社区价值等有事实依据的故事，执行日常与危机后的传播，持续建立外部信任。cross-functional incident coordination: lead communications workstreams with legal, operations, customer service, marketing and leadership to investigate issues, align messages and support corrective action. coordinate external agencies and advisers when needed, track owners and deadlines, and ensure follow-through until the issue is resolved.跨部门事件协调：牵头与法务、运营、客服、市场及管理层的公关协作，调查问题、统一口径并推动改进措施；按需协调外部机构与顾问，明确责任人和时间节点，持续跟进直至事件解决。preparedness, analysis and measurement: establish monitoring alerts, escalation procedures, crisis playbooks and platform-specific response guidelines. use social listening and media data to assess sentiment, spread, message accuracy and response effectiveness. brief leadership on emerging risks and document lessons and corrective actions after incidents.危机准备、分析与效果评估：建立监测预警、升级机制、危机预案及各平台回应指引；通过舆情与媒体数据评估情绪变化、传播情况、信息准确性及回应效果；向管理层汇报新出现的风险，并在事件后复盘经验与改进措施。qualifications and requirements 任职要求5+ years of relevant experience in public relations, corporate communications, public affairs or crisis communications, including substantial hands-on ownership of sensitive issues. strong individual contributors and agency professionals with end-to-end client responsibility are welcome.5年以上公关、企业传播、公共事务或危机沟通相关经验，并具有独立处理敏感事件的实战经历；欢迎资深执行型人才，以及曾全流程负责客户项目的公关机构候选人。demonstrated ability to independently manage a significant reputational incident. be ready to discuss your decisions, personal contribution and outcomes using non-confidential examples.能够证明自己独立主导过重要声誉事件；面试时可通过不涉及保密信息的案例，说明判断过程、本人承担的工作及处理结果。practical u.s. government relations experience and established, relevant stakeholder relationships. understand how to engage government offices and regulators professionally and work effectively with legal.具备美国政府关系实操经验及与业务相关的外部关系基础，熟悉政府部门和监管机构的沟通方式，能够与法务有效配合。professional fluency in both english and mandarin is required, including excellent english writing and the ability to draft and review simplified chinese crisis communications.英语及普通话必须达到专业工作水平；英文写作能力优秀，能够独立撰写和审核简体中文危机沟通内容。demonstrated experience managing reputational issues across multiple social platforms and digital communities. understand english- and chinese-language audience behavior, platform dynamics, creator influence and how a story spreads between social media, reviews and news coverage.具备跨社交平台及网络社区处理声誉事件的实战经验，了解中英文受众行为、不同平台的传播机制、内容创作者的影响，以及事件在社媒、评论网站和新闻媒体之间扩散的路径。strong news judgment, discretion and evidence-based decision-making. able to prioritize quickly, write clearly under pressure and personally drive execution across teams.具备敏锐的新闻判断力、保密意识和基于证据的决策能力，能够在压力下迅速确定优先级、清晰表达并亲自推动跨团队执行。available for time-sensitive incident response outside regular business hours when necessary, and occasional travel for stakeholder meetings.能够在必要时于非工作时间响应紧急事件，并接受因外部沟通需要安排的偶尔出差。preferred experience 优先考虑experience in delivery platforms, marketplaces, consumer technology, food and beverage, or other businesses facing public and regulatory scrutiny.具有外卖平台、交易平台、消费科技、餐饮或其他受到公众及监管关注行业的相关经验。relevant government and media networks in new york or washington, d.c.; experience in cross-border communications, crisis-focused pr agencies or social listening platforms such as meltwater, brandwatch, talkwalker or equivalent tools.拥有纽约或华盛顿特区相关政府及媒体资源；具备跨境传播、危机公关机构经验，或使用meltwater、brandwatch、talkwalker等舆情工具的经验。why join hungrypanda 为什么加入熊猫外卖take ownership of work that directly shapes public trust, stakeholder relationships and business continuity. apply your expertise across u.s. and chinese-language audiences in a role that combines strategic judgment with hands-on execution.你的工作将直接影响公众信任、外部关系与业务稳定。你将面向美国及中文受众，在兼顾策略判断与亲自执行的岗位中发挥专业能力。

about the role:the john s. and james l. knight foundation is seeking an exceptional writer with strong editorial judgment and project management skills to join our communications team and help shape how the foundation is understood in the press and public discourse. as communications officer, you will partner with the director of communications to support the delivery of clear, timely and consequential communications across the foundation’s work, and amplify the voice of one of the nation’s leading champions of the first amendment, a free press and democracy.this is a hands-on role for a thoughtful, highly organized professional who can move between strategy and execution. you will work across knight’s grantmaking portfolio in journalism, research, the arts and community impact to identify stories and translate complex ideas, research findings, grantmaking and convenings into compelling materials for journalists, partners and the public.knight holds itself to high editorial standards and journalistic integrity. this role carries that into how we talk about our mission to ignite in every person the power to shape thriving communities.you will work closely with knight’s director of communications, within the communications function led by our vice president of communications and digital strategy. the role sits in our miami headquarters.you are an ideal candidate if:you understand the essential role of the first amendment in a democracy. you have strong command of ap style, experience in communications, media relations or journalism and a deep understanding of the media landscape and the narratives shaping public conversation and civic discourse today. you’re organized, respect deadlines, have or are willing to build relationships with reporters and influencers, and have experience managing vendors and editing writers. you own your areas of responsibility, work with growing independence, spot risks early and know when to escalate. you keep pace when priorities shift, and you do your best work on a small team.key responsibilities:media relations: support the director of communications in building and maintaining working relationships with journalists, editors, thought leaders, influencers and outlets. pitch stories, field inquiries, coordinate staff interviews and help secure accurate, timely coverage of knight’s work.writing and message development: draft press releases, statements, op-eds, talking points and briefing memos that hold to the foundation’s external narrative and voice. keep internal message houses, data repositories and grantmaking dollar amounts up to date.leadership and spokesperson support: prepare materials to equip leadership and program staff for media interviews, public appearances and high-stakes conversations, including background research, q&a and briefing materials.monitoring and insight: track media coverage and perceptions of the foundation to inform how to position knight’s work in public conversation, backed by performance data.vendors and project management: work with external communications vendors across public relations, speechwriting and event production. edit and manage freelance writers for knight’s owned editorial content.convenings: support program development, talking-points, event communications, including invitations and relationships with peer funders, grantees, high-profile guests and the press before, during and after events. partner with the convenings project manager, who leads logistics and execution, and with the marketing and creative team on brand and creative. expect hands-on support onsite, with occasional evenings, weekends and travel.cross-functional partnership: keep communications, marketing, convenings and program teams in step so media, campaign and field engagement line up.things we look for in a successful candidate:experience in media relations, communications or journalism, with a track record of owning defined areas of work with increasing independence.exceptional writing and editing on deadline, with command of ap style.strong news judgment and demonstrated media relations results or reported work: pitches placed, reporter relationships built and coverage earned.sound judgment and discretion with sensitive, embargoed or high-profile information and the instinct to escalate issues appropriately.comfort supporting live events, including preproduction and hands-on execution on site.commitment to knight’s mission and interest in free expression, thriving communities and our focus areas: information ecosystems, economic mobility and cultural vibrancy.preferred but not required:journalism experience, or non-profit communications experience.familiarity with media monitoring and coverage analysis tools.proficiency with a leading content management system (e.g., wordpress) and email marketing platforms such as mailchimp and rsvpify.experience with project management tools such as monday, asana and airtable.adobe creative suite skills.experience with or openness to using artificial intelligence to streamline processes and increase efficiency.interested candidates should submit a brief portfolio (pdf or website link) of their work and a resume to recruiter@kf.org.about knight foundationwe ignite in every person the power to shape thriving communities.john s. and james l. knight believed that a well-informed community could best “determine its own true interests” and was essential to a well-functioning, thriving democracy. for 75 years, knight foundation has continued their work by supporting people, organizations and insights that lead to healthier communities.the foundation invests in journalism, arts and culture, research and field-building efforts that promote a more resilient information ecosystem, deepen shared understanding and advance a culture of free expression and community development in the 26 cities where the knight brothers once published newspapers. since our founding in 1950, we have been committed to the communities we serve and to providing those communities with the tools they need for residents to thrive.we believe in freedom of expression and in the values expressed in the first amendment to the u.s. constitution. we believe an informed citizenry is essential for representative democracy to function effectively. we believe in engaged, equitable and inclusive communities. we believe in the power of diverse perspectives to foster positive change and build stronger, more equitable communities.our drive to create positive change is amplified by our ability to collaborate internally and with our partners. we look for authenticity, agility and accountability, knowing we are at our best when we leverage our collective strengths and experiences. we proactively approach our work with a sense of pride and responsibility, adapting as needed to the changing realities in our communities.knight foundation offers competitive pay and a generous benefits package and is an equal opportunity employer. the hiring salary range for this role starts at $80,000. actual compensation is based on a number of factors including qualifications, skills and relevant experience.this is an in-office position located in miami.this posting outlines the general nature of the role and is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities; duties may change based on organizational needs. the role requires the ability to perform standard office activities. reasonable accommodation will be provided as required by law.

strategy practice intro at lippincott, the strategy team takes on the problems that have no clear answer but need one—the launches, pivots, and reinventions that demand original ideas and proven expertise. our work spans three disciplines: brand strategy, marketing and customer strategy, and naming. together with design and experience colleagues across the firm, we help clients navigate their biggest challenges, from rising above competitive noise, to uncovering new frontiers for growth, to crafting the signature moments that make a brand unmistakable. you'll advise leaders across markets and industries, bringing rigorous creativity and dynamic energy to every opportunity—the same spirit that's helped lippincott shape icons, disruptors, and category-creators since 1943.role overviewas a senior consultant, you turn evidence into ideas. you’ll deeply understand a client’s unique situation and ambition—gathering and synthesizing research, business context, and competitive dynamics—and translate that insight into the early thinking that shapes your team’s recommendations. you’ll contribute directly to both the strategic content and the delivery of the work, bringing rigorous creativity to every step and partnering closely with designers and senior strategists to shape thoughtful solutions across brand positioning, architecture, marketing, customer experience, and more. it’s a chance to learn the craft of brand-building from some of the best in the field, with direct exposure to senior leaders and a real voice in the room.what you’ll dogather, organize, and synthesize research on client strategy, industry dynamics, and customer insight to surface what mattersconduct in-depth interviews with client stakeholders and leadershipsupport analysis of quantitative and qualitative research, from discrete choice modeling to focus groupstranslate findings into compelling content, narratives, and points of viewcollaborate with consultants and designers to pressure-test ideas and sharpen thinkingcontribute to the storyline and development of client presentationsapply lippincott frameworks and methodologies to new and unfamiliar problemssupport new business efforts by helping shape proposal contentwhat makes you a great candidateat least 3 years of experience in strategy consulting, corporate or brand strategy, brand management, or innovationa bachelor’s degree in a relevant fieldstrong creative and analytical instincts, with the ability to connect new problems to past experienceexcellent presentation, writing, and interpersonal skills — comfortable communicating at every level, internally and with clientsa rigorous, methodical approach paired with the flexibility to adapt ita collaborative mindset and a genuine appetite for feedback and growthopenness to travel as neededa desire to build and learn side-by-side with your teams.about lippincott lippincott is a global brand, marketing, and experience consultancy. since 1943, we’ve of oliver wyman, we bring high-caliber industry, risk, and operational insight to every engagement, pairing a management consultancy’s strategic rigor with a proven legacy of creativity that works.who this role can be office-based in freiburg (germany) / san francisco (usa) or remote-first, with a requirement to be in one of the offices one full week per month.about black forest labswe’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and stable diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative ai accessible to millions. with flux, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.our flux models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. we're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. from our labs in freiburg to san francisco, we're building what comes next.why this roleblack forest labs builds visual intelligence: models that create and understand images and video, and increasingly act in the physical world. for a company whose work is visual, the brand is part of the work. it's often the first thing people see of us, before they've tried a single model. it has to hold the same bar as our models and grow as they do.we're hiring our first brand & marketing design lead to define that brand and own it wherever people meet bfl. you'll bring the taste that sets the standard for how bfl looks, and build what keeps it consistent across launches, the website, events and everything in between.this is a hands-on lead role. you'll ship much of the work yourself while setting up the tools and processes that let others ship at your level. over time, you'll also shape how brand and marketing design grows at bfl, including who we hire next.what you'll work onlead how our visual identity grows, including logo, type, color, imagery and motion, and turn it into guidelines and design systems others can work from. create the concept and creative direction for each model launch, campaign and event, working with research to show what every new model can do. make the work people see every day, online and offline: social posts, editorial, decks, docs, sales material, event spaces, merchandise and print. own the direction of bfl.ai and our growth pages, and help make the website one of the clearest and strongest expressions of the brand. build templates, internal tools and an agent-readable design system so marketing, sales and engineering can create on-brand work themselves. we'd rather you build the generator than draw the hundredth asset. work with product design on shared foundations like type, color and components, so bfl.ai, the playground, the dashboard, and other product surfaces feel like one company. your teamdesign at bfl is young, and much of how it works is still open, including how we review work, what we call finished and how design informs decisions across teams. you'll help define these and represent design across the company.you'll work closely with devran, who leads design at bfl, and with teams across the company, including marketing, growth, developer relations, research and product design. among the people you'll work with most are owais and aitana in marketing and jay in growth engineering.what we're looking forat least six years designing brands, and one or two projects you'd still stand behind today, where you played a key role from concept through rollout and others now build on the work. we're looking for an original idea, clear taste and execution that holds up in every detail. deep craft in identity and visual design, from typography and color to layout, art direction and motion. you notice the crop, the spacing and the timing of a transition, and you fix them before anyone asks. a quality bar that raises the work around you. you've made a team better before, through the work you shipped and the feedback you gave. you're ready to ship from day one. you've started work no one asked for, seen it through, and sorted out disagreements directly with the people involved. a systems thinker. you've built guidelines, templates or design systems that others used well without you in the room, and you can tell when work should scale and when it should stay one of a kind. you move easily between the big picture and the details. you can make the
